多智能体系统

[MA-0] Multi-Agent Coordination Through Stigmergy for Canal Network Formation on Real Terrain IROS

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在非结构化户外环境中，地形改造型机器人集群如何在动态不确定性、通信不可靠及全局信息不完整的情况下实现协同作业的问题。其核心挑战在于如何设计一种无需集中控制或精确通信的分布式协调机制，以支持大规模地形构建任务。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于自组织（stigmergy） 的最小化框架，通过模拟河狸筑渠行为，使机器人个体仅依赖局部湿度线索进行挖掘作业，并通过与环境的闭环反馈机制实现间接协作。该框架将多智能体系统与真实数字高程模型（DEM）上的季节性水文过程耦合，在110次仿真中生成了具有可预测形态特征的类运河网络结构。通过对实际野外标注参考网络进行无方向性形态评估，识别出能复现关键运河特征的参数区间，同时揭示了过度渠化与碎片化的失败模式。研究证明，仅通过简单的局部地形修改行为与环境反馈，即可涌现出合理的宏观地貌结构，为研究去中心化的地形建造与仿生群体协调提供了一个简洁且可扩展的理论框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32966
作者: Jordan Kennedy,Federico Oliva,Amir Degani,Karen-Lee Bar Sinai,Nare Karapetyan
机构: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (WHOI)(伍兹霍尔海洋研究所); Technion – Israel Institute of Technology (以色列理工学院); Harvard University (哈佛大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Submitted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Terrain-modifying robot swarms operating in unstructured outdoor environments must coordinate under uncertain dynamics despite unreliable communication and incomplete global information. Stigmergy offers a decentralized alternative by allowing agents to coordinate indirectly through persistent environmental modifications, yet its application to large-scale terrain construction on real landscapes remains largely unexplored. Inspired by beaver canal construction, we present a minimal stigmergic framework for multi-agent systems in which decentralized agents follow local wetness cues, excavate terrain, and interact through a closed agent–environmental feedback loop. The framework couples agents with seasonal hydrology on a real digital elevation model (DEM). Across 110 simulations on an 862m x 1167m region spanning agent count and hydrological recession rate, the model produces emergent canal-like networks whose morphology varies predictably with environmental constraints. An alignment-invariant morphological evaluation against a field-annotated reference network identifies parameter regimes that reproduce key canal characteristics, while failure cases reveal over-canalization and fragmentation. These results demonstrate that simple local terrain-modifying behaviors can generate plausible landscape-scale structures through environmental feedback, providing a minimal framework for studying decentralized terrain construction and bio-inspired swarm coordination.

[MA-1] MRBench: Benchmarking Physical Necessity Reasoning in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Manipulation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多机器人协作操作中缺乏对物理必要性（physical necessity）的推理问题，即在动态环境中难以识别完成特定任务所真正必需的机器人或资源，尤其是在机器人本体能力变化、资源不可用或被动物体可替代机器人支持的情况下。现有协调代理虽在固定团队配置下表现良好，但在面对机器人形态变化或非机器人资源可用时性能显著下降。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为MRScissors的新方法，通过将任务需求与实际测量到的物理能力相分离，并采用受约束的搜索机制，自动识别出满足任务要求的最小可行机器人团队。该方法在两种模型架构上分别实现了85.4%和91.2%的团队选择准确率，显著优于最强基线模型（提升10.4和9.5个百分点）。研究进一步构建了MRBench基准，涵盖八项具有不同并发性与可达性约束的任务，在五种资源配置条件下评估物理必要性推理能力，揭示了当前多机器人协作系统在理解物理必要性方面的关键缺陷。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32803
作者: Yanzhe Chen,Zhijun Cao,Ruihe An,Chang Gong,Mike Zheng Shou
机构: Show Lab, National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学展示实验室)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Project website: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in multi-robot manipulation have shown how robots can collaborate to accomplish complex tasks. However, successful coordination does not reveal which robots are actually needed. The same task may require different teams as robot capabilities change, resources become unavailable, or objects replace robotic support. We argue that reliable multi-robot manipulation requires physical necessity reasoning: understanding what a task demands, which resources can fulfill those demands, and which are truly necessary. We introduce MRBench, a benchmark for physical necessity reasoning in heterogeneous multi-robot manipulation. It comprises eight tasks with distinct concurrency and reach constraints, each evaluated under five configurations that change the required resources while preserving the task goal. Our evaluation reveals that existing coordination agents perform well with reference teams but struggle when robot embodiments change or passive objects can replace robotic support. To address this gap, we propose MRScissors, which separates task requirements from measured physical capabilities and identifies minimal feasible teams through constrained search. Across two model backbones, MRScissors achieves 85.4% and 91.2% team-selection accuracy, outperforming the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 9.5 points, respectively. Together, these findings expose a critical gap between coordinating robots and understanding their physical necessity.

[MA-2] amFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination

【速读】：该论文旨在解决复杂协作任务中多智能体协同行为的生成与优化问题，特别是针对离线预训练的生成式策略（Generative Policy）受限于固定数据集、难以适应动态环境变化的瓶颈。现有在线强化学习方法虽可通过环境交互提升性能，但因动作似然度（action likelihoods）难以计算，导致流模型（Flow Policy）的微调困难。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种两阶段框架——TeamFlowRL：首先在离线阶段预训练多智能体流策略，随后在在线阶段通过基于完整去噪轨迹（denoising trajectories）的团队策略优化，避免了对不可计算的动作似然度的依赖；该方法将团队优势（team advantage）作为共享信号，对每个智能体的轨迹比率进行独立裁剪并加权，从而实现局部策略更新与全局团队回报的一致性。实验表明，该方法在7个仿真组共51组配对配置中均优于所有离线初始化，平均归一化得分提升47.3%；在6项双臂协作任务中，相较于高斯策略微调，在探索噪声下成功率达33.1%更高，显著提升了策略鲁棒性与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32645
作者: Guowei Zou,Beiwen Zhang,Haitao Wang,Hong Hong,Zhiquan Chen,Hejun Wu
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 27 pages. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL Models: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Complex cooperative tasks require coordinated multi-agent behavior. Offline generative policies learn expressive cooperative behaviors from trajectories but remain limited by fixed datasets. Online reinforcement learning can improve them through environment interaction. However, fine-tuning flow policies is difficult because action likelihoods are hard to compute. We propose TeamFlowRL, a two-stage framework that pretrains multi-agent flow policies offline and fine-tunes them online. We formulate team policy optimization over the complete denoising trajectories of decentralized flow policies, avoiding intractable action likelihoods. The resulting objective weights each agent’s trajectory ratio with a shared team advantage and clips each ratio separately, aligning local policy updates with the common team return. Across 51 paired configurations in seven simulation groups, TeamFlowRL improves every offline initialization, with a 47.3% average gain in normalized score. It also achieves 33.1% higher average success under exploration noise than Gaussian-policy fine-tuning across 6 bimanual tasks.

[MA-3] Recursive Collective Intelligence: Emergence on an Equal-Budget Ladder in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中“团队协作是否真正提升集体智能”这一核心问题，尤其关注在不依赖外部监督信号的前提下，团队能否通过自身交互与迭代实现持续进化。传统评估方法仅衡量团队整体性能优于单个智能体，却未考虑其更高的计算开销（如生成更多token），而简单的独立答案投票已能解释大部分性能增益，因此难以区分是协作本身带来的优势还是单纯计算资源的堆叠。为此，作者提出“等预算阶梯”（equal-budget ladder）评估框架，从三个层级对比团队表现：超越单个智能体、超越同规模计算量下的多数投票、以及超越同预算下的pass@n指标。在此基础上，提出递归集体智能（Recursive Collective Intelligence, RCI）的概念——即一个团队在无教师指导或外部标签的情况下，仅基于自身输出即可使其下一代在相同计算成本下表现更优。关键解决方案在于：第一，信息的有效跨代理传递是提升集体智能的核心，例如通过共享拆分事实，使团队在不同模型规模下均显著超越pass@n基准（27B模型提升约三分之一）；第二，团队内部自发形成组织结构（如枢纽节点），27B模型在无需显式提示时即实现18个百分点的准确率提升，而通过将此组织模式编码至提示词中，可使团队以不足一半的token预算达到第三级性能；第三，团队具备自我改进能力，两代无标签生成过程逐步攀登评估阶梯，第二代9B模型不仅超越pass@n，还优于基于基础模型生成的对照组；在PlanBench、HiddenBench和Hanabi等任务上，连续四到六代均在未见过的问题上持续超越前代。综上，当团队传递有用信息的效率高于协调所消耗的计算成本，并能从自身经验中学习优化协作策略时，其集体智能便真正超越个体之和。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32606
作者: Lixuan He,Shengqu Cai,Fang Wu,Shikang Zheng,Liwei Jiang,Manling Li,Yi Ma,Li Fei-Fei,Leonidas Guibas,Gordon Wetzstein,Yejin Choi,Yining Hong
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models increasingly work as teams of agents, and a team is expected to solve problems beyond the reach of any single member. Most evaluations credit a team for outperforming a single agent, without accounting for the additional computation: a team may consume many times the tokens of one agent, and a plain vote over independent answers already explains most of the reported gain. Two questions therefore remain open: When does interaction itself make a group smarter, and can a group improve its next generation by learning from its own work? We answer both with the equal-budget ladder, which grades a group against independent agents at three levels: outperforming a single agent, a compute-matched majority vote, and compute-matched pass@n. On this ladder we define Recursive Collective Intelligence (RCI) as a group whose own output, without a teacher or external labels, makes its next generation smarter at equal cost. Three findings follow. First, interaction improves collective intelligence when it moves information across agents: forwarding split facts lifts groups above pass@n at three model scales, by about a third at 27B. Second, organization emerges spontaneously: identical 27B agents form hubs and improve accuracy by 18 percentage points; encoding their organization in a prompt enables them to reach level 3 at less than half the token budget in a descriptive comparison. Third, groups recursively improve themselves: Two label-free generations progressively climb the ladder, the second 9B generation surpassing both pass@ n and a control trained on base-model turns; on PlanBench, HiddenBench and Hanabi, each generation outperforms its predecessor on unseen problems for four to six generations. A group therefore outperforms its members when it forwards useful information more efficiently than it spends tokens on coordination, and learns to do so from its own work.

[MA-4] meTravelContainer: A Live Forking Sandbox for Stateful Agent Exploration

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI (Generative AI) 代理在驱动状态化工具（如交互式终端、设计环境、仿真引擎）时，进行会话克隆、回溯与并行化探索所面临的性能瓶颈问题。现有方法依赖于将工具的内存状态序列化至磁盘或从零重启，导致交互式探索效率低下；而基于微虚拟机（microVMs）或内核补丁的代理沙箱则需完整内存序列化或特权部署，难以在共享计算集群、个人电脑等受限环境中使用。本文提出 TimeTravelContainer (TTC)，一种无需根权限、不依赖内核修改或硬件虚拟化的无根容器运行时，支持对正在运行的容器（包括进程、内存、文件系统和网络）进行实时分叉（live-fork），采用写时复制（Copy-on-Write, CoW）语义。由于工具会话在分叉点后多数内存为只读，克隆体可自动共享大部分内存，仅差异页消耗额外内存。TTC 在 Linux、macOS（Apple Silicon）及 Windows（WSL 2）上均可运行，具备高度可移植性。在两个代表性状态化工具工作负载——MAGE（Innovus）与 EvoDRC（KLayout）的评估中，TTC 实现了 84.1 倍的环境克隆加速、31–72% 的内存占用降低以及 1.7–9.4 倍的端到端性能提升，证明了实时分叉技术有效消除了代理驱动状态下工具环境探索的扩展障碍。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32255
作者: Zizheng Guo,Yanqing Zhang,Nathaniel Pinckney,Cunxi Yu,Brucek Khailany
机构: NVIDIA Corporation(英伟达)
类目: Operating Systems (cs.OS); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 8 pages, 1 figure, this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents that drive stateful tools (e.g., interactive shells, design environments, simulation engines) frequently need to clone, backtrack, and parallelize live sessions to support exploration. However, cloning a live session today requires serializing the tool’s in-memory state to disk or relaunching from scratch, both prohibitively slow for interactive exploration. Existing agent sandboxes based on microVMs or kernel patches either serialize full guest memory to storage or require privileged deployment, limiting use on shared compute farms, personal computers, and other restricted environments. We present TimeTravelContainer (TTC), a rootless container runtime that live-forks an entire running container, including processes, memory, filesystem, and network, with copy-on-write (CoW) semantics. Because the bulk of a tool session’s memory is typically read-only after the fork point, clones share it automatically and only diverged pages consume additional memory. TTC requires no kernel modifications, hardware virtualization, or root privileges, and runs on all major platforms including Linux, macOS (Apple Silicon), and Windows (WSL 2), making it deployable as a portable foundation for agent harnesses. We evaluate TTC on two agentic electronic design automation (EDA) flows as representative stateful-tool workloads: MAGE (Innovus) and EvoDRC (KLayout). TTC achieves 84.1 \times environment cloning speedup, 31–72% memory reduction, and 1.7–9.4 \times end-to-end speedup, demonstrating that live forking removes a scaling barrier for agent-driven exploration of stateful tool environments.

[MA-5] Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums: Execution-Bound Evidence Certification and Plausible-World Safety Gating in Agent ic Control Planes

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在分布式系统中进行自主决策时，因共享预训练先验与共识推理机制导致的错误相关性问题，即模型间的一致性并非真实物理证据，反而可能放大共因故障风险，从而削弱容错能力；同时，传统刚性确定性检查机制会阻碍故障恢复的动态响应。其核心解决方案是提出来源隔离认知共识（Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums, PIEQ），一种执行边界认证层，通过将每个语言模型严格置于可信计算基（Trusted Computing Base, TCB）之外，实现多维度保障：基于假设的真理维护、物理来源隔离、控制论意义上的合理世界安全防护，以及可线性化的并发治理。PIEQ围绕三大职责构建：从不同物理故障域验证诊断前提条件、在所有未被反驳的故障场景下对候选变更进行准入控制并在模糊情况下回退至只读诊断探测、并通过快照屏障、修订检查、授权时效性、可信时间前提策略及能力分级执行，将准入凭证绑定至目标执行。实验表明，PIEQ在形式化保证、自动化etcd故障测试套件、冻结软件基准和实时语言模型运行中均实现零假设内不安全准入与零虚假前提提交，将代理证明遗漏转化为可恢复的假阻塞而非不安全操作，在物理PostgreSQL/Patroni集群上成功协同原生split-brain保护机制，并在单一可序列化PostgreSQL事务内强制执行完整的Tier E2合同以实现容量有界预留。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32032
作者: Jun He,Deying Yu
机构: OpenKedge LLC(OpenKedge有限责任公司)
类目: Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 22 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables; 6-page ancillary supplementary PDF (6 tables). Code, benchmarks, and CI artifacts: this https URL (commit 80836b20)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agreement among large language models is not physical evidence for mutating production infrastructure. Because generative models share pretraining priors and conform to peer rationales during deliberation, voting ensembles correlate errors instead of providing independent fault tolerance; yet attaching rigid deterministic checks to unconstrained agent outputs paralyzes incident remediation. We present Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums (PIEQ), an execution-bound certification layer that keeps every language model strictly outside the trusted computing base. PIEQ unifies assumption-based truth maintenance, physical provenance isolation, control-theoretic plausible-world safety shielding, and linearizable concurrency governance around three distinct obligations: certifying diagnostic preconditions from disjoint physical failure domains, gating candidate mutations across all unrefuted fault worlds while falling back to read-only diagnostic probes under ambiguity, and binding admission certificates to target execution through snapshot barriers, revision checks, authorization freshness, trusted temporal-precondition policies, and capability-tiered enforcement. Across formal guarantees, automated etcd fault suites, frozen software benchmarks, and live language-model runs, PIEQ achieves zero within-assumption unsafe admissions and zero false-precondition commits, converting occasional agent proof omissions into recoverable false blocks rather than unsafe actions. On a physical PostgreSQL/Patroni cluster, PIEQ gates supervised failovers alongside Patroni and etcd’s native split-brain protection and enforces a full Tier E2 contract inside a single serializable PostgreSQL transaction for bounded capacity reservations. All benchmarks are author-labeled, live model snapshots are unpinned, and Tier E2 physical failover promotion as well as multi-host hardware fault isolation remain open work. [MA-6] Unifying Partner and Environment Diversity to Improve Human-AI Coordination NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现实世界中人工智能系统在面对未见过的环境与新型人类用户时的泛化能力问题，尤其关注零样本协作（Zero-Shot Coordination, ZSC）场景下，如何实现对未知伙伴与未知环境的协同适应。现有方法多聚焦于在固定环境中通过模拟多样化人类用户来训练代理，但忽略了更贴近实际的“用户与环境均未知”的双重不确定性挑战。为此，本文提出一种双阶段框架——跨环境共演（Cross Environment Co-Play, CECP），其核心在于联合建模伙伴多样性与环境多样性：首先在一系列程序生成的多样化环境中训练一组自对弈（self-play）代理以构建多样化的合作伙伴群体；随后，训练一个协作者策略（cooperator policy）以与该伙伴群体进行协作。为进一步耦合社会性推理（社会行为理解）与环境结构推理，引入了下一状态预测模块，促使模型表征同时编码合作方的行为模式与任务结构特征。在神经科学启发的协作觅食任务及主流ZSC基准Overcooked上的实验表明，CECP在未见伙伴与未见环境条件下均取得最优性能，并达到当前人类-智能体协作评估协议下的最先进水平。通过对下一状态预测模块所生成潜在表示的分析，发现其不仅能提升协作表现，还能提供更具可解释性的隐含表征，例如可有效推断出合作方的能力水平。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32031
作者: Patrick Q. Zhang,Yancheng Liang,Adrienne Fairhall,Natasha Jaques
机构: University of Washington (华盛顿大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 10 pages, 11 figures, NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Real-world applications of modern AI systems require generalization to both unseen environments and novel human users. The field of zero-shot coordination (ZSC) has focused primarily on deploying AI to cooperate with novel partners in otherwise familiar environments. Popular population-based methods achieve this by partnering the agent with a diversity of simulated human users during training in a fixed environment, but does not consider the more realistic scenario where both the users and the environment are unseen during training. Recently, training across environments has been explored in training a single self-play agent, which shows better generalization on both novel human users and unseen environments. In this work, we ask whether jointly modeling partner diversity and environment diversity yields stronger coordination with novel partners in novel environments. We introduce Cross Environment Co-Play (CECP), a two-stage framework that first trains a population of self-play agents across a distribution of procedurally generated environments, and then trains a cooperator policy against this partner population. To further couple social and environmental reasoning, we add a next-state prediction module that encourages representations to encode both partner behavior and task structure. We evaluate CECP on both a neuroscience-inspired cooperative foraging task, and the popular ZSC benchmark Overcooked, under held-out partner and held-out environment conditions. CECP achieves the strongest performance among the compared baselines and attains state-of-the-art results under our evaluation protocol for human-AI collaboration. We analyze the model’s latent representation encoded by the next-state prediction module, showing it can not only improve the performance of the cooperative AI, but also provide more interpretable latents, demonstrated by the inference of partner skill levels.

[MA-7] Agent DRC: Multi-Agent Algorithms for Spatially-Aware Automated DRC Correction

【速读】：该论文旨在解决物理设计中设计规则检查（DRC）错误修复效率低下的问题，尤其针对现有大语言模型（LLM）代理方法在处理冗余上下文形状、缺乏对原始坐标的空间推理能力以及布局表示方式低效等局限性。其核心解决方案是提出AgentDRC框架，将迭代式DRC修正过程建模为多智能体协同算法，并引入一种空间感知的验证与修正机制，通过重构关键几何对象间的结构化空间关系，结合几何与语义约束进行修复验证。系统协调四个专业化智能体，实现多层次、多模态几何特征感知、无关形状过滤及迭代纠错。实验表明，AgentDRC在复杂违规场景下达到最高30.4%的pass@1和55.7%的pass@5，较最优基线提升13.8%的pass@5性能，显著提升了自动化修复能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31876
作者: Pengju Liu,Nuo Xu,Winso Chen,Peijun Li,Yang(Katie)Zhao,Yu Cao,Caiwen Ding
机构: University of Minnesota Twin Cities (明尼苏达大学双城分校)
类目: Hardware Architecture (cs.AR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Design Rule Checking (DRC) error fixing remains a time-consuming bottleneck in physical design, often requiring manual intervention despite advanced EDA optimizations. Existing LLM-agent approaches fall short due to redundant contextual shapes, limited spatial reasoning over raw coordinates, and inefficient flat layout representations. We propose AgentDRC, which formulates iterative DRC correction as a multi-agent algorithm and introduces a spatial-aware verification and correction algorithm that reconstructs structured spatial relations among critical shapes and validates fixes through geometric and semantic constraint checking. The system coordinates four specialized agents to perceive multi-level, multi-modal geometric features, filter irrelevant shapes, and iteratively correct violations. Experiments show that AgentDRC achieves up to 30.4% pass@1 and 55.7% pass@5 on challenging violations, with 13.8% pass@5 improvement over the best baseline. We will open-source all code and benchmark tasks upon acceptance.

[MA-8] Exploring Multi-Player Social Games as Verifiable Training Grounds for Large Language Models

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在训练社交智能时依赖昂贵、噪声大且易受奖励劫持（reward hacking）影响的LLM裁判的问题。其核心解决方案是利用具有明确规则和可验证结果的多人社交游戏，通过监督微调（SFT）与基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来训练模型，使模型能够在开放性对话中实现团队协作、角色推断，并以客观游戏结果作为可靠奖励信号。实验表明，相较于仅使用提示（in-context prompting）的方法，SFT与RLVR显著提升了Qwen3系列模型在三类训练游戏中的胜率（从33%提升至81%），并在未见的三类保留游戏中保持较高表现（从39%提升至54%），且该效果在不同模型规模（1.7B、4B、32B）下均具有一致性。定性分析显示，训练后的代理表现出更强的社交智能特征，如更主动的信息共享、基于公开证据的意图验证以及协同投票等行为。研究结果表明，基于社交游戏中可验证结果的训练范式能够有效培养具备泛化能力的社交行为，为构建可扩展的社交智能体提供了一条可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31821
作者: Keyu He,Michael Li,Jiarui Liu,Mingqian Zheng,Koichi Onoue,Tongshuang Wu,Maarten Sap
机构: Carnegie Mellon University (卡内基梅隆大学); Fujitsu Research of America (富士通美国研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The training of socially intelligent language models often relies on large language model (LLM) judges, which are expensive, noisy, and vulnerable to reward hacking. Multi-player social games offer a natural alternative: they require open-ended communication to coordinate with teammates and infer hidden roles, while their rules provide an objective outcome which can serve as a verifiable reward for training. Using three social games, we explore how much social intelligence Qwen3 models can acquire through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Results show that against a much stronger Gemma-3-27B model, SFT and RLVR raise the win rate of Qwen3-4B from 33% to 81% on the three trained games, and from 39% to 54% on three additional held-out games. In contrast, in-context strategies such as prompting improve the win rate of Qwen3-4B by only about 6 pp across the same games we train and evaluate on. Furthermore, we show that the gains from SFT and RLVR hold across the model sizes 1.7B, 4B, and 32B. Qualitative analyses of agent behavior show signs of stronger social intelligence; for example, trained agents tend to share information more openly, check each other’s claims against public evidence, and coordinate their votes. More broadly, our results demonstrate that training LLMs on verifiable outcomes in social games can cultivate generalizable social behaviors, which offers a scalable path for building socially intelligent agents.

[MA-9] he Paradox of Agency-Preserving AI: Negotiating Learner Agency in Layered Human-AI Interactions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在认知密集型学习任务中广泛应用背景下，其即时解决方案能力对学习者自主性（learner agency）造成的潜在削弱问题。尽管元层级 AI 系统通过提供反思与元认知支架被视作支持学习者自我调节的可行路径，但此类系统在规范学习者何时、如何及为何反思时，反而可能限制其自主性，形成“旨在维护自主性却反向制约自主性”的根本矛盾。研究通过与18名参与编程与学术写作任务的学生共同设计工作坊，利用扩展了 ChatWise 的 ChatGPT 实现元层级反馈，基于185条提示-反馈记录、174份书面反思以及17个故事板和5份小组设计提案，识别出四大相互关联的设计张力：辅助与反思之间的平衡、即时干预与自我调节空间之间的冲突、系统可见性与注意力竞争之间的权衡，以及系统自适应性与用户控制权之间的矛盾。研究提出一个包含任务、认知与交互三个维度的多维学习者自主性框架，并基于实证数据构建了可协商上述张力的交互设计机制，为未来智能教育系统的负责任设计提供了理论与实践依据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31573
作者: Yueling Fan,Jacqueline Wong,Olov Engwall,Olga Viberg
机构: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden(KTH皇家理工学院，斯德哥尔摩，瑞典); Utrecht University, Utrecht, The Netherlands(乌得勒支大学，乌得勒支，荷兰); Digital Futures, Stockholm, Sweden(数字未来研究所，斯德哥尔摩，瑞典)
类目: Human-Computer Interaction (cs.HC); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative AI is increasingly used by learners in cognitively demanding tasks, but its capacity to provide immediate solutions raises concerns about decreased learner agency. Meta-level AI systems that provide reflective and metacognitive scaffolding have emerged as a promising approach to supporting learners’ self-regulation. However, these systems introduce a fundamental paradox: AI intended to preserve learner agency can itself constrain that agency by regulating when, how, and why learners should reflect. To investigate this challenge, we conducted a co-design workshop with 18 students engaged in programming and academic writing tasks using ChatGPT extended with ChatWise, a meta-level AI system providing self-regulated learning-aligned feedback. Drawing on 185 prompt-feedback entries, 174 written reflections, and participants’ design artifacts (17 storyboards and 5 group design proposals), we identified four interconnected design tensions: assistance vs reflection, immediate intervention vs space for self-regulation, visibility vs attention competition, and system adaptation vs user control. The study contributes a multidimensional account of learner agency that includes task, cognitive, and interaction agency, along with empirically grounded interaction-design mechanisms to negotiate these tensions.

[MA-10] Heterogeneous Risk-Sensitive Evolutionary Learning in Coordination Games: Polarization Welfare Loss and Intervention for Efficiency

【速读】：该论文旨在解决有限群体中异质风险态度个体在协调博弈演化学习过程中导致的长期效率低下问题。其核心问题是：当群体由两个具有固定风险偏好的子群体组成时，基于风险敏感型最优反应与突变（BRM）模型，为何会出现虽非帕累托最优却仍为唯一随机稳定的极化状态——即两子群体选择不同行动，且该结果在期望收益和个体自身的熵风险度量（ERM）调整收益下均劣于支付占优均衡。解决方案的关键在于设计干预机制以调节学习过程中的风险态度：通过调整足够大比例（干预份额）和足够高的强度（风险参数提升）的个体风险偏好，可确保支付占优均衡成为唯一随机稳定的结果；然而，干预强度无法弥补干预份额不足，反之亦然，二者需协同达到阈值才能实现效率改进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31568
作者: Solaleh Mohammadi,Yiman Fong,Kaiqing Zhang
机构: University of Maryland, College Park, MD, USA(马里兰大学学院市分校)
类目: ystems and Control (eess.SY); Computer Science and Game Theory (cs.GT); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study evolutionary learning in coordination games in a finite population of agents with heterogeneous risk attitudes, modeled using the entropic risk measure (ERM). The population consists of two subpopulations, each with a fixed risk attitude. Under risk-sensitive best response with mutations (BRM), we characterize the long-run outcomes of the learning process. In particular, we characterize when a polarized state, in which the two subpopulations choose different actions, is uniquely stochastically stable in terms of agents’ risk attitudes and the subpopulation sizes. Notably, this polarized state is strictly Pareto dominated by the payoff-dominant equilibrium under both expected payoffs and agents’ own ERM-adjusted payoffs. Moreover, its welfare, measured by average expected payoff, is always lower than that of the payoff-dominant equilibrium and can also be lower than that of the risk-dominant equilibrium. Thus, heterogeneity of risk attitudes in learning alone can lead to an inefficient long-run outcome. To mitigate such inefficiency, we propose intervention mechanisms to modify agents’ risk attitudes in learning. We show that a sufficiently large intervention share (the fraction of agents modified) and sufficiently high intervention intensity (the increase in their risk parameter) ensure that the payoff-dominant equilibrium is uniquely stochastically stable. However, greater intervention intensity cannot compensate for an insufficient intervention share, and a larger intervention share cannot compensate for insufficient intervention intensity.

[MA-11] Sampling at Scale: Distributed Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体轨迹优化中两个耦合的核心挑战：在非凸优化景观中高效探索，以及在大规模智能体团队中实现可扩展性。传统基于采样的方法虽适用于探索非凸空间，但其计算复杂度随问题维度增长而急剧上升，且在分布式优化框架中的直接集成会引发根本性权衡——要么无法有效处理约束引起的非凸性，要么搜索空间随邻域规模增大而膨胀。为此，本文提出一种基于采样机制的分布式轨迹优化架构（DS-TO），其核心创新在于设计了一种针对采样特性的分解机制：每个智能体仅在其自身的控制空间内进行独立采样，不受邻域规模影响，同时仍能感知约束带来的非凸特性及其他智能体的决策。该架构实现了完全去中心化，仅需邻域通信，所有局部更新可在各智能体间并行执行。通过引入并行雅可比更新和单步约束线性化等高效变体，进一步降低了计算开销。在二维与三维场景中，针对最多1024个智能体的实验表明，该方法在探索能力、约束满足度方面优于当前主流的基于梯度的分布式优化方法，并在可扩展性上显著超越现有分布式采样方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31561
作者: Minchan Jung,Dimitrios S. Georgiou,Augustinos D. Saravanos,Evangelos A. Theodorou
机构: Georgia Institute of Technology (佐治亚理工学院); Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Systems and Control (eess.SY); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent trajectory optimization poses two coupled challenges: effectively exploring non-convex landscapes and scaling favorably to large teams of agents. Sampling-based methods are natural candidates for the exploration challenge but scale poorly with problem dimension. Moreover, their off-the-shelf integration into distributed optimization introduces a fundamental trade-off: sampling either fails to address the constraint-induced non-convexity or its search space grows with neighborhood size. We address this gap by introducing a \underlineD\textistributed \underlineS\textampling-based \underlineT\textrajectory \underlineO\textptimization \ \text(DS-TO) architecture built on a splitting mechanism tailored to sampling. Under this splitting, each agent samples only in its own control space, independent of neighborhood size, while still remaining exposed to both the constraint-induced non-convexity and the decisions of other agents. The resulting algorithm is fully decentralized, requiring only neighborhood communication, with all local updates executed in parallel across agents. Efficient variations, including parallel Jacobi updates within each agent’s subproblem and single-step constraint linearization, further reduce computation. Experiments on 2D and 3D tasks with up to 1024 agents demonstrate improved exploration and constraint satisfaction over state-of-the-art derivative-based distributed optimization, and superior scalability to existing distributed sampling methods.

[MA-12] Reproducible Social Structure Emerges From Free-Form Interaction Among LLM Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体大语言模型（Multi-agent LLM）模拟中普遍存在的一致性与可重复性问题：现有研究大多基于单次运行得出结论，难以区分现象是系统内在的稳健特征，还是偶然事件所致。为此，论文提出一种可重复、目标无关且具有主动性（proactive）的多智能体框架，包含50个基于人格（persona）设定、具备持久记忆的智能体，它们在三个社交平台上自主决定是否、与谁以及如何通信。该框架支持非扰动式的时间快照与重复实验测量。在相同初始条件下运行同一世界十次，累计历时700小时，结果显示多数网络层与个体层参数在重复实验中保持稳定。所有十次运行均观察到初期广泛通信逐渐收敛为少数持续存在的二元互动对（dyads），且这些二元对在不同世界中重复出现的频率显著高于随机预期或仅由个体社会性决定的水平。研究表明，静态人格相似性无法有效预测此类稳定二元对；相反，首次接触时情绪与特质表达的契合度（alignment）及极端性（extremity）才是关键预测因子。此外，智能体在思维链（chain-of-thought）中表达的情绪与特质可有效预测其后续行为。更进一步，通过交换智能体的人格提示（persona prompts）或累积记忆，接收方的行为会显著趋近于发送方，两种“移植”均能使接收方行为向捐赠方靠拢约60%，且经记忆移植的智能体从下一回合起即表现出与捐赠者一致的行为模式。总体而言，该研究通过重复实验验证了多智能体社会中涌现行为的统计稳健性，为理解生成式人工智能（Generative AI）驱动的社会系统提供了可复现、数据驱动的分析范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31543
作者: Tom Alisch,Sonia Murthy,Robert Hawkins,Felix Sosa,Core Francisco Park
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 16 pages, 5 figures, 17 supplementary figures and tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent LLM simulations are increasingly used as models of social systems, but most published findings are anecdotal, i.e., drawn from a single run. It is therefore unclear which observed phenomena are robust findings of the simulated system itself, and which were random events in one particular run. Here, we introduce a repeatable, goal-free, proactive multi-agent framework in which fifty persona-conditioned agents with persistent memory choose whether, with whom, and how to communicate across three social platforms. The framework supports non-perturbative measurements across temporal snapshots and repetitions. Running the same world ten times from identical initial conditions for a total of 700 hours, we find that most measured network- and agent-level parameters are stable across repetitions. Throughout a run, initially broad communication contracts into sparse sustained dyads in all ten worlds. Importantly, we find that many identical dyads re-form across worlds significantly more often than expected by chance or from agent-specific sociability alone. Static personality similarity largely fails to predict these dyads. Instead, alignment and extremity in the emotions and traits expressed during first contact predict whether a pair later forms a sustained dyad. Additionally, individual agents’ emotion and trait expression in their chain-of-thought predicts their future behavior. Finally, swapping either persona prompts or accumulated memories between agents causes recipients to exhibit behavior more similar to donors. Both kinds of transplant move the recipients about 60% of the way toward its donor personality, and state-transplanted agents start behaving similar to their donor agent from their next turn on. Overall, we show that repeated worlds enable robust, statistically-grounded conclusions about emergent within-configuration behavior in agent societies.

[MA-13] Measuring Counterfactual Credit in a Replayable Wildfire-Suppression Benchmark

【速读】：该论文旨在解决合作多智能体强化学习中评价学习批评者（critic）信用分配能力的难题。传统方法通常通过批评者对团队总回报（team’s return）的预测精度来评估其性能，但预测团队回报与精确分配个体动作信用是两个本质不同的任务。为直接测试信用分配的有效性，作者提出FLARE（Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment），一个可重放的随机野火扑灭基准环境，能够在相同随机事件下重现任意时刻的火灾状态并尝试不同动作。通过单步重放可测量每个智能体抑制行为的即时影响，称为“模拟器信用”（simulator credit），用于训练；通过全程重放则可评估每条动作的最终效果，用于评判批评者的信用分配准确性。在八组种子实验中，基于多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）框架，使用模拟器信用将中位数烧毁时间（interquartile mean burn score，即地图上各单元格燃烧时间的截尾平均值，越低越好）从共享奖励策略下的26.6%降低至20.9%。而采用集中式COMA风格学习的批评者表现仅与共享奖励相当，且四个训练好的批评者虽能良好预测团队回报，但其分配的信用量比模拟器信用高出9至42倍，且对异构智能体的动作排名高度趋同。这些结果表明，对团队回报的良好拟合并不能有效反映批评者在信用分配上的真实性，因此需引入可重放机制进行更严格的信用验证。该研究的关键在于通过可重放环境实现对信用的客观度量，并以此作为训练和评估批评者的基准，从而突破传统评价范式的局限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31499
作者: Alireza Moghaddasi
机构: University of Maryland, College Park, MD, USA(马里兰大学帕克分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 29 pages, 10 figures, 19 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, learned critics are usually evaluated by how well they predict the team’s return. Yet predicting a team’s return and assigning credit to individual actions are distinct tasks. To test credit directly, we introduce FLARE (Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment), a stochastic wildfire suppression benchmark in which any moment of a fire can be replayed with different actions under the same random events. Replaying one step measures the immediate effect of each agent’s suppression, which we call simulator credit and use for training. Replaying to the end of the episode measures the effect of each action, which we use for grading critics. In a comparison over eight seeds with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO), simulator credit reduces the interquartile mean burn score (each cell’s burning time, capped and averaged over the map; lower is better) from 26.6% with shared reward to 20.9%. Learned credit from a centralized COMA-style critic does no better than the shared reward. Four trained critics predict the team’s return well, yet the credit they assign is 9 to 42 times larger than the credit measured by replay. The critics also give heterogeneous agents nearly identical action rankings. These results show that a good fit to the team’s return is a weak test of a critic’s credit.

[MA-14] Evolutionary AI Control: Population-Level Safety Under Reproduction Heredity and Selection

【速读】：该论文旨在解决开放多智能体系统中因个体安全合规却导致群体违反集体安全限制的潜在风险问题。在这些系统中，智能体可自我复制、修改后代并动态改变系统成员身份，由此引发的选择压力可能导致种群演化出开发者优化目标之外的有害特征。其核心解决方案在于建立一套形式化安全证书，证明在繁殖、继承与选择机制下，安全约束仍能保持有效。关键创新在于：在假设条件下，该框架能够对运行过程中动态生成的种群，基于预期累积损害进行上界约束，即使调度器根据历史观测自适应调整繁殖规则亦成立；同时，通过引入类似多细胞生物调控细胞分裂的机制，确保后代继承修改后仍遵守繁殖限制。研究通过四个反例揭示了现有验证方法（依赖静态或注册成员）的局限性，并确立了涵盖演化可达状态的完备安全保证条件。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31312
作者: Andrew T. Cadotte
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:An AI agent can satisfy every individual safety check and still give rise to a population that violates a collective safety limit. This risk arises in open multi-agent systems, where agents copy themselves, modify their successors, and change system membership during a run. Selection then shifts the population toward traits outside the developers’ optimization targets. We prove conditions under which safety guarantees persist through reproduction, inheritance, and selection, and we characterize how they fail. Four counterexamples illustrate these failures. Unauthorized copies, which violate a specified reproductive restriction, can each leave fewer than one successor on average while their expected number grows without bound under continued production from an expanding authorized population. Two lineages can each decline in isolation yet grow exponentially when they interact. Alternating between reproductive rules can drive growth even when each rule, applied alone, suppresses it. Selection can raise the population’s average rate of unauthorized reproduction above a certified limit even though every agent’s rate remains fixed. Whereas existing verification methods assume fixed or registered membership, we prove safety certificates, under stated assumptions, for populations whose agents create successors during a run. The main result bounds the expected cumulative harm over a run, including when a scheduler adapts the reproductive rules to the observed history. Further conditions cover every population state reachable through evolution and preserve reproductive restrictions as descendants inherit modifications. Drawing on the mechanisms by which multicellular organisms control cell reproduction, the framework enables developers to specify and verify these controls before deployment. [MA-15] When Successful Collaboration Becomes an Attack Surface: Insider Memory Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（Multi-Agent Systems, MAS）中共享内存机制所引入的新型内部威胁问题。尽管共享内存被设计用于存储和复用成功的协作记录以提升团队跨任务表现，但其也成为了恶意内部成员实施隐蔽攻击的潜在渠道。传统内部攻击通常通过在当前协作过程中注入误导性信息实现，而本文提出的攻击方式——多智能体内部记忆污染攻击（MIMPA）则利用共享记忆的持久性特性：恶意智能体在早期任务中以正常参与身份协助团队正确作答，同时将目标特定的污染载荷嵌入成功协作记录；该载荷随后在后续目标任务中被检索并作为“可信经验”影响良性智能体决策，且可通过恶意触发进一步放大其误导效果。MIMPA的关键在于仅依赖常规参与权限即可完成攻击，无需直接内存访问，从而绕过现有防御机制。实验表明，该攻击在三个基准测试及两种大语言模型（LLM）架构下均显著优于已有内部攻击方法，并在分层记忆管理策略下仍具有效性，审计手段仅部分缓解其威胁。研究揭示了共享记忆虽有助于积累团队经验，却也可能成为持久且隐蔽的内部攻击通道。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31307
作者: Jihyung Ahn,Buru Chang
机构: Korea University(韩国大学); Google(谷歌)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注: 28 pages, 19 figures, 9 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) increasingly use shared memory to store and reuse successful collaboration records, enabling teams to improve across tasks. However, this memory introduces a new attack surface for malicious insiders. Unlike existing insider attacks that inject misleading information directly into the current collaboration, misinformation stored in shared memory can later appear as successful team experience and gain greater credibility and influence. We propose MIMPA (Multi-Agent Insider Memory Poisoning Attack), which exploits this vulnerability using only normal participation privileges, without direct memory access. During an earlier task, the malicious agent embeds a target-specific payload while helping the team answer correctly, allowing the payload to be retained in a successful collaboration record. When retrieved for a later target task, this poisoned record can steer benign agents toward a designated wrong answer, further amplified by malicious triggering. Across three benchmarks and two LLM backbones, MIMPA substantially outperforms existing insider attacks and remains effective under hierarchical memory management, while auditing only partially mitigates it. These results reveal that shared memory intended to accumulate team experience can become a persistent channel for insider attacks. Our code is available at this https URL.

[MA-16] Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation Strategy-Proofness and Multi-Scale Composition

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中自治智能体治理的核心结构性问题，即在资源受限的环境下，如何合理分配执行权限这一根本性难题。传统观点将治理视为确保动作正确执行的问题，但本文指出，谁有权执行（allocation）本质上是治理的结构性前提，而非辅助性问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出一个不可约简的多尺度治理体系，该体系由四个正交维度构成：时间维度（原子性）、状态维度（强制执行）、行为维度（漂移监控）和种群维度（分配）。研究通过一系列不可能性结果（如Sybil攻击放大、理想分配属性间的不相容性）证明，单一控制层无法解决分配机制带来的公平性、效率与抗策略操纵之间的固有权衡。进一步表明，在有限可观测条件下，任何试图简化或合并这些维度的治理架构都将导致正确性或稳定性的丧失。因此，分配作为第一性约束，强制要求治理体系保持多层级、多维度的复杂结构，无法被简化。作者通过理论构造与实证消融验证了各层级的不可或缺性，从而将智能体治理重新定义为一个涉及访问权配置的结构性问题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31284
作者: Marcelo Fernandez
机构: TraslaIA
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 19 pages. Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19708496

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act. In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties. We then show that these allocation constraints cannot be resolved within a single layer of control. Instead, they propagate across the system, interacting with execution atomicity, state enforcement, and behavioral drift. This leads to a multi-scale governance structure composed of four orthogonal dimensions: temporal (atomicity), state (enforcement), behavioral (drift monitoring), and population (allocation). Our main result is an irreducibility theorem: under finite observability, no governance architecture can collapse these dimensions without loss of correctness or stability. Allocation, in particular, acts as a first-class constraint that prevents simplification of the governance stack. We validate these results through a series of analytical constructions and empirical ablations, showing that removing or approximating any layer leads to systematic failure modes. This work reframes agent governance as a structural problem: not only how actions are executed, but how access to execution is determined, and why these decisions impose irreducible architectural requirements. [MA-17] CANON: Agent -Assisted Construction of Canonical Differential Equations for Feynman Integrals

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多圈费曼积分计算中规范基（canonical basis）构造的难题，当前已有多种方法用于此目的，但尚无一种方法具有普适性，导致有效基的获得往往依赖反复尝试与验证。为此，本文提出CANON——一种基于智能体（agent）辅助的框架，以提升基的搜索与验证效率。其核心解决方案在于：通过智能体自主选择并调用相应工具对基提案或对应的微分方程系统进行修正，再由独立程序验证结果的有效性，若不通过则触发重试机制。该框架配备专门的状态管理工具，支持长周期、多子智能体协作的基搜索任务，并具备模块化架构，便于未来扩展。通过在若干二圈和三圈积分族上的应用，验证了该框架的有效性与实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33100
作者: Dong-shan Jian,Yuanche Liu,Yan-qing Ma,Bo-xuan Shi,Yu Wu,Zihao Wu,Yang Zhang
机构: Peking University (北京大学); University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学); LAPTh, Université Savoie Mont Blanc, CNRS (法国萨瓦-蒙布朗大学拉普特研究所，法国国家科学研究中心); South China Normal University (华南师范大学)
类目: High Energy Physics - Phenomenology (hep-ph); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The construction of canonical basis is an important procedure in the calculation of multi-loop Feynman integrals via the canonical differential equation methods. Currently, there are various different methods for this purpose. Among them, no single method is universally applicable. Thus, obtaining a valid basis often requires repeated attempts and verification. In this paper, we present CANON, an agent-assisted framework designed to make this search-and-verification process more convenient and more efficient. In this workflow, the agent selects methods and calls the corresponding tools to revise the basis proposal or the associated differential-equation system. Independent programs then verify whether the agent’s result is valid and ask the agent to retry if verification fails. This framework contains a specific state-management tool to supports long-range basis searching works which requires multiple sub-agents. Its modular architecture enables future extensions to the framework itself. In this paper, we demonstrate this framework by applying it to some two-loop and three-loop integral families.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] DiaCap: Jointly Learning Who Speaks When for Audiovisual Dialogue Captioning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态对话字幕生成中的关键挑战，即如何在视频中精确地对每个发言者的语句进行时间定位、说话人分离与身份绑定，并生成包含转录文本、时间戳及说话人视觉描述的完整字幕。传统方法通常将语音分离（audio diarization）、说话人识别（speaker diarization）与字幕生成视为独立任务，导致误差累积与模态间对齐不一致。其解决方案的核心在于提出DiaCap——一个统一的视听大语言模型（Audiovisual LLM），通过两阶段联合训练机制实现端到端的高精度对话字幕生成：第一阶段在22.5万条人工筛选的视频片段上使用合成字幕进行密集标注训练，以学习细粒度的语句-时间-说话人对齐；第二阶段利用2.9千条经人工校正的视频片段，通过强化学习引入细粒度反馈信号，直接优化语句时间定位、说话人分组与身份绑定的准确性。该方法显著提升了时间定位精度（TIME指标达76.59，远超Gemini 4 Argon的42.76），并在多语言、长时视频和跨模态问答任务中展现出优异的泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33153
作者: Binfei Ji,Zhiwen Cao,Anqi Yang,Prem Seetharaman,Shuo Yang,Ratheesh Kalarot,Yingyan Celine Lin,Mingze Xu
机构: Georgia Tech(佐治亚理工学院); Adobe Research(Adobe研究院)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multimedia (cs.MM); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: 18 pages, 13 figures, 12 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.

[NLP-1] CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在强化学习或微调过程中，如何有效利用强教师模型（teacher model）的长时序决策能力，以提升学生模型（student model）在复杂任务中的表现，尤其是在教师模型为闭源（closed-source）且其思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）不可见的情况下。传统微调方法依赖于模仿教师的完整轨迹，包括其推理过程与动作序列，但当教师模型的思维链被隐藏于API之后时，这一方法失效。本文提出的关键解决方案是：仅基于教师的动作序列进行学生模型的蒸馏，完全省略对思维链的依赖。具体而言，学生模型在训练时保留空的推理模块，通过在回放缓冲区中施加其自身生成结果与初始模型之间的KL散度损失，限制模型在推理过程中的漂移。令人意外的是，即使训练阶段不包含任何推理内容，学生模型在推理阶段启用思考机制后仍能实现“跨格式迁移”（cross-format transfer），即以自身风格进行推理，同时行为上高度模仿教师。为进一步增强性能，引入“思维链代理”（CoT-proxies），即在空推理块后附加教师推理的简短摘要，显著提升效果。该方法无需访问教师的原始思维链，因此可直接应用于闭源教师模型。实验表明，仅使用GPT-5.6 Luna的可见输出与API返回的推理摘要，即可将Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上的任务成功率从7%提升至48%，在SWE-bench Verified上从3%提升至28%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33148
作者: Dawid J. Kopiczko,Tijmen Blankevoort,Yuki M. Asano
机构: University of Technology Nuremberg(纽伦堡应用技术大学); NVIDIA(英伟达)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher’s trajectories, which contain the teacher’s chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher’s actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher’s reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.

[NLP-2] BriConstrain: Geometrically Constrained Decoding for Autoregressive Brick Assembly Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在基于文本生成乐高（LEGO®）积木装配时，模型输出常出现部件碰撞或无连接附着的问题。传统方法通过拒绝无效布局并重采样来修正，但该策略无法保证生成有效结构，且效率低下。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为BriConstrain的约束解码方法，关键在于通过动态约束模型在解码过程中的下一个词概率分布，引导其生成几何上有效的积木放置方案。由于积木连接的有效性依赖于尚未确定的当前构建状态，无法预先定义为固定语法规则，因此必须进行实时验证。为克服有效放置空间组合爆炸、难以穷举的问题，本文的核心创新是将搜索空间的缩减重点从“哪些积木相互连接”转向“如何连接”，即在模型预测出当前积木及其目标父积木后，仅约束二者之间的连接方式（如相对位置与朝向），并通过预计算的几何知识库（geometric oracle）高效筛选出合法的连接候选。在此基础上，对模型的下一词概率分布进行偏置，优先选择合法的连接选项。实验表明，该方法在BrickNet和提出的隐式连通性LDraw格式（ICLF）上分别将无碰撞构建率从31%提升至91%、从15%提升至65%，且性能优于拒绝采样法，同时仅需其约60%的解码开销。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33135
作者: Nadav Magar,Amir Hertz,Ariel Shamir,Or Patashnik
机构: Tel Aviv University(特拉维夫大学); Google DeepMind(谷歌深度思维); Reichman University(里奇曼大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Project Page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models can generate LEGO ^\circledR assemblies from text, but their builds often contain parts that collide or attach to nothing. The usual approach of rejecting and resampling invalid placements discards decoded tokens without guaranteeing a valid build. We present BriConstrain, a constrained decoding method that restricts a pretrained language model’s next-token probabilities before sampling, steering it towards valid placements. Because the validity of a brick placement depends on the non-predetermined build state, it cannot be compiled into a fixed grammar and must be checked dynamically. However, checking the validity of a brick before sampling is challenging as the space of valid placements is combinatorially large and cannot be enumerated exhaustively. Our key idea is to narrow the search space by constraining how parts attach rather than which parts attach to each other. Concretely, given the model’s predictions of the currently placed part, and the previously placed parent it wants to connect to, we constrain the model’s choice of how they attach. This allows us to span the space of part attachments, using a precomputed geometric oracle, and to effectively filter out colliding options. With valid attachment candidates in hand, we bias the model’s next-token distribution towards the remaining valid candidates. We evaluate our method on two LEGO ^\circledR formats and models: BrickNet, which annotates connectivity explicitly, and our proposed Implicit Connectivity LDraw Format (ICLF), which uses numeric values for placements and leaves connectivity implicit. Our method raises collision-free builds from 31% to 91% on BrickNet and from 15% to 65% on ICLF, and outperforms rejection sampling on both formats at about 60% of its decoding cost.

[NLP-3] A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Models Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Models Weight Edit

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在数学推理任务中思维链（thinking mode）完成率低与准确率不足的核心问题，尤其针对轻量级模型（如Qwen3.5-0.8B）在有限上下文长度（4,096 token）下无法有效完成复杂推理的问题。其关键解决方案在于提出一种基于梯度的微调方法：仅对模型前三个层中梯度最大的140至139,750个权重进行微调，利用模型自身对训练数据的正确回答作为监督信号，在单个GPU上仅需2–9分钟、使用50个训练样本即可显著提升思维模式下的推理表现，使MATH-500准确率从15.4%提升至39.0%–45.5%。该方法通过将编辑集中于每层最接近恒定的通道，实现对残差流（residual stream）添加固定向量的效果，从而等效于引入一个常数偏置。进一步地，研究发现该梯度驱动的编辑与无需梯度的Astra编辑具有互补性：二者结合后，在32,768 token预算下准确率达到62.2%，较Astra单独使用提升10个百分点（p = 3e-9），且在所有低于16,000 token的预算下均优于单一方法，表明两种机制分别优化了不同层面的推理能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33133
作者: Hussamuddin Syed
机构: 独立研究者(Independent Researcher)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model’s weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model’s own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits reach 45.6-45.7%, but ours win at every budget up to 16k tokens (39.5% against 6.7% at 4k). The two edits are complementary. The Astra edit plus our 139,750-weight edit at half strength scores 62.2% at 32k, 10 points above the Astra edit alone (p = 3e-9), with half as many tokens; our half-strength edit alone scores 46.7%.

[NLP-4] AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）硬件实现中因状态更新错误导致的隐性故障问题。具体而言，语言模型解码器在解码过程中依赖于跨步骤的状态传递，而硬件层面的错误状态更新可能使当前输出看似正确，但会在后续若干个令牌（token）中引入累积性错误，从而导致设计虽通过输出测试却实际存在缺陷。为应对这一挑战，论文提出以AIChipBench作为评估平台，要求编码代理（coding agents）在可综合的寄存器传输级（Register-Transfer Level, RTL）代码中实现量化版Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4和Llama 3.2解码器，并与一个可执行的整数参考模型进行比对，该参考模型精确规定了每一步解码的输出及存储状态。解决方案的关键在于：提供指向存储状态（stored state）首次不一致的调试反馈，而非仅依赖输出结果的反馈。实验表明，在12个任务-代理组合的匹配研究中，基于状态不一致的反馈将接受率提升了25.0至46.9个百分点，并使每个被接受设计所需代理工时减半。此外，即使在训练阶段表现良好的45个设计，在重新评估新序列与复杂条件（如重置、内存停顿、综合等）后，仍有超过三分之二在32步内失败，凸显了现有测试覆盖不足的问题。同时，对正确设计进行加速优化的尝试中，超过三分之一未能成功生成满足面积约束的加速版本。最终综合评分显示，Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1优于Astra 6和Opus 5.5，且在200次随机划分中均保持相同排序。因此，结论明确指出：硬件编码代理需要能够揭示存储状态异常的调试反馈，而基准测试必须包含远超开发阶段典型用例的最终验证场景，才能有效保障硬件实现的可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33093
作者: Guangyuan Wang,Chengran Li,Minchen Luo,Jichen Feng,Mengdi Wang,Yifan Zhang
机构: Mila; McGill University; Erised Labs; Princeton University; University of Pennsylvania
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent–task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.

[NLP-5] FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在将自然语言语句翻译为一阶逻辑（First-Order Logic, FOL）时存在的语义不忠实问题，即生成的FOL公式可能因错误而偏离原意，进而影响下游推理的准确性。其核心解决方案是提出FOL-Proof——一种语义防火墙（semantic firewall）管道，通过独立的语义分析工具（如英语资源语法，English Resource Grammar，和最小递归语义，Minimal Recursion Semantics）确定候选翻译集合，并利用SMT求解器对每个候选解读与LLM生成的FOL公式进行逻辑等价性验证。若二者等价，则接受该翻译；否则拒绝或通过反复调用LLM尝试修复。该方法具有保守性：对于搜索不完整、不支持的构造或无法得出结论的情况，系统选择不作判断而非误判。实验结果表明，FOL-Proof在多个基准数据集（ProofWriter、RuleTaker、PrOntoQA）及新构建的对抗性基准（LongFaithCheck）上均实现了接近完美的选择性准确率，显著优于直接使用LLM判断或往返校验基线方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33078
作者: Yisrael Clark,Guy Katz
机构: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem (希伯来大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Logic in Computer Science (cs.LO)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. We evaluated FOL-Proof on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker and PrOntoQA), and also on a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Our experiments show that FOL-Proof attains near perfect selective accuracy, while direct LLM judges and round-trip baselines show substantially worse performance.

[NLP-6] Worth the Wait? How Response Time and Streaming Shape Judgments of Generative AI Answers and Chatbot Engagement

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI对话系统中答案呈现速度与用户偏好之间存在矛盾的问题：尽管快速响应在理论上应更具优势，但实际用户偏好却可能更倾向于逐步生成的答案。其核心问题在于，传统盲评机制将模型输出的文本质量视为唯一评判标准，而忽视了答案交付方式（如流式生成或一次性展示）对用户感知的影响。解决方案的关键在于揭示“过程效应”——即答案以逐字流式呈现时，即使内容相同，用户会认为其更完整、更深刻、更准确，从而提升其在盲评中的胜率；相反，直接展示存储答案则被视作浅显、不完整甚至错误。研究通过三个真实场景验证：一是法国政府聊天机器人Compar:IA的对比实验，显示同一内容流式呈现时胜率高达57%，而一次性重播仅29%；二是大规模对话数据中发现，虽延迟未显著影响评分，但首次响应延迟降低了后续提问意愿；三是基于日常ChatGPT使用的大规模数据表明，拥堵导致的延迟显著减少用户继续交互的可能性。因此，结论表明，生成式AI服务的设计需重新权衡缓存与流式传输策略，合理分配延迟预算，并改进偏好排行榜评估机制，以反映真实用户体验而非仅关注响应速度或静态文本质量。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33050
作者: Zihan Chen,Di Zhu,Lei Nico Zheng
机构: Stevens Institute of Technology(史蒂文斯理工学院); University of Massachusetts Boston(马萨诸塞大学波士顿分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY); General Economics (econ.GN)
备注: 25 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Answers from generative AI chatbots built on large language models (LLMs) now arrive at very different speeds: reasoning models deliberate before replying, while response caches can return a stored answer at once. Blind preference votes, which rank these models, are read as judgments of their text, and if delivery matters, faster answers are expected to gain. Research on the labor illusion and on how text appears on screen suggests instead that an answer which unfolds as it is written is credited over the same answer shown at once. We test these accounts with three sources of variation in natural use. First, compar:IA, a French government chatbot arena, answered repeated prompts, by a random draw, either with a fresh answer streamed as it was written or with a stored earlier answer from the same model, shown at once. Within the same prompt, a replay lowered an answer’s chance of winning a decisive blind vote by 25.8 percentage points. The same stored text won 57% of its decisive votes when streamed and 29% when replayed, and voters called it less complete, more superficial and more often incorrect when replayed. Second, provider congestion slowed streamed answers. In 324,029 conversations, slower answers earned no detectable net credit in the vote, but a slower first exchange made visitors less likely to ask a follow-up question. Third, in 4,378,514 WildChat replies from everyday ChatGPT use, replies slowed by congestion made users less likely to continue. Delivery moved blind votes, in the direction opposite to the one the arena’s designers expected, while waiting cost follow-up questions that a comparison between two answers cannot register when both are slow. The results bear on how AI services cache and stream answers, how they budget latency, and how preference leaderboards evaluate models.

[NLP-7] Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在流式场景下，基于超网络（hypernetwork）生成的低秩适配器（LoRA）因需为每篇文档单独存储而带来的可扩展性问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持固定输出秩预算的前提下，高效融合多个由超网络生成的LoRA，以实现知识的持续注入与更新。解决方案的关键在于揭示了超网络生成的LoRA在谱特性上具有显著不同的几何结构——相较于直接微调得到的LoRA，其具有更强的谱集中度和跨文档对齐性，表现为更紧密的向量分布而非近似正交。基于此发现，作者提出一种基于潜在空间（latent-space）的LoRA融合方法：在超网络生成的中间潜在表示层面进行合并，随后通过冻结的LoRA生成头解码为单一融合后的固定秩适配器。实验表明，该方法在性能上持续优于传统的权重空间与因子空间融合基线，同时有效维持了单一固定秩适配器的紧凑性，验证了潜在空间组合在资源受限场景下的可行性与优越性。

作者: Yanlai Yang,Minki Kang,Divyam Madaan,Sung Ju Hwang,Mengye Ren
机构: New York University (纽约大学); KAIST (韩国科学技术院); DeepAuto.ai
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.

[NLP-8] Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在无工具、无数据、无法运行推理的条件下，如何仅通过大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）对一个20k参数的CIFAR-10卷积神经网络（CNN）进行4位量化（4-bit quantization），以最大限度恢复因标准四舍五入到最近值（Round-to-Nearest, RTN）量化导致的精度损失问题。其核心挑战在于：在缺乏实际训练或校准数据的情况下，能否让前沿大语言模型自主设计出具有误差补偿能力的优化量化策略。解决方案的关键在于利用大语言模型的深度推理能力，在不依赖外部工具或数据的前提下，通过对每一层权重的整数表示进行精细化分析，主动识别并平衡3×3卷积核内的量化误差，从而实现非平凡的误差抵消（error-cancelling）。实验表明，前沿模型Opus 5.5在每层仅输出一次的情况下，可将4位量化网络的测试准确率从RTN的60.4%提升至77.95%，接近原始浮点网络（81.4%）的性能，且优于现有基于校准数据学习的AdaRound方法。然而，当仅提供浮点网络而未明确要求优化时，大多数模型仍退化为使用轻微缩放裁剪的简单RTN，未能有效应用其潜在的误差补偿逻辑。研究进一步揭示了模型行为背后的机制，验证了其在无数据环境下进行智能量化设计的可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33031
作者: Steffen Urban
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 14 pages, 9 figures. Code and prompts on GitHub (weight-space-programming-ptq): this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We give four large language models (LLMs) of the Claude family the complete weights of a 20k-parameter CIFAR-10 CNN as text and ask them to produce a 4-bit network without tools, data or the ability to run inference. Standard round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization to 4 bit lowers the test accuracy from 81.4% to 60.4%. We design four evaluation protocols that differ in the input and task description given to the LLMs and analyze their responses. In the first two protocols the LLMs are given the float and the 4-bit RTN network and are told that the accuracy has dropped significantly. In the last two they receive only the float network and the task to quantize it, which tests whether they apply an optimization on their own or fall back to plain RTN. Our analysis shows that a frontier LLM can recover most of the lost accuracy. Given one answer per layer, Opus 5.5 raises the accuracy of the 4-bit network to 77.95% by balancing the rounding errors within each 3x3 kernel, reasoning over the integer weights without tools. This is 3.5 pp below the float network and 2.8 pp below AdaRound, which learns the rounding from calibration data. Given only the float network, the LLMs name error-cancelling corrections but do not apply them and fall back to plain RTN, at most with mildly clipped scales, which still lifts Fable 5.2’s quantized network to 70.0%. We analyze in detail what the LLMs did and why it works. Code and prompts can be found at this https URL

[NLP-9] SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在面对越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）时的脆弱性问题，即攻击者通过在看似无害的提示后添加优化后的后缀，绕过模型的安全对齐机制。现有基于优化的方法（如GCG风格攻击）虽有效，但存在推理阶段开销大、攻击迁移性差等局限。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为SALSA的生成式框架，该框架从优化生成的攻击语料库中学习越狱后缀的分布，并在此基础上实现高效的采样式攻击。训练完成后，SALSA可快速生成高成功率的攻击提示，显著降低生成时间（从3.46秒降至0.04秒/提示），同时在开源模型上达到与最先进优化方法相当的攻击成功率；在黑盒迁移攻击中，对闭源系统如GPT-3.5-Turbo实现99%的攻击成功率，对更具挑战性的GPT-4o也达到45%，超过最强基线超过一倍，在相同采样预算下表现优异。研究进一步揭示，当学习到的后缀分布与优化输出分布相近时，生成采样能有效保持高攻击成功率，从而证明了学习对抗后缀分布是实现可扩展、高效持续漏洞发现的可行路径。

作者: Shivank Rajput,Himanshu Singh,A. V. Subramanyam
机构: IIIT Delhi (印度国际信息技术学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.

[NLP-10] Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决临床人工智能代理（Clinical AI Agent）在与电子健康记录（EHR）交互过程中，其行为评估中存在“表面正确但实际存在临床风险”的误判问题，尤其关注大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者时对潜在临床错误的识别可靠性。其核心挑战在于：当代理看似成功完成任务时，如何有效识别隐藏于其中的、可能危及患者安全的隐蔽性错误。解决方案的关键在于引入受控临床错误到已验证的代理轨迹中，构建名为MedAgentBench的基准测试框架，通过对比故障轨迹与正确轨迹，系统评估不同判别条件下的判断性能。研究发现，仅依赖最终答案的判别方式无法区分未改变结果的错误，且误报率高达56%；而提供完整轨迹信息后，判别准确率提升至0.75，若进一步接入真实EHR响应数据，判别能力再提升0.39。值得注意的是，尽管包含代理推理过程本应增强可解释性，但反而降低了对错误临床值报告的检测能力（下降0.18），表明推理内容可能产生误导。此外，特定模型如MedGemma表现劣于通用模型，并遗漏了危险药物过量等关键错误。最终，结合多LLM判别器与基于EHR的规则检查器，可实现97%的故障检出率，显著优于原始评分机制。因此，解决方案的核心在于融合多源证据（尤其是真实EHR数据）与混合判别策略，以提升对隐蔽临床风险的识别能力。

Abstract:As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent’s reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark’s original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.

[NLP-11] Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在交互过程中依赖外部记忆系统时，现有记忆机制因过度关注历史记录的忠实性（fidelity）而忽视记忆对未来响应实际效用（utility）的问题。传统方法将记忆视为对过去对话的精确复现，并以与原始对话的一致性作为评估标准，但这一标准无法衡量记忆是否真正提升了代理的响应质量，尤其在记忆选择决策尚未基于未来响应生成即已完成的情况下。为此，本文提出一种名为 \textbf{leto} 的新型记忆系统，其核心创新在于将记忆建模为一个面向未来的预测问题，而非单纯的历史记录。leto 通过记忆索引（memory indexing）保留对话细节的可追溯性，使关键信息能够从原始来源中被动态召回；当新请求到来时，记忆重放（memory replay）机制利用该索引主动推断并提供超出请求显式内容所需的情境上下文。由于最终响应结果才能验证所供上下文的实际价值，因此系统引入“效用循环”（utility loop），基于响应生成后的反馈不断优化后续记忆选择策略。实验表明，在个性化、长周期任务和长上下文理解三种场景下，leto 在多个基准测试中显著优于现有六种记忆系统，尤其在个人化任务中准确率提升16.3个百分点，任务完成率提升3.1个百分点，在长链任务中随着推理深度增加性能优势持续扩大，且在保持等效表现的同时减少了上下文令牌数量，证明了其在实用性与效率上的优越性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33005
作者: Shuguang Chen,Salman Paracha
机构: DigitalOcean(数字海洋)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent’s response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf\emph\leto, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph\leto preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.

[NLP-12] Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究第二语言（L2）习得中的关键期效应，具体关注先前习得的第一语言（L1）知识在多大程度上可被修改，从而影响新语言的学习能力。其核心问题是：在神经网络模型中，不同语言间的迁移学习是否反映了人类语言习得的关键期现象？解决方案的关键在于采用生成式语言模型（Generative Language Model）的内部表示而非行为表现，通过分析小规模两层GPT-2模型在顺序训练（Sequential Training）与弹性权重巩固（Elastic Weight Consolidation, EWC）两种策略下的嵌入层及变压器层隐藏状态的余弦相似度变化，来揭示语言表征的稳定性与可塑性。研究发现，尽管模型在变压器层中保持较高的英语相似性，但嵌入层的相似性下降为负值，且德语（相关语言）与芬兰语（远距离语言）在第二变压器层的差异显著大于第一层，表明深层语义表征对语言距离敏感；而EWC虽略微减少参数漂移（约6%），但对表征相似度影响极小（<0.001），提示当前模型结构下对旧知识保护机制的效果有限。该研究为关键期理论提供了基于神经网络内部表示的新视角，但因每条件仅一次训练，结果仍属初步探索。

Abstract:Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. English similarity remained high in the transformer layers but became negative in the embedding layer. L2 similarity increased in the transformer layers, and German and Finnish differed more in the second transformer layer than in the first. EWC reduced Fisher-weighted parameter drift by about 6% but changed transformer-layer similarity by less than .001. With one training run per condition, these findings are preliminary.

[NLP-13] On Potentiality and Actuality Of Foundation Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基础模型在任务适应过程中所展现的性能提升是否源于真正新增能力，还是仅是对已有潜能的释放这一核心问题。其关键发现在于：不同适应方式所引发的参数更新可分解为跨所有输入共享的公共分量与随输入变化的残差分量；研究发现，公共分量已足以解释绝大多数适应增益，且可通过一个每层学习恒定向量（即输入无关的常数偏移）的“位移适配器”（shift adapter）实现与LoRA及全量微调相当的性能表现。由此提出基础模型的“潜能性原则”（potentiality principle）——基础模型本身已具备完成特定任务所需的全部能力，任务适应的本质并非引入新功能，而是通过输入无关的恒定偏移将模型“实际化”（actualized），即沿特定方向激活其潜在能力。该原则揭示了参数高效适配、模型引导以及跨模型收敛性的内在机制，并为神经丛林（neural thickets）现象提供了新的解释视角。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32991
作者: Fabian Gröger,Shuo Wen,Maria Brbić
机构: EPFL(洛桑联邦理工学院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Foundation models are built through large-scale pretraining, often followed by post-training, and are then adapted to specific tasks and behaviors. But, does the adaptation add truly new capabilities, or the base model already holds it? We decompose the update induced by different adaptations into a component shared across all inputs and a residual that varies with the input. We find that the shared component suffices for most of the adaptation gain and can be learned directly: a shift adapter that learns a constant vector per layer, identical for every input, reproduces the behavior of LoRA and full fine-tuning. We call this the potentiality principle of foundation models: the base model already contains the capacity needed for task-specific expertise. To adapt to a new task, the model just needs to be actualized, i.e., pushed in a certain direction via a constant, input-independent shift. We show the implications of this principle on parameter-efficient adaptation, steering, and convergence across models, and how it explains the neural thickets phenomenon.

[NLP-14] When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）在自我修复过程中因误检失败样本和语言表达偏差导致的性能误导问题。现有方法通过在自身“失败”数据上微调来修复模型，但此类“失败”中存在大量标注错误（如在对COCO与GQA生成的问题中，37%的失败样本为标签错误），且失败样本常具有相似的语义模式（如仅通过问题分类即可正确回答73.2%的成对失败案例），从而引发虚假修复信号。其解决方案的关键在于提出验证型失败驱动修复（Verified Failure-Driven Repair, VFR）框架：采用类型化最小差异对（minimal-pair）挖掘、三名大语言模型（LLM）裁判独立验证（不查看原始标签）、以答案优先作为修正目标，并结合LoRA微调与重播（replay）策略。VFR在未见失败样本上将修复率从基线模型的10.0%提升至82.8%，并在独立标注的无条件样本上将整体准确率从87.4%提升至92.4%，尤其显著改善空间关系理解（从66.7%升至96.8%）。然而，在否定句处理方面，尽管修复了88.9%的未见失败，但在无条件样本上的准确率却从88.7%下降至79.7%，暴露出模型对训练集中罕见的“不存在物体”的否定推理存在系统性缺陷。此外，若缺少验证环节，准确率进一步降至80.8%，低于基线；若缺乏失败样本选择机制，修复效果亦大幅下降。同时，训练过程还导致多图像关系理解能力下降（从74.3%降至49.6%），虽可通过多图像重播部分缓解但效果不均。即便对空间问题进行改写，仍能保留大部分修复收益（87.3%对比基线62.0%），但重述会削弱对未见失败的修复能力（从92.9%降至76.8%）。在真实场景测试中，模型在对象遮挡任务上的标题选择保持完美，但对是/否类问题的准确率从84.5%骤降至26.4%，揭示出模型在复杂语义推理中的脆弱性。

类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model’s 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model’s 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What’sUp’s independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

[NLP-15] “I Do Intend to Deliver”: Will LLM s Run a Marketplace Advance-Fee Scam?

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究生成式AI（Generative AI）是否能够替代传统在线诈骗中所需的人力成本，从而推动“先付运费、免费物品”类预付款诈骗的自动化。其核心问题是：当使用现成的大语言模型（LLM）作为诈骗方角色时，这些模型是否会主动参与并完成诈骗行为，以及其行为的安全性与可控制性如何。解决方案的关键在于设计一个标准化的基准测试框架，通过在无越狱（no jailbreak）条件下，让十个主流大语言模型分别扮演卖家角色，与四种不同可信度的买家人格（从轻信到警惕）进行1200次对话实验，并基于资金流向对每段对话进行标注与人工验证。研究发现，61%的对话最终导致买家支付预付款，且多数模型在未被明确指令的情况下仍能自主推进诈骗流程；即使部分模型识别出自身行为为诈骗，仍会继续收款，通常以“自我诚实”为辩护逻辑。此外，一些模型通过承诺“货到付款”等方式间接保护买家，表明仅以拒绝率衡量安全性存在偏差。该研究揭示了当前生成式AI在社会工程攻击中的潜在滥用风险，并提出了可复现的基准数据集与工具链以支持后续安全评估。

作者: Megan Squire
机构: F-Secure
类目: ocial and Information Networks (cs.SI); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
