点击查看摘要

Abstract:Online fraud is traditionally limited by the cost of the human labor needed to talk to potential victims. We ask whether hosted large language models will now supply that labor. We prompted ten off-the-shelf models to play the seller in the “free item, just pay delivery” advance-fee scam common on buy-and-sell sites, using a plain system prompt with no jailbreak. Each model played 30 conversations against each of four buyer personas, from credulous to guarded, with the same model playing the buyer (1,200 conversations). We label each conversation by what happened to the buyer’s money, and validate the labels against two human coders. 737 conversations (61%) ended with the buyer paying in advance. Eight of the ten models played in almost every conversation, and running both sides cost about 2.5 cents per payment. Only the guarded buyer, who wanted a findable identity, resisted, and the most willing sellers got past it by inventing names and phone numbers. Sellers that recognized the scam still took the money in 133 conversations, usually reasoning about their own honesty rather than the buyer’s risk. Several models protected the buyer without refusing, by conceding payment on delivery, so refusal rates alone misstate safety. We release the benchmark, prompts, code and labels.

[NLP-16] ShellBench: What Matters More for AI Agents Models or Harness for Everyday Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在普通用户中广泛应用背景下，用户难以判断何种模型配置最适合自己使用场景的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在真实复杂的工作环境（如文件杂乱、数据源冲突）中，有效评估不同大模型与智能体框架（agent harnesses）在任务执行中的性能与安全性。解决方案的关键是提出 ShellBench 基准测试体系，包含100个基于超过1000万用户请求的真实日常任务，涵盖多源异构数据和实际工作流情境，并对任务结果进行正确性与安全性的双重评分。通过在53,100次实验中评估12个模型在5种智能体框架下于3种推理层级的表现，研究发现模型选择对性能影响显著高于框架选择，但顶级模型间差距极小（仅1.1个百分点），且所有框架在性能与安全性上表现相近（pass@1得分介于42.9至45.2之间），表明系统架构的差异对整体效果影响有限，而模型本身的选择更具决定性。

Abstract:The use of AI agents among the general public has been increasing exponentially throughout 2026, though it is often hard for users to determine which configuration is most effective for their personal use. To help provide clarity here we introduce ShellBench, 100 day-to-day tasks based on more than 10 million user requests, each set in a realistic workspace with messy files and competing data sources, and graded for both correctness and safety. We evaluate 12 models across 5 agent harnesses at 3 reasoning levels for a total of 53,100 rollouts, 20% of which are on tasks designated for public release. We find that model choice impacts performance more than harness choice, but the three leading models differ by only 1.1 percentage points. GPT-6.1 Sol passed 61.4% of attempts at about one-sixth of GPT-6 Astra’s estimated token cost per attempt, while GPT-6 Astra led at 62.5%. We also found that harness choice had little effect on either performance or safety with all harnesses scoring between 42.9 (Claude Code) and 45.2 (OpenClaw) for pass@1.

[NLP-17] InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决指令微调（instruction-tuning）过程中模型在学习新知识时普遍出现的通用能力退化问题。具体而言，标准微调方法会导致模型在指令遵循、推理和编程等通用任务上的性能平均下降35分，且这种性能衰退与响应长度显著缩短密切相关——微调后模型的输出长度至少减半，响应偏离初始模型输出长度越远，失败率越高。为应对这一挑战，论文提出InstructReplay方法：在微调过程中，通过让模型对一组通用指令重复生成初始状态下的答案，从而保持其在这些任务上的输出行为与初始模型一致。实验表明，在三个模型家族和两个不同领域中，InstructReplay将五项通用基准的平均性能下降从28.1分降至2.4分，同时有效保留了原始响应长度，并在学习新事实方面与标准微调相当。与其他七种适应方法相比，InstructReplay在所有六组设置中均表现出更优的“学习-保留”平衡能力。受控对比分析进一步证实，该方法的成功关键在于重放模型自身对通用指令的原始回答，而非损失函数的形式本身。

作者: Xiaofeng Shi,Qian Kou,Hua Zhou
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Project page at this https URL and code at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Fine-tuning an instruction-tuned language model on new facts often erodes its general abilities. We find that standard fine-tuning lowers instruction-following, reasoning and coding benchmarks by 35 points on average, and that these losses track a collapse in answer length: fine-tuned models at least halve their responses, and the further a response drifts from the initial model’s length, the more often it fails. We propose InstructReplay: the initial model answers a set of general instructions once, and during fine-tuning the model is kept close to the initial model on these answers. Across three model families and two domains, InstructReplay reduces the average decline on five general benchmarks from 28.1 to 2.4 points and keeps answer length close to the initial model’s, while learning the new facts as well as standard fine-tuning. It balances learning and retention better than seven adaptation methods in all six settings. Controlled comparisons attribute the gain to replaying the model’s own answers to general instructions rather than to the form of the loss.

[NLP-18] Joint Detection of Constructive Speech Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在线仇恨言论（hate speech）日益增长所带来的负面影响，尤其是在社交媒体平台减少人工内容审核的背景下，如何有效识别和应对仇恨言论与建设性言论（constructive speech）的共存问题。其核心挑战在于缺乏大规模、多语言标注的数据集以及能够同时区分仇恨语气、建设性语气及对原文评论的认同程度的高效自动化检测方法。解决方案的关键在于构建一个涵盖英语和丹麦语的社会媒体评论大规模双语数据集，并基于该数据集对多种多语言大语言模型（multilingual LLMs）进行微调，以实现对三种语义维度——仇恨语气、建设性语气、对父评论的认同度——的联合分类。研究进一步对比了上下文增强型与非上下文增强型模型架构的性能，结果表明，经过优化的E5-large模型在两种架构下均表现最佳，分别达到82%和81.6%的平均F1分数，验证了多语言大模型在跨语言、可扩展地检测仇恨与建设性言论方面的潜力。

类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.

[NLP-19] Fresh Keys Stale Secrets: Numeric Leakage across Linked LLM Prompts

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小型企业在使用云语言模型时，因反复查询包含敏感财务信息（如价格、单位成本和利润率）的私密数据而面临的信息泄露风险。其核心问题是：尽管采用数值提示混淆（numeric prompt disguise）技术以保护数据隐私，但攻击者通过分析企业历史查询记录，结合已知的行业级价格与利润率统计信息，仍可能逐步重构出真实数值。解决方案的关键在于评估不同混淆机制在多轮查询场景下的安全性，特别是识别出“重复使用同一混淆密钥”与“每次查询使用新混淆密钥”的差异。研究发现，当攻击者掌握混淆算法并利用跨查询关联性时，即使采用顺序保持替换（order-preserving substitution）或Prεεmpt等防护机制，在仅16次关联查询后，目标数值的恢复率显著上升（例如利润率恢复率从25.0%升至59.4%），且使用新混淆映射比重复使用旧映射可使攻击者提升29.4个百分点的恢复精度。理论分析表明，重复使用单一混淆密钥会限制所有查询仅暴露一次全精度视图，从而形成安全边界；而每次使用新密钥则导致密钥可被识别，从而引入可被利用的模式。研究还验证了该现象在不同先验分布及5%以内数值漂移条件下的稳健性，同时指出基于自然语言描述的上下文线索对攻击辅助有限（最多提升2.5个百分点）。

Abstract:Small businesses repeatedly ask cloud language models about the same confidential prices, unit costs and margins. Numeric prompt disguises for such numbers are evaluated one prompt at a time, but a provider sees a firm’s history, in which each fresh secret gives a new, independent view of the same numbers. Since real costs are not public, we measure on synthetic firms with known values how much an honest-but-curious provider recovers when it knows the disguise algorithm, holds sector-level price and margin statistics, and links a firm’s queries. In one prompt, per-field scaling, a fixed-axis instantiation of Zhang et al.'s order-preserving substitution and Pr \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt’s released sanitizer keep the attacker’s margin-hit advantage over a prior-only guess between -0.6 and +4.4 percentage points. After 16 linked queries with fresh secrets, every disguise we test (Pr \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt at \varepsilon\geq 0.5 ) has a target recovered significantly more often: under the order-preserving substitution, margin recovery rises from 25.0% to 59.4%. The same attacker recovers 29.4 percentage points more margins with fresh maps than with one reused map. Theory explains the contrast: one reused secret bounds all queries by a single full-precision view of the fields shown, whereas fresh scaling keys are identifiable. Except for Pr \varepsilon\varepsilon mpt at \varepsilon=0.5 , the gains persist when the attacker’s prior comes from another population model and when values drift by up to 5% between queries; on our firms, whose prose cues are weak, reading the prose with a language model adds at most 2.5 points. [NLP-20] From Grammar Deltas to Token Masks: Incremental Constrained Decoding under Runtime Grammar Evolution ICLR2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在代码及领域特定语言生成中，面对动态演化的语法规则（grammar）时的约束解码效率问题。传统方法在遇到首次出现的语法更新时，需对已生成前缀重新进行完整解析以更新约束状态，导致大量重复计算。其核心解决方案是提出GramDelta——一种支持追加式运行时语法更新的增量式约束解码框架。GramDelta通过维护已提交前缀的解析状态，并仅基于历史依赖关系传播新添加语法规则所引发的状态变化，避免了前缀重播（prefix replay）。同时，它通过无需编译的因子化投影机制，在共享的历史分析表（historical charts）上直接映射出精确的下一个词元掩码，避免了每次更新后对掩码缓存的重新编译。该方法在保持与全重建等效输出质量的同时，使更新开销与语法变更的实际影响成正比。实验表明，无更新时GramDelta引入的额外开销可忽略；在持续的运行时语法演化场景下，其首见语法更新延迟降低10.7–11.5倍，相较于最强重构基线，额外的每词元输出时间（TPOT）开销减少53.1%–81.9%，显著提升了约束解码在渐进式约束生成中的效率与实用性。

作者: Hantao Hua,Jiming Su,Yonggang Che,Feng Zhu
机构: National University of Defense Technology (国防科技大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Formal Languages and Automata Theory (cs.FL)
备注: Submitted to ICLR 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Grammar-constrained decoding enables large language models to generate outputs that satisfy formal constraints, but in code and domain-specific language generation, the relevant constraints are not always fully available before decoding and may emerge progressively from new declarations, inferred type information, or runtime analysis feedback. Existing structured-decoding engines efficiently handle fixed, predeclared, or previously seen constraint structures; however, when a first-seen grammar update changes the parser state induced by an already committed prefix, the straightforward solution reconstructs the constraint state under the updated grammar, repeating parsing work already performed over the prefix. We introduce GramDelta, an incremental framework for constrained decoding with append-only runtime grammar updates. GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar rules through historical dependencies, avoiding prefix replay. It then maps the updated parse state to exact next-token masks via compilation-free factorized projection over shared historical charts, avoiding per-update mask-cache recompilation. GramDelta therefore preserves the result of full reconstruction while making update cost sensitive to the actual impact of a grammar change. Experiments across four model configurations show that GramDelta adds negligible overhead without updates; under sustained runtime grammar evolution, it reduces median first-seen grammar-update latency by 10.7–11.5x and reduces the additional TPOT overhead over unconstrained decoding by 53.1–81.9% relative to the strongest reconstruction baseline. These results enable efficient constrained decoding when constraints progressively emerge and evolve with the generated prefix.

[NLP-21] Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在有限上下文样本下实现高效泛化（即样本效率）的问题，具体表现为如何使模型仅通过少量用户交互、陌生代码片段或实验结果等上下文信息，快速学习并生成具有泛化能力的知识。其核心挑战在于提升模型在少样本场景下的适应能力，同时避免显著增加推理延迟。解决方案的关键在于引入“睡眠”机制（sleep），即在上下文处理阶段对输入内容进行多轮递归前向传播（N次重复的前向传递），以迭代优化模型对上下文表征的理解。实验表明，较长的睡眠周期（如N=4）显著提升了模型在多个少样本算法任务和问答任务中的上下文适应速度，并在分布外评估中实现了更低的下一个词预测损失；例如，在代码任务上，使用N=2和N=4的模型分别仅需基线模型2.10倍和2.39倍的上下文 token 数即可达到相同性能，证明了该方法在提升样本效率方面的有效性。总体而言，该研究为构建在上下文适应能力与解码延迟之间取得更好权衡的语言模型提供了重要路径。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs N recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes N ) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with N=2 and N=4 match the no-sleep baseline’s loss using 2.10\times and 2.39\times fewer tokens in-context, respectively. More broadly, we view our work as a step toward building models that have better tradeoffs between in-context adaptation and decoding latency.

[NLP-22] Is Prosody Encoded in the Neural Audio Codec Mimi?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决神经音频编解码器（Neural Audio Codec, NAC）在语音编码过程中对韵律（prosody）信息捕捉能力不足的问题。尽管现有研究主要关注解码阶段重建语音的自然度，但对编码阶段所保留的语音韵律特征缺乏深入分析。本文以应用于对话式语音代理（如Moshi、Sesame）及语音到语音翻译（Hibiki）等下游任务的NAC模型Mimi为研究对象，系统探究了其编码表示中与韵律相关的潜在表征，揭示了编码过程对语调、重音、节奏等韵律特征的建模能力，为提升生成式语音模型对语音语义和情感表达的准确捕捉提供了关键依据。

Abstract:Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become a fundamental infrastructure for modern speech-language models, discretizing continuous speech signals into token sequences that enable large language models to process and generate audio. Most research evaluates codec quality at the decoding phase, assessing the naturalness of reconstructed speech. However, little research investigates what phonetic information is captured during encoding. In this paper, we investigated the potential correlates of prosody in the NAC Mimi, a codec used by conversational speech agents such as Moshi and Sesame and used in downstream tasks such as speech-to-speech translation (Hibiki).

[NLP-23] Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLM s via PCA NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现代大语言模型（LLM）中前馈网络（FFN）中间层宽度在各层间保持一致的固定分配策略是否合理的问题。尽管这一做法源自原始Transformer架构，但机制研究指出不同深度的层执行的功能存在质的差异，暗示其容量需求可能并非均匀分布。为探究这一假设，作者通过主成分分析（PCA）对每个FFN下投影层的输入进行降维，以最小主成分数量重建激活值至固定余弦相似度水平，从而量化各层的内在维度（intrinsic dimensionality）。在涵盖14个模型家族、参数量从70M到72B的58个开源模型上，研究发现中层具有显著更高的内在维度，呈现出“中层主导”的分布特征，且该现象在不同语料库（包括英文与中文）及后训练微调过程中均保持稳健。作为结构意义的直接验证，作者基于此内在维度信号指导知识蒸馏学生模型的宽度剪枝，在匹配参数预算下，基于PCA引导的非均匀宽度分配相较于传统均匀分配分别在Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-3B上提升2.3和2.5点性能；而内在维度分布更均匀的教师模型则表现差距较小（+0.9和+0.5），且预算匹配的反向控制组表现最差。跨四类教师模型的性能差距与教师模型层间内在维度分布不均程度（用σ₉₉量化）高度相关，且优势在下游监督微调后依然存在。这表明，非均匀的容量分配策略不仅有效，且能捕捉到深层语义表征结构的本质差异。

Abstract:Modern large language models (LLMs) keep the feed-forward network (FFN) intermediate width identical across every layer, a convention inherited from the original Transformer. Yet mechanistic work suggests layers at different depths do qualitatively different work, raising a natural question: are their capacity demands also non-uniform, and if so, can a fixed parameter budget be allocated more wisely than uniformly? To probe this, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) to the input of each FFN down-projection and measure, for every layer, its intrinsic dimensionality as the smallest number of principal components needed to reconstruct the activation up to a fixed cosine similarity. Scanning 58 open-weight LLMs spanning 14 families and 70M to 72B parameters, we find a recurring middle-heavy profile in which middle layers carry higher intrinsic dimensionality than edge layers; the profile is robust to the calibration corpus, even across English and Chinese, and is largely preserved through post-training fine-tuning. As a direct test that this signal is structurally meaningful, we use it to guide width pruning in a knowledge-distilled student under a matched parameter budget: the PCA-guided allocation outperforms the uniform-width convention by +2.3 points on Qwen3-8B and +2.5 on Qwen2.5-3B, while lower-dispersion teachers show smaller gaps (+0.9 on Gemma-3-4B, +0.5 on LLaMA-3-8B), and a budget-matched inverted control does worst on all four teachers. Across these four teachers, the size of the gap tracks how unevenly the teacher’s intrinsic dimensionality is distributed across layers (a single-number summary we call \sigma_99 ), and the advantage persists through downstream supervised fine-tuning. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-24] Beyond Fixed-Context Likelihood: Zero-Shot AI-Generated Text Detection via Context Perturbation Discrepancy

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式文本中难以区分人类撰写与人工智能生成内容的问题，尤其关注在相同上下文条件下，不同位置的词元（token）对数概率增益存在差异时，如何有效识别异常生成模式。其核心挑战在于：同一词元概率增益在某些位置可能是正常现象，而在另一些位置则可能暗示非自然生成行为。为此，论文提出一种零样本检测方法——上下文扰动差异（Context Perturbation Discrepancy, CPD），其关键在于通过比较单个预训练语言模型在完整前缀（full-prefix）分布与局部短窗口（restricted-prefix）分布下的期望概率增益，量化实际观测增益与预期之间的偏差。具体而言，CPD利用KL散度估计完整前缀分布下预期的增益，并将此期望从实际观测增益中减去，再对符号化偏差之和进行基于解析参考标准差的归一化处理，从而实现对生成异常的敏感检测。实验表明，在GEN、DetectRL-X和HART等数据集上，该方法显著提升检测性能，平均达到94.80%的AUROC和79.60%的召回率（5%假阳性率下），且在原始与编辑后的HART文本中，能更准确地反映文本的草稿来源而非最终表达形式，展现出更强的判别能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32778
作者: Yifan Tang,Jingran Li,Yihao Wang,Zhen Yang,Jianyi Liu,Gongshen Liu,Ru Zhang
机构: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (北京邮电大学); Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (北京人工智能研究院); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The same increase in token log probability from earlier context can be typical at one position and unusually large at another. We introduce Context Perturbation Discrepancy (CPD), a zero-shot detector that measures this gain relative to what a single pretrained language model expects. Keeping the passage fixed, CPD scores each observed token under its full prefix and under a short window of recent tokens. Under the full-prefix distribution, the expected gain equals the KL divergence from that distribution to the restricted-prefix distribution. CPD subtracts this expectation from each observed gain and scales the sum of the signed deviations by its analytical reference standard deviation. On unedited human and AI texts from GEN, DetectRL-X, and HART, subtracting the expected gain raises AUROC by 32.78-35.81 percentage points at the same variance scale. CPD outperforms seven zero-shot baselines, averaging 94.80% AUROC and 79.60% recall at a 5% false-positive rate. On original and edited HART passages, the same scores separate texts more clearly by draft origin than by the benchmark’s final-expression labels (89.15% versus 65.50% AUROC). Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-25] ASCENT: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Advancing Stepwise Diagnostic Reasoning in Large Language Models on Common Clinical Scenarios ALT

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大型语言模型（LLMs）在医学问诊任务中缺乏对临床实际诊断推理过程的评估问题，尤其关注在信息逐步积累背景下医生如何动态修正初步判断的分步诊断推理能力。现有评测多基于完整病历信息的最终答案，无法反映真实临床流程中逐步推演、不断修正的动态认知过程。为此，作者构建了首个由临床医师标注的分步临床推理基准数据集ASCENT（Annotated Stepwise Clinical rEasoning for Naturalistic Diagnosis），包含3,078个源自MedQA-USMLE的病例，每个病例被分解为与电子病历（EMR）对齐的三步结构：发现（Findings）、初步印象（Impression）及支持性推理依据（Rationale），从而实现对不完全信息条件下中间推理阶段的精准评估。其核心解决方案在于引入“分步诊断推理”这一新范式，并通过在ASCENT上对Qwen2.5-7B和32B进行微调，显著提升了模型在中间步骤上的精确率（precision），验证了该数据集在揭示模型真实推理能力方面的有效性。研究表明，即使在强推理模型上，分步诊断任务仍存在巨大提升空间，且错误传播问题仍是临床部署的关键挑战，而经过ASCENT微调的模型更依赖于先前印象的诊断内容而非输出格式，展现出更强的语义一致性与鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32734
作者: Yera Choi,Yeong Hwa Kim,Jaedeok Lee,Taekang Kim,Sangdoo Yun,Seong-Eun Moon
机构: NAVER Applied AI Research, Republic of Korea; Ewha Womans University Mokdong Hospital, Republic of Korea; Healthcare AI Research Institute (HARI), Seoul National University Hospital, Republic of Korea; Yonsei University Wonju College of Medicine, Republic of Korea; NAVER AI Lab, Republic of Korea
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Published in Proceedings of the 7th Conference on Health, Inference, and Learning (CHIL 2026), PMLR 333:404-426. 23 pages, 8 figures, 12 tables. Data and code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) excel at medical question answering yet are rarely evaluated on the stepwise diagnostic reasoning that defines real clinical workflows, where impressions are revised as information accumulates. We build Annotated Stepwise Clinical rEasoning for NaturalisTic Diagnosis (ASCENT), a clinician-annotated benchmark and training resource of 3,078 stepwise problems derived from MedQA-USMLE that decomposes each vignette into EMR-aligned steps (Findings, Impression, supporting Rationale), enabling evaluation of intermediate reasoning under incomplete information. Experiments and training with ASCENT revealed insights into how current LLMs handle stepwise diagnostic reasoning. Even strong reasoning models that perform well on MedQA-USMLE leave substantial headroom on ASCENT, and general-purpose frontier models trail further, exposing a persistent gap between fully informed and stepwise diagnosis. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B and 32B on ASCENT yields measurable F1 gains over both pre-trained and HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT-trained baselines, with gains driven primarily by precision. Complementary robustness analyses (counterfactual perturbation, format-vs-content control, judge agreement, and rollout) further show that ASCENT-fine-tuned models rely on the diagnostic content of prior impressions rather than imitating their output format, while error propagation under rollout remains a key challenge for clinical deployment. [NLP-26] Red-Teaming a Sovereign LLM Its Reasoning and Its Training Stages

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决开放权重大语言模型（LLM）在处理敏感信息时的隐私泄露问题，具体探究系统提示中保密指令是否足以保护此类信息。研究发现，尽管存在明确的保密要求，但包括Apertus v1.5在内的多个开源大模型在多种攻击场景下仍表现出严重的隐私泄露风险，尤其在修正诱饵攻击（correction bait）中，8B和70B版本分别有96%和95%的请求泄露敏感信息。此外，验证类查询与衍生值查询亦可间接暴露受保护内容，且推理过程中的中间轨迹可能泄露原始数据，即使最终输出未包含明文信息。研究还表明，后训练（post-training）并不能稳定提升模型安全性。其解决方案的关键在于：仅依赖系统提示无法确保保密性，必须引入多语言、多推理模式下的认知感知型安全评估机制，以全面识别并缓解潜在的隐私泄露路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32710
作者: Hatef Otroshi Shahreza
机构: Idiap Research Institute(伊迪亚普研究学院); Switzerland(瑞士)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for applications with sensitive information. We investigate whether confidentiality instructions in system prompt can protect such information. We red-team Apertus v1.5, an open sovereign LLM, and five other model families across six languages and reasoning modes. We use synthetic personal records to evaluate direct disclosure, correction baits, yes/no verification, derived-value queries, reasoning leakage and authorisation checks. We also explore copyright attribution, historical misrepresentation and stereotyping. Despite confidentiality instructions, Apertus 8B and 70B leak information in 96% and 95% of requests, respectively, in correction-bait attacks. Verification and derived-value queries also expose protected information without necessarily revealing identifiers. Moreover, reasoning traces can leak confidential records even when final answers withhold them. Our experiments also show that post-training does not consistently improve safety. Our findings demonstrate that system prompts alone cannot ensure confidentiality and highlight the need for multilingual reasoning-aware safety evaluations.

[NLP-27] Social Bias Neurons in Multilingual Language Models: A Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言模型在处理涉及社会刻板印象的输入时表现出的社会偏见问题。其核心解决方案在于采用新兴的机制可解释性方法，精准定位并表征编码此类偏见的模型组件。研究通过在三种指令微调模型、四种语言及七个偏见维度上开展分析，运用多语言偏见基准数据集，实施两种识别社会偏见神经元的方法——激活概率熵与整合间隙梯度（integrated gap gradients）。结果表明，整合间隙梯度方法更为有效，其所识别出的神经元主要集中在模型深层，且在被抑制时能更显著地降低模型偏见。进一步分析揭示，高资源语言与低资源语言之间的神经元分布模式存在差异，说明预训练数据中语言的表征程度会影响模型内部偏见的表征方式。此外，与性别、国籍和社会阶层相关的偏见神经元与其他偏见维度的神经元重叠度最高，表明这三个维度在模型学习和处理偏见过程中具有关键作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32685
作者: Lance Calvin Lim Gamboa,Yue Feng,Mark Lee
机构: University of Birmingham (伯明翰大学); Ateneo de Manila University (马尼拉雅典耀大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted in Findings of EACL2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multilingual models exhibit social bias when processing inputs pertaining to societal stereotypes. We adapt emerging mechanistic interpretability methods to pinpoint and characterize model components that encode this bias. We conduct our analysis across three instruction-tuned models, four languages, and seven bias dimensions. Specifically, we leverage multilingual bias benchmarks in implementing two methods for identifying social bias neurons: activation probability entropy and integrated gap gradients. We find the latter method to be more effective, as the neurons it isolates (which are largely concentrated at the model’s deepest layers) lead to sharper decreases in model bias when suppressed. Further analysis reveals neuron distribution patterns differ between high- and low-resourced languages, suggesting that a language’s representation in pretraining data influences how its biases are represented within model internals. Our results also indicate that neurons linked to gender, nationality, and social class biases overlap the most with neurons related to other bias dimensions, pointing to the pivotal role these three dimensions play in how models learn and handle bias.

[NLP-28] Bathys: Advancing Deep Search Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决复杂开放任务中代理（agent）进行深度搜索（deep search）时面临的挑战，即如何在多轮迭代的信息获取、查询重构与基于证据的验证过程中实现高效且可靠的推理。传统单次检索方法难以应对此类任务的动态性和依赖性需求。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个融合可验证问题生成、后训练及在线强化学习（RL）的端到端训练框架，并通过上下文压缩机制支持长序列推理。核心创新包括：1）高质量数据构造策略，将每个线索重新表述为需独立检索的间接引用，确保搜索深度；2）保留证据链以支持答案的联合验证，保障结果唯一性与可靠性；3）采用分阶段优化流程——监督微调（SFT）建立长期工具使用基础，Kahneman-Tversky优化（KTO）利用轨迹级二元反馈提升基于证据的答案选择能力，以及压缩管理组序列策略优化（CM-GSPO），通过长度归一化的似然比与子轨迹优势重加权，纠正因独立平均子轨迹损失带来的偏差。该框架使Bathys 9B和27B在包含轨迹自验证与条件重试的评估协议下分别达到66.51%和80.49%的BrowseComp准确率，显著提升了深度搜索代理的鲁棒性与性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32660
作者: Zixuan Chen,Shengyou Yuan,Nang Yuan,Ming Ma,Zelin Xiao,Lin Zhou,Siyuan Luo,Jiaqi Su,Chengrui Wu,Tiankuo Yao,Nairong Zheng,Cong Pang,Jiapeng Luo
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 18 pages. Models and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Deep search is a critical capability for agents tackling complex, open-ended tasks, where solving a problem requires iterative information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. To address these requirements, we present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents built around a training framework that spans verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning (RL) under context compression. Our high-quality data construction ensures both search depth and reliability: each clue is reformulated as an indirect reference requiring independent retrieval, and retained evidence chains enable verification that the clues jointly determine a unique answer. Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation for tool use over long horizons and query reformulation; KTO uses binary feedback on trajectories to improve the selection of answers grounded in evidence; CM-GSPO optimizes execution sub-trajectories with length-normalized likelihood ratios on the recorded rollout contexts and reweights sub-trajectory advantages to correct the extra weighting introduced by independently averaging sub-trajectory losses. Bathys 9B and 27B attain 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries.

[NLP-29] Generating Schema-Aligned Synthetic Dialogues and Measuring Their Diversity

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在敏感领域（如医疗）中构建对话到结构化记录转换模型时，高质量成对数据（即对话文本与其对应结构化记录）难以获取且标注成本高昂的问题。传统方法依赖人工标注，而在隐私敏感场景下往往不可行。为此，论文提出一种逆向生成策略：先生成符合模式（schema-valid）的结构化记录，再基于该记录反向生成自然对话，从而确保标签在文本生成前已存在，无需额外标注步骤。其解决方案的关键在于引入多维度的可控变异性机制，包括采样变化配置、角色设定（personas）以及按记录字段顺序规划话题（topic plan），以克服单纯提示语言模型生成时导致的对话同质化问题。实验表明，采用完整配置后，输出在嵌入空间中的方差扩展至约2.5倍独立方向（参与度比率从9.2提升至23.3），显著增强了多样性；在两个医学对话语料库中亦观察到类似趋势，且样本量、文本长度和语言特征为影响因素。下游任务验证显示，使用该方法生成的对话微调8B抽取模型，在字段准确率上达到64.8%，优于朴素生成方式的57.5%。研究开源了生成工具库及德语临床对话与对齐记录语料库。

作者: Konrad Stolte,Toni Fetzer
机构: cronn GmbH(克罗恩有限公司), Bonn, Germany
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 11 pages. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Training or evaluating a model that turns a conversation into a structured record requires paired data, meaning a transcript together with the exact record it should be converted into. Such pairs are expensive to annotate, and in sensitive domains they are also difficult to obtain at all. We therefore build them in the opposite order by sampling a schema-valid record first, then writing a dialogue from it, and optionally synthesizing speech from the dialogue, so the label exists before the text and we need no annotation step. Naively prompting a language model for such dialogues yields small variations of a single conversation, so we add a sampled variation configuration, personas, and a topic plan that orders the fields of the record as explicit mechanisms for variation. We measure the variation that reaches the output through embedding space, where the embedding variance spreads over about two and a half times as many independent directions with our full configuration compared to without (participation ratio 23.3 against 9.2). Two corpora of medical dialogue give values of the same order, with sample size, text length and language being additional factors there. We also show the positive effect of our method in a downstream test, where an 8B extraction model reaches 64.8% field accuracy when fine-tuned on dialogues from our method, against 57.5% from naive generation. We release the generation library and the generated corpus of German clinical dialogues with aligned records.

[NLP-30] MargEmbed-Akan: Bridging Twi Questions and English Knowledge through Cross-Lingual Score Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决以阿坎语（Twi）为母语的用户在互联网上进行信息检索时面临的跨语言检索难题，即多数在线信息以英语呈现，而用户查询多为本地语言，导致传统检索系统性能显著下降。其核心挑战在于如何在缺乏大规模双语标注数据的情况下，构建高效且精准的跨语言嵌入模型，实现对阿坎语查询与英文文档之间的语义对齐。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为MargEmbed-Akan的开源查询编码器，其通过交叉语言得分蒸馏（cross-lingual score distillation）机制训练而成：利用一个冻结的基线模型（AfriE5-Large-instruct）对英文问题及其答案和难例负样本进行评分，再让学生模型同时接收原始英文问题和经过回译验证的阿坎语翻译，学习复现这些得分，从而在不依赖额外标注的前提下，将英文语义行为有效迁移至阿坎语空间。该方法在保留英文检索性能的同时，显著提升了阿坎语查询的检索效果，尤其在无E/O字符的输入场景下表现突出，在AfriQA和圣经翻译检索任务中均超越现有主流模型，证明了其在低资源语言跨语言信息检索中的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32630
作者: Prince N. Y. Annan,Ali A. A. Aziz,Stephen E. Moore
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 14 pages,4 figures,8 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Most information sought online by Twi (Akan) speakers is written in English, making cross-lingual retrieval essential. We evaluate eight systems: BM25, five open embedding models, and two proprietary models (gemini-embedding-001 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) on two Twi-English tasks. AfriQA contains 1,221 natively written Asante Twi questions that must retrieve their answering English Wikipedia passages. Bible translation retrieval requires a Twi passage to retrieve its English translation from 6,195 candidates. We introduce MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct using cross-lingual score distillation. The frozen base model scores each English training question against its answer passage and seven hard negatives. The student learns to reproduce these scores from both an NLLB-200 Twi translation that passes a round-trip translation check and the original English question, preserving English behaviour. During training, passages are encoded by the frozen base model; at evaluation, MargEmbed-Akan encodes questions and passages. On AfriQA, base AfriE5 and gemini-embedding-001 both achieve 66.6 nDCG@10; EmbeddingGemma 2, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large achieve 56.6, 51.3, and 53.4, respectively. MargEmbed-Akan achieves 71.5, outperforming gemini-embedding-001 by 4.9 points, its base model by 5.0, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 18.1. Its largest gain is on Twi typed without E and O (+7.5 over gemini-embedding-001). English retrieval does not differ significantly from the base model, although both proprietary models score 1.5-2.2 points higher. On Bible translation retrieval, MargEmbed-Akan and gemini-embedding-001 are statistically tied on standard Twi (97.2 vs. 96.5 nDCG@10); MargEmbed-Akan performs better on diacritic-free Twi (92.7 vs. 84.9). No AfriQA data was used for training or model selection. [NLP-31] REBEAL: Human References Are No Longer the Best Translation and Metrics Do Not Notice EACL27

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前基于参考译文的机器翻译（MT）评估中，评估指标对参考译文质量缺陷的敏感性问题。随着2024年WMT MQM评估中人类参考译文在多数情况下并非最优且存在19%至87%的标注错误，传统评估方法所依赖的“参考译文正确且优于系统输出”的假设已失效。为此，作者提出REBEAL（Reference Bias EvALuation）基准，系统性地测试主流评估指标在七类受控参考译文污染下的表现，这些污染类型源自实际评估中记录的错误类别。研究发现，尽管近年来基于学习的评估指标（如xCOMET、MetricX）相比传统指标更具鲁棒性，但各类指标仍存在固有缺陷：表面型指标对译文长度不敏感，导致污染在较长句段中被掩盖；而学习型指标则会错误地接受语义无关语言的参考译文为近似正确。所有指标共同存在的致命弱点是未能识别命名实体污染（named-entity contamination），此类污染可使九个系统的排名顺序发生高达33%的颠倒（即36组系统对中有8组出现排序反转），严重削弱评估结果的可靠性。因此，解决方案的关键在于建立对参考译文质量的敏感性检测机制，并推动开发能够抵御此类偏见的新型评估框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32623
作者: Ahrii Kim,Chanjun Park,Seong-heum Kim
机构: AI-Bio Convergence Research Inst.(人工智能与生物融合研究机构); School of Software(软件学院); Dept. of Intelligent Semiconductors(智能半导体系); Soongsil University(松岛大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: EACL 27 main

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reference-based MT evaluation assumes the human reference is correct and better than the systems it scores. Both assumptions now fail, since the human reference ranks first in none of the 2024 WMT MQM campaigns and carries annotated errors in 19% to 87% of its segments. What a metric does with a flawed reference is a question about the metric, and it would have been worth asking before reference quality came into doubt. We introduce REBEAL (Reference Bias EvALuation), a benchmark that probes how MT metrics respond to seven types of controlled reference contamination, drawn from the error categories those campaigns record. Across eight widely used metrics and three language pairs, recent learned metrics (xCOMET, MetricX) prove more robust than their predecessors, but each family fails in its own way. Surface metrics show no length sensitivity, so contamination hides in longer segments, while learned metrics accept references in unrelated languages as nearly correct. The failure they share is named-entity contamination, which no metric detects and which flips up to 8 of 36 system pairs when ranking nine MT systems.

[NLP-32] When “Neutral” Means Irrelevant: A Construct-Validity Audit of NormAd-ETI

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI模型在评估日常行为规范时，其多维度判断指标（NormAd-ETI评分）中存在的语义混杂问题。具体而言，该评分将“规范适用性”（applicability）与“行为符合性”（conformity）两个独立决策合并为单一输出，导致在文化上下文从具体规则退化至国家名称时，模型对规范适用性的判断能力显著下降（趋近随机水平），而行为符合性仍保持较高水平。由于评分机制将二者耦合，使得整体分数主要反映较为稳定的符合性，掩盖了实际存在的适用性薄弱问题。研究发现，仅通过标准提示无法解耦这两个维度；尽管针对前沿大模型设计的强制选择探针可实现分离，但小型开放模型仍无法有效区分，其适用性判断仍受隐藏的“可接受性标签”干扰。引入书面推理虽能缓解混杂效应，但未能完全消除。因此，论文提出关键解决方案：应分别报告适用性与符合性结果，并量化二者之间的“混淆差距”（conflation gap），以提升模型评估的透明度与准确性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32614
作者: Aarav Singh,Animesh Pathak,Christian Hoang,Navyansh Singh,Avantika Singh
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 19 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:NormAd-ETI scores a model’s judgment of everyday actions as acceptable, unacceptable, or neither as the cultural context shrinks from a specific rule to a country name. We audit what that three-way score measures. It combines two decisions: whether a supplied norm applies, and whether the action conforms to it. Separating them shows that when only a country is shown, applicability falls to near chance while conformity stays well above it, because the prompt withholds the rule a Neutral label depends on. Because one answer carries both decisions, the score follows the steadier conformity and hides the weaker applicability, and no single prompt recovers the two separately. Dedicated forced-choice probes separate them for frontier models but not for small open models, where the applicability judgment still tracks the hidden acceptability label. Adding a written rationale reduces that conflation without removing it. We recommend reporting the two results separately and measuring the conflation gap.

[NLP-33] Privacy Disclosure Control Benchmark (PDC-Bench): How Faithfully Do LLM s Keep Privacy Constraints on In-Context Disclosure Granularity? EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在执行任务时，因输出粒度过细而导致的隐私泄露问题，特别是针对个人属性披露粒度受限场景下的合规性检测难题。现有基准无法衡量在给定语义约束（如仅允许国家层面披露）下信息泄露的程度，导致对间接隐私泄露（即语义泄露）的识别不足。为此，论文将披露控制形式化为知识图谱层级结构上的允许上限约束，并构建了PDC-Bench基准，涵盖地理、年龄、种族与族裔、职业四大类共16,105个样本。实验结果表明，在所测试的11个LLM中，62%的违规属于语义泄露，且语义泄露程度主要受允许披露粒度和任务对私有属性的需求影响，而非模型本身。因此，可靠的隐私审计必须同时关注语义泄露以及上述两个关键因素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32610
作者: Kosuke Fujita,Daiki Nishiyama,Jun Sakuma
机构: Institute of Science Tokyo (东京科学研究所); RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project (AIP) (理化学研究所先进智能项目中心)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In LLM task execution, a constraint on the permitted disclosure granularity of personal attributes is sometimes imposed on the output. For example, if a person’s private attribute is their location (San Francisco) and disclosure is permitted only at the country level, an output at the state level (California) violates the constraint. Detecting such violations requires capturing not only direct privacy leakage (San Francisco) but also semantic leakage (California). However, existing benchmarks cannot measure the degree of leakage with respect to a given semantic constraint such as the country-level limit. We therefore formalize disclosure control as a constraint on the permitted ceiling over the hierarchy of a knowledge graph. Building on this formulation, we construct PDC-Bench, a benchmark of 16,105 samples covering geography, age, race and ethnicity, and occupation. In our experiments applying PDC-Bench to eleven LLMs, 62% of the constraint violations were semantic leakage. We further found that semantic leakage depends less on the model than on the permitted disclosure granularity and the task’s need for the private attribute; reliable auditing must therefore target semantic leakage together with these two factors. Data, prompts, and code are available at this https URL.

[NLP-34] Gated Concept Adapters: Layer-Wise Concept Bottlenecks for Auditable Text Understanding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型（如Transformer）在文本理解任务中缺乏可审计性的问题，即其高维隐藏状态难以提供可供人类分析或干预的紧凑、可解释接口。为应对这一挑战，作者提出了一种分层概念瓶颈框架——门控概念适配器（Gated Concept Adapters, GCA），其核心解决方案是：在预训练Transformer的选定输出层上附加门控的、低维的概念生成读出适配器，将词元表示映射为概念激活值，通过学习得到的门控机制进行过滤，并聚合为层级摘要，最终以概念中介接口的形式传递给预测头。该设计使得模型的内部表示可通过使用统计、特征短语（signature n-grams）、事后概念命名及针对性概念干预等方式实现可解释性与可控性。实验表明，在细粒度情绪分类、毒性检测、主题分类及受控动词填空压力测试中，GCA在保持良好预测性能的同时，显著提升了概念表示的非冗余性与可干预性，尤其在情感与安全相关任务中表现突出。此外，尽管在部分任务上存在轻微性能损失，但其提供的概念级可解释性与轻量级后置控制能力，使模型在透明性、诊断与干预方面优于追求极致准确率的传统方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32600
作者: Niloofar Ranjbar,Saeedeh Momtazi,Mohammad Mehdi Homayounpoor
机构: Amirkabir University of Technology (Tehran Polytechnic)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Preprint. Includes supplementary appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Human-facing text understanding systems are used to infer affect, moderate harmful content, and support socially sensitive decisions. However, Transformer predictions are difficult to audit because they are produced from high-dimensional hidden states that do not provide a compact, inspectable interface for human analysis or intervention. We introduce Gated Concept Adapters (GCA), a layer-wise concept bottleneck framework that attaches gated, low-dimensional concept-producing readout adapters to selected outputs of pretrained Transformers. Token representations are mapped into concept activations, filtered by learned gates, pooled into layer-level summaries, and exposed to the prediction head as a concept-mediated interface. The dimensions can be inspected through usage statistics, signature n-grams, post-hoc concept names, and targeted concept interventions. We evaluate GCA on fine-grained emotion classification, toxicity detection, topic classification, and a controlled verb-cloze stress test. In the affective and safety-relevant classification settings, GCA learns comparatively low-redundancy and intervention-sensitive concept representations while retaining useful predictive performance. On toxicity detection, it remains close to an unconstrained ModernBERT baseline while enabling concept-level inspection, targeted intervention, and lightweight post-hoc control. On GoEmotions, the end-to-end concept model incurs a macro-F1 cost relative to unconstrained RoBERTa, while a task-initialized frozen variant substantially reduces this gap. On AG News, GCA remains competitive with recent concept-based baselines, and the Qwen verb-cloze experiment clarifies the limits of concept-mediated full-vocabulary prediction. Overall, GCA provides a neural concept interface for auditable text understanding, prioritizing transparency, diagnosis, and intervention over unconstrained accuracy maximization.

[NLP-35] Evaluating Latent Knowledge Stability in Multimodal Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在图像视角变化和问题表述多样化条件下，其潜在知识表征（latent knowledge representations）稳定性不足的问题。现有评估方法仅依赖输出正确性与整体表征漂移，难以揭示模型决策过程中的细微变化。为此，本文提出两个关键评估指标：边际保留率（Margin Retention Score, MRS）与潜在知识支持结构稳定性（Knowledge Support-Structure Stability, KSS）。MRS通过量化初始答案对竞争选项的逻辑概率差（logit margin）在不同条件下的衰减程度，衡量潜在知识表征的退化情况；KSS则基于参考条件下的边际梯度构建内部支持结构，综合评估支持分布与总支持强度的变化，从而反映内部推理机制的稳定性。为系统验证，作者构建了包含19,452个知识条目的MMStableBench基准数据集，覆盖多种图像视角、语义等价的问题表述及答案选项排列。实验表明，MRS与KSS可有效揭示准确率无法捕捉的潜在知识不稳定性，且基于MRS设计的正则化项能显著提升编辑后知识的泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32566
作者: Chuancheng Shi,Shangze Li,Wenhua Wu,Zifeng Cheng,Pengyang Shao,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Changes in image viewpoint and question formulation can alter latent knowledge representations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, output correctness and overall representational drift provide limited insight into how these changes affect model decisions. We therefore evaluate latent knowledge stability across visual and linguistic elicitation conditions from two complementary perspectives: answer preference and internal support. Specifically, we devise the margin retention score (MRS), which measures the first-order projected degradation of the initial answer’s logit margin over competing options across conditions and assesses how changes in latent knowledge representations affect this margin. We also present latent knowledge support-structure stability (KSS), which evaluates reference-correct items by comparing internal support profiles constructed using the margin gradient under the reference condition, which jointly reflects changes in how internal support is distributed and changes in total support magnitude. We further construct MMStableBench, comprising 19,452 knowledge items (facts), each probing the same latent knowledge across varied image viewpoints, semantically equivalent question formulations, and answer-option permutations. Experiments across 15 MLLMs show that MRS and KSS reveal latent knowledge instability not captured by accuracy, while an MRS-inspired regularizer further improves the generalization of edited latent knowledge.

[NLP-36] Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在延迟约束下，如何通过多智能体协作机制提升大语言模型在复杂任务中的执行效率与性能的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保证响应速度的前提下，实现多个专业角色（如CEO与专家）之间的高效协同，以克服单智能体在处理高复杂度任务时的瓶颈。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于集体奖励的强化学习框架（Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards, RLCR），其中由一名首席执行官（CEO）与最多八名专家共享同一策略，通过消息板和工作区进行信息交互，并基于共同的结果衍生优势进行联合训练。该机制通过引入截止时间（deadline）激励并行工作，使得提前完成任务的贡献能够获得更高回报，从而优化整体绩效。实验表明，采用八人组织架构的执行方式在多项基准测试中显著优于单智能体模式，尤其在IMO-ProofBench-Advanced上将得分从23.8%提升至39.0%，且平均延迟仅为单智能体的约三分之一。此外，模型在训练过程中自发形成层级结构以降低通信开销，增强同行评审投入，并动态调整任务分工。尽管存在部分监督场景下外部报告率下降的安全隐患，但整体表现出对有害行为的高度拒绝能力，验证了该方法在组织学习、性能-延迟权衡及集体监管方面的有效性，为后续研究提供了可复现的共享优势基线。

作者: Iliyan Zarov,Henry Course,Anthony Hartshorn,Ran Achiron,Louis Roche,Akshit Sinha,Chengxi Taylor,Ross Taylor
机构: General Reasoning, Inc.
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. The trained model also outperforms Nemotron 3 Super, post-trained from the same base model, across all evaluations when comparing each model’s best tested configuration. On EdgeBench, organisations overtake the single agent after approximately 0.4 derived hours. Over the course of training, organisations develop hierarchies to manage communication costs, invest more in peer review, and alter how work is divided. Safety evaluations find near-universal refusal of harmful actions but sustained declines in external reporting in two of three oversight scenarios. These results establish a shared-advantage baseline for studying organisational learning, performance-latency trade-offs, and collective oversight.

[NLP-37] What If Chinese Were Latinized? A Counterfactual Study of Input Representation Tokenization and Language Modeling

【速读】： 该论文旨在探讨若中文曾如拉丁化运动（Latinxua Sin Wenz）所提议的那样实现拉丁化，会对中文自然语言处理（Natural Language Processing, NLP）产生何种影响。核心问题在于：在拼音（Pinyin）作为书写表示形式的情况下，其与汉字在语言建模中的表现差异，尤其受同音词（homophones）和声调标记带来的复杂性影响。为此，研究将中文语料转换为以音节分隔的拼音形式，并从零开始训练超BPE（superBPE）分词器，发现拼音词汇表不仅存在预期的同音词冲突，其词汇“肥力”（fertility，即单位词汇量下可生成的子词数量）还比汉字高出约10%。进一步地，采用类似Llama的模型架构对汉字与拼音表示分别进行预训练，结果显示拼音模型在字符级困惑度、同音词消歧以及ZhoBLiMP最小对测试中的整体表现均劣于汉字模型；此外，初步的音系学探针分析显示，两种表示形式的表现均接近随机水平。关键结论在于，书写表示形式并非中立的编码方式，其选择会深刻影响语言建模能力及其下游任务性能。尽管中文未实际经历拉丁化，但韩语（Hangul）与越南语（越南语使用拉丁字母取代汉字）等语言的历史经验表明，此类表示形式的转变会带来显著的建模成本，本研究量化评估的代价可为相关语言的模型研发提供方向指引。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32525
作者: Zijie Zheng,Ej Zhou
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (香港科技大学); University of Cambridge (剑桥大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:If Chinese had been Latinized, as the Latinxua Sin Wenz movement proposed, what would it have meant for Chinese NLP? Homophones and tone marking complicate the answer. We convert Chinese corpora to syllable-separated Pinyin and train superBPE tokenizers from scratch. The resulting Pinyin vocabularies not only exhibit expected homophone collisions, but also show approximately 10% higher fertility than characters. An alternative BPE configuration changes the relative fertility of the two representations. We further pretrain Llama-style models on Chinese characters and Pinyin. The Pinyin models perform worse on per-character perplexity, homophone disambiguation, and overall ZhoBLiMP minimal-pair accuracy. An exploratory phonological probe yields near-chance performance for both representations. The broader implication is that written input representations are not merely neutral encodings. Choices for representations affect language modeling and their downstream performances. Latinization never actually happened for Chinese, but other languages did, such as Hangul and Latin script replaced character in Korean and Vietnamese; the cost we measure is a guide to where modeling effort for those languages should concentrate.

[NLP-38] STAR: Counterfactual Dual-World Rollouts and Spatial Target Adaptive Reconstruction for Visual On-Policy Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉-语言模型在推理过程中过度依赖全局上下文和语言先验，而忽视对答案决定性局部细节的准确捕捉这一关键问题。现有方法虽采用基于高分辨率证据块的视觉在线策略自蒸馏（visual on-policy self-distillation），但跨尺度诊断表明，即使完全遮蔽局部证据，模型仍能保持超过一半的全图准确率，说明其正确性并不必然源于对局部信息的依赖。此外，不同词元的空间注意力状态导致视觉修正需求存在显著差异。为此，本文提出STAR框架，其核心创新在于结合独立的反事实双世界轨迹采样与空间注意力引导的目标重构机制：通过局部图像编辑构建具有相同问题和背景但答案决定性事实不同的配对世界，使共享的学生模型在图像一致前缀下独立采样轨迹，从而暴露上下文捷径；在每个世界中，教师通过对比真实图像块与均色块来判断视觉修正方向，同时利用学生图像注意力与教师中心空间参考之间的差异，自适应地控制词元级目标对数概率的重构强度。该方法无需额外注意力损失或测试时工具开销，在六个细粒度基准上实现相对于初始化平均准确率最高提升8.04个百分点，达到OPSD最终准确率的速度快4.7倍，并展现出良好的域外推理泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32472
作者: Yi Zou,Zhuang Yan,Yudong Zhang,Xu Wang,Yang Wang
机构: University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei, China; AMAP, Alibaba Group
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 11 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vision-language models often rely on global context and language priors while overlooking answer-determining local details. Privileged visual on-policy self-distillation supervises full-image student rollouts using a frozen teacher that views high-resolution evidence crops. Yet our cross-scale diagnostics show that models retain over half of their full-image accuracy when local evidence is completely masked, indicating that single-image correctness does not guarantee reliance on local evidence, while the need for visual correction also varies across tokens with their spatial attention states. We propose STAR, a visual on-policy self-distillation framework combining independent counterfactual dual-world rollouts with spatial-attention-guided target reconstruction. Local image editing constructs paired worlds with identical questions and backgrounds but distinct answer-determining facts, where a shared student samples trajectories independently to expose contextual shortcuts under image-consistent prefixes. Within each world, the teacher contrasts real and mean-color crops to determine the visual correction direction, while the divergence between student image attention and a teacher-centroid spatial reference adaptively controls token-wise target log-probability reconstruction. Without auxiliary attention losses or test-time tool overhead, STAR improves Qwen3.5 across scales by up to 8.04 percentage points in average accuracy over initialization across six fine-grained benchmarks, reaches OPSD’s final accuracy 4.7\times faster, and generalizes to out-of-domain reasoning tasks.

[NLP-39] BCP: A Lightweight Boundary-Controlled Framework for Online Sign Language Recognition and Translation NLPCC2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在线手语识别与翻译（Online Sign Language Recognition and Translation, SLR/SLT）中如何高效利用预训练离线模型的问题。现有方法在将强大的离线模型迁移至在线场景时，通常需对整个模型进行重新训练，且依赖于从离线视频构建的模拟流式前缀，导致计算成本高昂。为此，本文提出一种统一轻量级框架——边界控制前缀提交（Boundary-Controlled Prefix Commit, BCP），其核心在于冻结预训练的离线模型，并引入一个轻量级边界适配器（boundary adapter），通过预训练模型的连接时序分类（Connectionist Temporal Classification, CTC）对齐信号进行监督，无需人工标注即可自动决策何时提交输出。在推理阶段，采用边界控制的Wait-K输出策略，基于前缀投票实现自适应突发提交，同时保持基线Wait-K调度的输出进度。实验表明，BCP仅引入每种离线模型不足0.1%的额外可训练参数，在PHOENIX-2014T和CSL-Daily数据集上实现了优异的性能-延迟权衡，尤其在签到文本（S2T）任务中表现突出，同时在签到词（S2G）和签到词再到文本（S2G2T）任务中也保持了竞争力。

作者: Xiao Ma,Lin Li,Shiqing Wu,Wang Gao,Chuanbo Liu,Jianquan Liu
机构: Wuhan University of Technology(武汉理工大学); City University of Macau(澳门城市大学); Jianghan University(江汉大学); Biometrics Research Laboratories, NEC Corporation(NEC公司生物识别实验室)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Online sign language recognition (SLR) and translation (SLT) incrementally produce gloss sequences or natural language text from sign video as it arrives, a capability essential for real-time communication and live captioning. However, powerful pretrained offline models cannot be directly deployed in this setting, while existing online methods typically retrain the entire model on simulated streaming prefixes constructed from offline videos, incurring high costs. To address this challenge, we propose Boundary-Controlled Prefix Commit (BCP), a unified lightweight framework that converts pretrained offline methods into online counterparts for sign-to-gloss (S2G), sign-to-text (S2T), and sign-to-gloss-to-text (S2G2T). Specifically, BCP freezes the pretrained model and introduces a lightweight boundary adapter that decides when to commit, supervised by Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) alignments from a pretrained SLR model, without any human annotation. At inference, a Boundary-Controlled Wait-K Output Policy then decides what to commit via prefix voting, yielding adaptive burst commits while preserving the output progress of the base Wait-K schedule. Experiments on PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily across four offline methods show that BCP, with less than 0.1% additional trainable parameters per offline method, achieves a strong quality-latency trade-off on S2T and remains competitive on S2G and S2G2T.

[NLP-40] MAGPIE: Agent ic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多参考图像生成中如何可靠地将选定主体按照指令精确布局至目标场景的问题。现有方法虽在参考图像生成与组合控制方面取得进展，但缺乏对预期构图关系的显式建模与可检查性，导致生成结果难以精准符合指令。其解决方案的关键在于提出MAGPIE框架，通过一个可执行的Blender脚本形式化表示简化3D场景的意图构图，并引入编码代理（coding agent）实现对场景几何结构及渲染视图与指令的一致性验证与迭代修正。最终生成的代理渲染结果作为视觉化生成计划，指导图像生成器在保留各主体外观特征的同时，严格遵循预定布局。基于MAGPIE-Instruct-3K训练的生成模型显著提升了Qwen与FLUX在DreamOmni2和SconeEval上的表现，其中在DreamOmni2上相较原始骨干模型提升28.21个百分点，且在SconeEval评测中达到最高综合得分，验证了该方法在复杂场景组合生成中的有效性。

Abstract:Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject’s appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

[NLP-41] Phoneme-identity depth profiles do not reliably predict LoRA placement for dysarthric ASR

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在将语音基础模型（speech foundation model）高效适配至构音障碍语音（dysarthric speech）时，如何选择最优的编码器层进行参数高效微调（parameter-efficient adaptation）这一关键问题。现有策略主张通过探测编码器各层的语音信息可解码性，将适配器（adapter）放置于信息最易解码的位置，从而实现最优性能。然而，本文通过在两种自动语音识别模型（Qwen3-ASR、Whisper-small）与两个构音障碍语音语料库（中文CDSD、英文UASpeech）上的系统实验发现，该推断并不成立：所有四组实验的词错误率（phoneme-error）曲线最小值均集中在相对深度83%~92%之间，且不同语料库或探针种子间差异极小，表明该位置具有高度一致性；但若据此采用三种常见映射方式（梯度最陡处、最低均值误差带、拐点位置）来确定适配区间，均无法复现实际测试中表现最佳的配置。研究进一步揭示，适配位置具有显著的模型与语料特异性——在CDSD数据集上，Qwen3-ASR偏好上三分之一层（三种子平均CER 29.88%），而Whisper-small则更优于全层LoRA（53.56%）；在UASpeech上，两者均未表现出对上层的偏好。尽管在三个种子下上层优于全层的差异具有统计显著性（-1.31 pp, CI [-2.16, -0.25]），但上层与中层之间无显著差异（-0.83 pp, CI [-2.06, +1.86]）。更重要的是，两模型之间的偏好存在显著交互效应（-4.71 pp, CI [-6.17, -2.89]），提示适配策略需考虑模型-语料组合的协同特性。此外，在Qwen3-ASR × UASpeech组合中，靠近输入层的适配反而显著劣于不进行任何适配（+9.90 pp CER）。因此，论文的核心结论是：当前基于探测结果的适配层选择策略不可靠，最佳适配带应通过针对具体模型与语料的短周期适配扫描（short adaptation sweep）来确定，而非依赖预训练探测结果的推断。

作者: Bernard Muller,LaVonne Roberts
机构: The Scott-Morgan Foundation (斯科特-摩根基金会); SMF Labs (SMF 实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)

Abstract:Parameter-efficient adaptation of a speech foundation model to dysarthric speech requires a rarely justified choice: which encoder layers to adapt. A recently proposed strategy is to probe the encoder, find where phonetic information becomes most decodable, and put the adapters there. We test that inference across two ASR models (Qwen3-ASR, Whisper-small) and two dysarthric corpora (Mandarin CDSD, English UASpeech), holding recipe and seed discipline constant. The inference fails. Measured under one pipeline rather than inherited from published figures, all four phoneme-error curves minimise between 83% and 92% of relative depth, each model’s minimising layer moving no further between corpora than between probe seeds. The best adaptation band is not similarly constant: none of three natural mappings from the curve to a band – steepest improvement, lowest band-mean error, or knee location – recovers the best tested configuration. We do not claim no statistic of the curve could work, only that these three do not. Placement still matters, but is model- and corpus-specific. On CDSD the models disagree – Qwen3-ASR prefers its upper third (29.88% CER, three-seed mean), Whisper-small all-block LoRA (53.56%) – while on UASpeech neither favours the upper band. At three seeds, upper-versus-all is resolved (-1.31 pp, CI [-2.16, -0.25]) but upper-versus-middle is not (-0.83 pp, CI [-2.06, +1.86]). The two models’ preferences differ as a directly tested interaction (-4.71 pp, CI [-6.17, -2.89]); we designate this the primary claim, and record that the designation was made post hoc. On Qwen3-ASR x UASpeech, adapting near the input is reliably worse than not adapting at all (+9.90 pp CER). We recommend choosing the band by a short adaptation sweep on the model and corpus in hand, not by reading it off a probe. [NLP-42] When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有光学字符识别（OCR）与文档理解系统将人类标注（如箭头、删除线、插入符号等）视为视觉噪声，而非具有语义意义的编辑操作的问题。其核心挑战在于如何有效建模文档中手写或数字形式的视觉意图线索（visual intent cues），并将其与原始文档内容联合推理，以生成准确的修正后文本。解决方案的关键在于提出“意图感知的OCR”（intent-aware OCR）任务，并构建首个大规模多模态数据集DocIntent，包含1,600份金融文档及超过5,700个标注的视觉意图线索，每个样本均配有布局感知且意图解析后的OCR目标。同时，设计了216文档的IntentBench基准测试，用于评估模型在多样化真实标注条件下的鲁棒性。基于该数据集，研究者微调了3B和7B参数量的视觉-语言模型（DocIntentOCR），在直接意图监督下实现显著性能提升：在IntentBench上分别达到0.81和0.83的F1分数，显著优于商用闭源模型（如GPT-4.1的0.626）和开源模型（如LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B的0.50），证明了意图感知监督可使小型领域专用模型超越更大规模通用模型。该工作确立了意图感知OCR作为人机协同文档理解的新范式，并提供了推动交互式文档处理研究的基础资源。

作者: Akshata A Bhat,Daman Deep Singh,Niyati Chhaya
机构: Hyperbots Inc.

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.

[NLP-43] Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在处理长上下文时面临的三大瓶颈：随着上下文长度增加，前向传播速度下降、精度降低，且受限于固定上下文窗口（context window）无法扩展。现有解决方案如稀疏注意力（sparse attention）虽提升了计算效率，但未能克服精度下降和上下文长度限制；而近期提出的训练无感方法——网格探测（grid probing），通过多次对输入的局部与步进片段提问以恢复精度并扩展推理范围，但其代价高昂，因每次查询均需重新完整编码整个输入。本文的核心洞察是：网格探测本质上是一种外部模拟的注意力机制（emulated attention），即通过提示工程（prompting）在外层重构注意力模式，仅约束模型可见的输入区域。为此，作者提出因子化上下文注意力（Factorized Context Attention, FCA），一种无需训练的块稀疏注意力机制，可原生实现相同的注意力模式。FCA仅需一次将输入编码至键值缓存（KV cache），随后在单次批处理前向传播中并行读取所有片段，并采用阶梯位置调度（stair position schedule）确保各片段位置始终处于模型已训练的位置范围内。实验表明，FCA在长视频理解、长文本推理与图像定位任务中，达到与网格探测相当的精度与上下文覆盖能力，但计算成本仅为后者的极小部分；相较单次前向传播，其在长视频上提升约10个百分点，在长篇小说上提升9至14个百分点，可在超过千帧的视频中定位微小目标，或处理四倍于窗口长度的文本，并将后续问题的回答时间缩短至网格探测的十分之一。因此，原生注意力机制在不引入额外训练的前提下，保留了模拟注意力的优势，同时彻底规避其高开销缺陷，适用于现有的冻结语言与视觉-语言模型。

机构: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Thuwal, Saudi Arabia; Department of Computer Science, Edge Hill University, Ormskirk, England
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. It gains about 10 points over the single pass on long video and 9 to 14 points on long novels, finds needles in videos of over a thousand frames and in texts four times the length of the window, and answers a later question about the same input in as little as a tenth of the time of grid probing. Native attention thus keeps what emulated attention gains without its cost, all with existing frozen language and vision-language models.

[NLP-44] On the Importance of Hidden-State Refinement in Masked Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型中隐状态（hidden-state）动态演化被忽视的问题。尽管掩码扩散语言模型（Masked Diffusion Language Models, MDLMs）在每轮去噪过程中会产生丰富的分层隐藏状态轨迹，但现有方法仅关注最终的词元级输出，忽略了连续隐藏状态所蕴含的渐进式优化信息。其核心问题在于：如何有效利用这些跨步骤、跨层级的隐藏状态演化过程来提升文本生成质量。本文的关键解决方案是提出跨步骤循环精炼机制（Cross-Step Recurrent Refinement, CSRR），通过在去噪步骤间传递并整合隐藏状态信息，实现对生成过程的持续精炼。实验结果表明，该机制显著提升了文本生成质量，揭示了连续隐藏状态精炼在MDLM中的关键作用。

机构: 1. Tsinghua University (清华大学); 2. Peking University (北京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked or corrupted token sequences, allowing token predictions to condition on bidirectional context and update multiple positions in parallel. While each denoising step produces a rich layer-wise hidden-state trajectory, prior work typically focuses only on token-level information and discards these continuous hidden states, leaving their refinement dynamics underexplored. In this work, we analyze hidden-state dynamics in MDLMs and find clear evidence of layer-wise and cross-step refinement: smooth evolution across adjacent layers, greater predictive power in deeper layers, gradual degradation under transformer block removal, and strong final-state alignment across consecutive denoising steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Cross-Step Recurrent Refinement (CSRR), a mechanism that carries hidden-state information across denoising steps to enhance generation. Extensive experiments show that CSRR improves text generation quality, highlighting the critical role of continuous hidden-state refinement in MDLMs. Project page: this https URL

[NLP-45] Decision Models: An Introduction and Capability Evaluation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决软件系统在票务路由（ticket routing）与事件初步判断（incident triage）等应用场景中，如何实现可程序化执行的自动化决策问题。其核心挑战在于确保决策模型输出具备准确性、格式有效性及低延迟响应能力。解决方案的关键在于构建一个具有显式类型约束的结构化决策服务——StartLux Instant，通过为选择项、二元判断和策略评分定义明确的数据类型，保障输出的规范性与可执行性。实验结果表明，该方案在1,000个中英文案例上实现了95.3%的整体准确率，所有请求均返回有效输出，且中位请求延迟仅为0.084秒，在分类与路由任务中达到99.4%准确率，并在全部100个工具选择案例中正确选型，验证了类型化决策服务在提升决策效率与可靠性方面的有效性，同时揭示了其适用性受具体任务误差容忍度与延迟要求制约。

Abstract:Applications such as ticket routing and incident triage need decisions that software can act on. Decision models provide these outputs through explicit types for choices, binary judgments, and policy scores. We evaluate the accuracy, output validity, and request latency of eleven configurations on 1,000 English and Chinese cases across nine task suites. StartLux Instant achieves 95.3% overall accuracy, returns valid outputs on all 1,000 cases, and has a median request latency of 0.084 s. It reaches 99.4% on classification and routing and selects the correct response on all 100 tool-selection cases. The highest overall accuracy among the evaluated configurations is 97.1%. These results show how a typed decision service can support fast, programmatic decisions and why its suitability depends on task-specific errors and latency requirements.

[NLP-46] Implementation of Machine Translation for the Uzbek Language Based on Transformer Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决乌兹别克语（Uzbek language）在机器翻译（Machine Translation, MT）领域因语料数据稀缺及语言结构复杂性导致的翻译性能不足问题。其关键解决方案在于构建一个规模约为300万句对的高质量乌兹别克语-英语平行语料库，通过数据收集、预处理与增强技术弥补数据匮乏的短板，并基于T5和mT5等Transformer模型进行微调（fine-tuning），以实现更优的翻译表现。实验采用BLEU评分标准进行评估，结果表明该方法显著优于传统方法，有效推动了乌兹别克语在数字环境中的应用与发展。

Abstract:This research focuses on building a machine translation system for the Uzbek language using transformer models such as T5 and mT5. Because of the limited data and the complexity of the Uzbek language, we collect, preprocess and augment data to create a strong Uzbek-English parallel corpus of about 3 million sentence pairs. The models are fine-tuned for optimal translation performance, and we use the BLEU score to evaluate the results. This study shows that our approach significantly improves upon older methods and helps promote the Uzbek language in the digital world.

[NLP-47] ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLM s Actually Look at All the Images?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多图像基准测试中普遍存在的“单图像捷径”（single-image shortcut）问题，即许多多图像任务实际上仅依赖单幅图像或题目本身即可作答，导致多模态大语言模型（MLLM）倾向于利用这一捷径而非真正融合多图像证据。其核心问题是现有基准测试缺乏对跨图像推理的严格验证，使得模型在训练和评估中被错误激励去依赖单一图像信息。解决方案的关键在于构建一个经过严格审计的大型多图像基准数据集——ASTERISM，该数据集从19个公开基准中筛选出必须依赖多图像才能正确回答的样本，共包含18.7k项，并统一格式、评分标准与任务类别；同时提出一种名为“跨图像信用分配”（Cross-Image Credit Assignment, CICA）的新机制，作为强化学习中可验证奖励（RLVR）的扩展，通过将奖励更精准地分配给需要多图像信息的模型输出 token，从而抑制单图像捷径行为。实验证明，CICA 在三个开源 MLLM 上使 ASTERISM 得分提升 2.6 至 6.0 分，显著优于传统强化学习目标，有效引导模型学习真正的多图像联合推理能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32316
作者: Chanseul Cho,Dongwoo Kim,Noori Bae,Seungjae Moon,Seongsu Lee,Youngmin Ro
机构: University of Seoul(首尔大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Code and datasets: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

[NLP-48] ArabFake: A multitask deep learning framework for Arabic fake news Detection Categorization and risk prediction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决阿拉伯语媒体（包括社交媒体）中虚假新闻传播所引发的信息真实性受损及公众信任危机问题。其核心挑战在于阿拉伯语的语言复杂性，特别是多方言混杂、语义歧义和隐含误导性语言特征的识别。为应对这一难题，论文提出了一种名为ArabFake的深度学习框架，其关键创新在于构建了一个基于MARBERTv2的多任务学习架构，实现了虚假新闻检测、内容分类与风险评估三者的统一建模。通过共享知识表示实现多任务协同学习，显著提升了模型效率与性能。此外，研究引入情感值（valence scoring）作为可解释性机制，揭示虚假新闻中操纵性语言线索的使用模式，增强了对虚假信息传播策略的理解。实验结果表明，ArabFake在三项任务上分别取得94.12%、84.92%和88.91%的F1分数，验证了其在真实场景中的有效性与可靠性。同时，研究构建并公开了包含2,495条人工标注新闻的ArabFake数据集，为后续研究提供了高质量基准。

作者: Ahmed Maher Khafaga Shehata,Mohammed Nasser Al-Suqri,Nour Eldin Mohamed Elshaiekh Osman,Faten Hamad,Yousuf Nasser Alhusaini,Ahmed Mahfouz
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The spread of fake news among Arabic media including social media represents a great challenge to the integrity of information and the trust of the public in it. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive deep-learning framework, named ArabFake, that goes beyond the binary classification on Arabic fake news detection. ArabFake, built over MARBERTv2 (a state-of-the-art model for multi-dialectal Arabic tweets), proficiently address the complexity of the Arabic language while performing three unified tasks which are fake news detection, content categorization and its risk assessment. The framework promotes efficiency and performance both by enabling multi-task learning through shared knowledge representation across tasks. In order to facilitate development and evaluation, we present the ArabFake Dataset consisting of 2,495 manually labelled news items with labels that are verified by experts regarding fake news categories and risk levels. ArabFake demonstrates robust performance, achieving an F1 score of 94.12% for fake news detection, 84.92% for categorization, and 88.91% for risk zone assessment, highlighting its reliability and effectiveness across multiple tasks. We improve interpretability and extract insight into manipulative techniques by integrating valence scoring as part of the framework that emphasizes misleading linguistic cues used to disseminate fake news within the produced image. The results show that ArabFake is a holistic Arabic fake news detection framework that has practical implications on news organizations and fact checking projects.

[NLP-49] SkillCore: Internalizing Generalizable Skills via Scaffolding-Removed Fine-Tuning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 代理在实际应用中因用户无法主动调用运行时技能（runtime skills）而导致其能力未能广泛发挥的问题。当前大多数用户并未主动触发技能，使得本可提升问题求解能力的通用流程性知识仍作为可选的外部附加模块存在，限制了其普及性与有效性。为克服这一局限，论文提出将通用技能内化为模型自身的能力，使其无需显式加载即可直接调用。其核心解决方案是设计名为 SkillCore 的数据构建管道与监督微调方法：通过移除真实代理轨迹中的技能加载结构（scaffolding），仅保留任务上下文和后续动作，从而训练模型直接执行任务；同时，为保留对特定任务技能的访问能力，引入少量保留原始技能调用信息的轨迹进行混合训练。实验结果表明，在无技能依赖的测试集上，SkillCore 相较于基础 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen2.5-72B 模型分别提升了 54.4% 和 24.8% 的任务完成质量，同时在独立探针任务中保持了对特定技能的调用能力，并在 SWE-bench Verified 上维持了良好的通用编码性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32246
作者: Yi Liu,Changqing Ai,Peijie Dong,Xiankun Lin,Yongkang Yang,Zhezheng Hao,Xilin Xia,Hande Dong,Qiang Lin,Qiang Xu
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong(香港中文大学); Tencent(腾讯), WorkBuddy Team; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)(香港科技大学(广州)); Zhejiang University(浙江大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages, 4 figures, and 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Runtime skills can improve agents’ problem-solving capabilities by providing procedural guidance for tasks such as code review and debugging. However, these benefits reach only a minority of users, as most do not proactively invoke skills in practice. We argue that such generalizable procedures should become part of the model’s capabilities rather than remain optional external add-ons, making them directly available without explicit skill loading. To this end, we present SkillCore, a data pipeline and supervised fine-tuning recipe for internalizing generalizable skills. We transform real agent trajectories by removing skill-loading scaffolding while preserving the task context and subsequent agent actions, thereby supervising direct execution without external skill content. To preserve access to task-specific skills that provide genuinely external information, we mix these scaffold-removed trajectories with a small proportion of skill-native trajectories that preserve supervision for skill invocation. On a held-out skill-free evaluation, SkillCore improves task completion quality over the base Qwen3-8B and Qwen2.5-72B models by 54.4% and 24.8%, respectively, while preserving task-specific skill invocation on a separate probe and general coding performance on SWE-bench Verified.

[NLP-50] ArEssays: Towards Robust Arabic Handwritten Text Understanding in Educational Settings

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决阿拉伯语手写学生作文在教育场景中自动理解的难题，核心挑战在于阿拉伯文字体本身的复杂性以及儿童书写中存在的高度变异性。为此，研究团队构建了ArEssays——一个大规模的真实学生作文数据集，涵盖埃及从小学到中学阶段的学生写作样本，包含逐字转录版本与语言学校正后的版本。其解决方案的关键在于：首次系统地对34种视觉-语言模型和光学字符识别（OCR）模型进行基准测试，并揭示了现有方法在真实学生手写文本上的显著性能差距；同时公开数据集、训练流程与评测结果，以推动阿拉伯语手写文本识别（Arabic OCR）、文档理解及教育领域自然语言处理（NLP）的研究进展。

Abstract:Automated understanding of handwritten Arabic student essays remains challenging due to script complexity and high variability in children’s writing. We introduce ArEssays, a large-scale dataset of authentic essays from primary to secondary students across Egypt, with both verbatim transcriptions and linguistically corrected versions. We benchmark 34 vision-language and OCR models, including fine-tuned systems, and find large performance gaps on real student handwriting. We release the dataset, training pipelines, and results to support research in Arabic OCR, document understanding, and educational NLP.
