[NLP-51] Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前语言模型在对齐与控制方面依赖后期微调或推理时干预的局限性，即现有模型采用基于下一个词预测（next-token prediction）的预训练方式，导致指令理解与数据处理共用同一输入通道，从而引发诸如意图越狱（jailbreaks）和非故意的上下文对齐漂移等常见失效模式。其核心解决方案是提出一种从架构设计之初就分离指令控制信号与数据输入的新预训练方法与模型架构——Mancelle-3B。该模型引入一个编码器，通过交叉注意力机制处理未来文本的高层语义特征，并防止词元流回写至这一控制通道，使该通道成为可被模型主动依赖以预测下一个词的可控“舵柄”（steering handle）。实验表明，相较于基于提示（prompt-based）和激活（activation-based）的方法，Mancelle-3B 在保持语言流畅性的前提下实现了更强的可控性，且能有效抵御对抗性黑盒及软提示反向控制攻击。该研究验证了将鲁棒控制能力早期、系统性地嵌入语言模型架构中的可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32199
作者: Henry Castillo,Yanchen Liu,Claudio Mayrink Verdun,Dylan Hadfield-Menell
机构: Cambridge-Boston Alignment Initiative; Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院); Harvard University (哈佛大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today’s language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. These models repurpose a single input channel for both instructions and data, leading to common failure modes where the model mistakenly treats data as instructions such as intentional jailbreaks and unintentional in-context alignment drift. To correct this, we propose a pretraining method and architecture that separates the two from the very start, producing Mancelle-3B. An encoder processes high-level semantic features of upcoming text with cross-attention that prevents the token stream from writing back into this control channel. During pretraining, the model learns to rely on these features to predict the next token, turning the channel into an effective handle for steering the model. Mancelle-3B steers more strongly than prompt- and activation-based methods on comparable open models while maintaining fluency, and it withstands adversarial black-box and soft-prompt counter-steering that defeats those baselines. We reproduce this against a more controlled baseline with Mancelle-400M. Our results show that robust control can be built into language models if we do so early and intentionally.

[NLP-52] hinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型在复杂推理任务中缺乏有效视觉-语言协同能力的问题，特别是如何在不依赖大量人工标注的任务特定示范（task-specific demonstrations）的情况下，训练模型实现跨模态的交错式推理（interleaved multimodal reasoning）。其核心解决方案在于提出一种两阶段自监督学习框架——ThinkMorph-SSL。第一阶段“预训练推理”（pretext reasoning）将图像修复类任务（如图像去噪、着色等）转化为无需指令的交错推理轨迹：模型先描述被破坏或变换的图像，生成恢复后的标准图像，并对结果进行解释，从而习得从视觉输入到中间表征再到语义理解的链式推理能力。第二阶段利用自动生成的示范进行基于问题驱动的指令微调，在有限计算预算下显著提升了模型性能。实验表明，该方法在12个基准测试上平均提升11.33个准确率点，证明了仅通过图像自身提供的自监督信号即可构建支持交错式视觉推理的关键能力，进而增强对任务特定示范的学习效率与泛化性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32183
作者: Jiawei Gu,Linjie Li,Yiming Liu,Yunzhuo Hao,Huichen Wang,Guanzheng Chen,Zhichao Peng,Luxin Xu,Xinyu Zhang,Li Luo,Disen Lan,Zican Hu,Mingyang Song,David Valente,Alex Jinpeng Wang,Yafu Li,Ganqu Cui,Zhengyuan Yang,Qizhe Xie,Yejin Choi,Ranjay Krishna,Yu Cheng
机构: University of Washington; Tsinghua University; Zhejiang University; National University of Singapore; Central South University; Fudan University; The University of Hong Kong; Nanjing University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; University of Rochester; Stanford University
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.

[NLP-53] RightDiff: Learning Generative Reward Models to Judge by the Right Differences

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式奖励模型（Generative Reward Models）在进行成对偏好判断时存在的核心问题：现有方法通常依赖通用的查询级评估标准或无约束的推理过程，忽视了响应特异性差异对偏好决策的关键影响；同时，仅追求结果正确性会诱导模型利用冗长表达和格式化等表面捷径，导致推理漂移（rationale drift）。其解决方案的关键在于提出RightDiff框架，该框架将成对评估重构为一个基于证据的、单次自回归生成的评估轨迹。RightDiff通过显式发现候选响应间的对比差异，并将其分类为“实质性”或“非实质性”因素，在最终裁决前生成特定于成对比较的评估标准。为避免事后理性化带来的偏差，该方法采用响应隔离提示合成示范数据，并引入受预算约束的一一匹配与乘法门控机制，对差异对齐奖励进行正则化优化。实验表明，RightDiff在RewardBench和RM-Bench上达到当前最优的偏好建模性能，超越所有开源奖励模型并领先于专有大语言模型裁判；在下游任务中，其可为直接偏好优化提供可靠监督信号，有效抑制长度相关捷径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32166
作者: Qiyuan Chen,Hongsen Huang,Jiahe Chen,Renjie Hua,Hongxia Xu,Chuan Ren,Jian Wu
机构: Zhejiang University(浙江大学); Soochow Securities Co., Ltd.(苏州证券有限公司); Nanjing University(南京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative reward models typically rely on generic query-level rubrics or unconstrained rationales, overlooking the fact that pairwise preference is driven by response-specific differences. Moreover, optimizing solely for outcome correctness encourages models to exploit superficial shortcuts such as verbosity and formatting, triggering rationale drift. To address this, we propose RightDiff, which structures pairwise evaluation into an evidence-grounded evaluation trajectory executed in a single autoregressive generation. RightDiff explicitly discovers contrastive differences between candidates, categorizes them into material or immaterial factors, and induces pair-specific rubrics before final adjudication. To train this process without post-hoc rationalization, we synthesize demonstration data via response-isolated prompts and optimize the reward model with a difference-alignment reward regularized by budget-constrained one-to-one matching and multiplicative gating. RightDiff achieves state-of-the-art preference modeling performance on RewardBench and RM-Bench, surpassing all open-source reward models and leading proprietary LLM judges. Downstream, it provides reliable supervision for direct preference optimization on Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval while effectively resisting length shortcuts.

[NLP-54] Making Evaluation Explicit Is Not Enough: Supervising the Evaluation Process in Generative Reward Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式奖励模型（Generative Reward Models, GRMs）在语言模型评估中存在“事后合理化”（post-hoc rationalization）的问题，即模型可能在仅依赖最终偏好监督的情况下，虽然得出正确的最终评分，但其生成的中间评价（如评语、评分标准或分析过程）缺乏实质支撑或逻辑一致性，导致评估过程不可靠。为解决此问题，论文提出STEP-GRM框架，其核心在于对基于评分标准的GRMs的中间评估过程进行直接监督：不仅保留传统的偏好监督，还引入结构化指导以规范评分标准的构建，并提供针对各评价维度的局部监督，促使模型不仅学习正确的最终偏好，更掌握可信赖的、一致的推理过程。实验表明，STEP-GRM在标准奖励建模基准上表现优异，同时显著提升了中间评价的一致性与正确性；更重要的是，由其生成的奖励信号能有效提升下游策略优化效果，证明了可靠评估过程对实际应用价值的正向贡献。

Abstract:Generative reward models (GRMs) make language-model evaluation more explicit by generating critiques, rubrics, or intermediate analyses before predicting a final preference. However, explicit evaluation does not necessarily imply a reliable evaluation process: under outcome-only supervision, a model may reach the correct final preference while producing weak or unsupported intermediate judgments, turning the evaluation into a post-hoc rationalization. We introduce STEP-GRM, a framework that directly supervises the intermediate evaluation process of rubric-based GRMs. In addition to conventional preference supervision, STEP-GRM provides structural guidance for rubric construction and local supervision for criterion-level judgments, encouraging the model to learn not only the correct final preference but also a more reliable process for reaching it. Extensive experiments show that STEP-GRM achieves strong performance on standard reward-modeling benchmarks while improving the consistency and correctness of intermediate evaluations. Moreover, reward signals produced by STEP-GRM lead to better downstream policy optimization, demonstrating that more reliable evaluation processes can translate into practical gains beyond reward-model accuracy.

[NLP-55] ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在后训练阶段依赖一阶强化学习方法（如组相对策略优化，GRPO）所引发的高内存与系统开销问题，同时探索零阶（zeroth-order, ZO）优化方法在多模态推理任务中的可行性。其核心挑战在于：直接应用标准进化策略（Evolution Strategies, ES）或增强随机搜索（Augmented Random Search, ARS）等前向仅需方法时，会遭遇两大根本性失败模式——（i）图像块网格过拟合（patch-grid overfitting），即模型过度关注特定网格位置的视觉标记伪影而忽略空间不变特征；（ii）灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting），由于无界高秩参数更新与策略漂移，导致泛化能力下降及分布外（out-of-distribution, OOD）任务性能退化。为此，论文提出一种视觉对齐的增强随机搜索框架——ARS-VLM，其关键解决方案包括：（1）通过双线性配对的跨网格视图提取对比性视觉基底，将扰动集中于共享视觉信号，抑制块位移伪影；（2）在浅层视觉融合层引入软子空间先验进行锚定，释放深层推理层自由度，在无需参考模型的前提下有效抑制策略漂移；（3）基于成对视图的扰动评分机制，在top-k选择中剔除对视图脆弱方向的敏感性。实验表明，ARS-VLM在Qwen3-VL-8B上仅用20步即达到61.0%验证准确率（相较GRPO的150步减少7.5倍优化步数），且避免了传统ARS/ES的后期OOD崩溃问题；同时在7个分布外视觉推理基准上实现75.41%的单视图微平均准确率，接近全参数GRPO的75.31%表现，充分证明其在前向仅需架构下实现高效、稳定且具备强泛化能力的多模态推理后训练。

作者: Xiangwei Wang,Jianyuan Lin,Peng Wang,Saman Halgamuge
机构: 未知
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

[NLP-56] Calibrated Reading of Latent Reasoning and Communication

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中潜在推理过程与键值通信机制依赖连续表示存储中间信息，导致模型行为难以直接观测的问题。现有激活读取方法在任务特定探针的低开销与语言模型解码器的灵活性之间存在权衡。本文提出校准潜在读取器（Calibrated Latent Reader, CLR），其核心在于通过状态与候选答案之间的任务条件交互，实现对推理结果和消息内容的联合预测；该方法结合源适配器（source adapters）实现跨模型迁移，利用置信区间校准（conformal calibration）在交换性假设下提供覆盖率与误报率保障。实验表明，在两个CODI模型上，CLR相较于MLP与注意力探针，在最终答案预测和参考值归属任务中准确率提升4–18个百分点；在CODI-GPT-2上，其性能接近基于17亿参数的LatentQA显式语义化器，但仅需437–648倍更少的推理浮点运算量（FLOPs）。在合成Qwen3-4B通信场景中，通过对比解码事实与公开承诺，可在5%名义误报率下检测出93.1%的消息替换行为。

机构: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; AI2Robotics; Southwest Jiaotong University; Tsinghua University; The University of Hong Kong; New Jersey Institute of Technology
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Latent reasoning and key-value communication store intermediate information in continuous representations, limiting direct inspection of model behavior. Existing activation readers trade the low cost of task-specific probes against the flexibility of language-model decoders. We propose the Calibrated Latent Reader, CLR, a compact transformer that predicts reasoning outcomes and message content through task-conditioned interactions between states and candidate answers. Source adapters support transfer across models, while conformal calibration provides coverage and false-alarm guarantees under exchangeability. On two CODI models, CLR improves accuracy over MLP and attention probes by 4-18 percentage points for final-answer prediction and reference-value membership. On CODI-GPT-2, it achieves accuracy comparable to a 1.7B LatentQA-based verbalizer using 437-648 times fewer inference FLOPs. On synthetic Qwen3-4B communications, comparing decoded facts with public commitments detects 93.1% of message substitutions at a nominal 5% false-positive rate.

[NLP-57] Fix How It Acts Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决开放权重大语言模型（Open-weight LLMs）在执行代码生成等软件工程任务时，因细微但累积的错误行为（如重复失败步骤或过早声明任务完成）而导致性能下降的问题。其核心挑战在于：尽管模型具备正确的推理能力，但微小的行为偏差会显著影响最终结果。传统解决方案依赖于低秩适配器（LoRA）进行微调，但此类轻量级更新在模型合并至发布检查点时，因量化格式（如BF16、FP8/NVFP4）导致权重更新丢失严重——在BF16版本中约有三分之二的更新被抹除，在混合FP8/NVFP4版本中甚至高达93%。为应对这一问题，本文提出“合并感知微调”（merge-aware fine-tuning）方法：在训练过程中，将基础权重与适配器更新的和直接按目标存储格式（如BF16、NVFP4）进行每步四舍五入，并保留厂商的量化比例，使损失函数基于实际部署时的数值表示进行计算。该方法确保前向传播与推理引擎数值一致，梯度可穿透舍入操作，从而实现“所训即所发”的模型优化。该策略仅优化模型的行为输出，保持原始推理能力接近基线模型。在Nemotron-3.5上的实验表明，该方法在BF16与NVFP4两种发布版本中均显著提升代理式编程表现，终端基准测试2.1（Terminal-Bench 2.1）上最高提升达8.4分，并已公开发布优化后的模型。

作者: Sandeep Singh Sandha,Prann Bansal,Arvind Sundararajan
机构: Abacus.AI(阿布卡斯人工智能)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 30 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Models released at this https URL and this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Open-weight LLMs are competent software engineers, but they sometimes fail at tasks they are otherwise able to do. Often it is not a failure of reasoning. It is a few small missteps over a long trajectory (repeating a step that has already failed, or declaring the task done while a requirement is still unmet) that make the difference. Correcting this calls for a surgical weight update that steers the model toward the right actions without interfering with its reasoning. Such updates, typically learned with LoRA adapters, are often too small to survive merging into a released checkpoint. In our BF16 release, the median weight change is only 1.5% of a single rounding step, and merging loses roughly two thirds of the update’s norm. When the same adapter is merged into the mixed FP8/NVFP4 release of the same model, 93% of the update disappears. Instead of increasing the size of the update, we directly train on the surviving part. We introduce merge-aware fine-tuning. Standard LoRA rounds the merged weights to the storage format only at export, so the loss never sees the rounded weights. We instead round the sum of base weights and adapter update to the release format at every training step, keeping the vendor’s quantization scales, and compute the loss on these weights. The forward pass matches the serving engine numerics, and the gradient passes straight through the rounding, so the model we train is the model we ship. The loss optimizes only the model’s actions and keeps its reasoning close to the base model. Applied to Nemotron-3.5, the recipe improves agentic coding in both the BF16 and the NVFP4 release, by up to 8.4 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and we publicly release both models.

[NLP-58] Do Clinician-Scored Examples Help LLM s Code ADOS-2 from Hour-Long Transcripts?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在自动编码自闭症诊断观察量表（ADOS-2）中与临床医生评分一致性不足的问题，尤其关注专家标注示例是否能有效提升模型评分的准确性。其核心挑战在于：尽管大型语言模型具备理解评分标准的能力，但依赖专家标注示例进行少样本学习（few-shot scoring）是否真正实现模型与临床判断的一致性，仍缺乏严格验证。研究的关键发现是，使用错误标签替换原有专家标注示例后，模型预测结果虽发生显著偏移（约三分之一预测值趋向错误标签），但与临床医生的评分一致性并未下降，表明仅靠标注示例无法有效校准模型；进一步对比多种方法（如锚定比较、基于协议的证据路由、直接评分等）后发现，未经过后验校准的直接全转录评分表现最佳（加权二次κ=0.30），而所有复杂化流程均未显著优于基础方法。研究强调，真正的校准需通过受控的虚假标签对照实验和强基线进行验证，否则对“校准”或“流水线复杂性提升”的宣称不可靠。

Abstract:Large language models can apply a written rubric to a transcript, making automated coding of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) look within reach. A common way to align such a rater with clinicians is to show it expert-scored examples, but whether correct labels improve agreement is rarely tested. We test this for eight speech-based items of hour-long ADOS-2 Module 3 sessions from 48 children, with one local model and a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design. We compare few-shot scoring, an anchored comparison in which the model only judges a child better, similar or worse than scored anchors and a fixed rule gives the score, post-hoc calibration, protocol-based evidence routing and direct scoring of the full transcript. On 40 held-out children, agreement with clinicians was modest, with quadratic weighted kappa between 0.22 and 0.30. Replacing every example’s label with a wrong one changed about a third of the few-shot predictions, more often towards the corrupted labels than chance, but did not lower agreement, 0.25 with correct and 0.23 with wrong labels. A larger second model did the same. The anchored comparison did not improve on few-shot scoring, its cross-child judgements were no more accurate than those implied by absolute scores, and routing did not help. Among the registered, uncalibrated arms, direct scoring of the full transcript agreed best at 0.30. Exploratory follow-up analyses found that the model’s graded judgements ranked children better than its final scores, that existing batch calibration raised agreement to 0.46 on the same children, and that in controlled synthetic sessions scoring episodes separately did not beat calibrated whole-transcript scoring. Expert-scored examples do not by themselves calibrate model-based clinical raters, and claims of calibration or added pipeline complexity need corrupted-label controls and strong baselines.

[NLP-59] HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决医疗领域中异构专业视觉-语言模型（VLMs）难以统一的问题。现有专业医学VLMs通常基于私有数据训练，且各自采用独立架构，导致无法直接集成或共享，而分别部署这些大型模型则带来高昂的计算成本。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种无参考答案、无需访问原始训练数据的在线策略蒸馏方法——HuluOPD。该方法通过仅使用未标注的提示（unlabeled prompts），让轻量级模型在不同模态的专业模型监督下进行学习，利用一种跨分词器的连续性对齐损失（continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss），实现了跨架构与分词器差异下的有效知识迁移。实验表明，仅需原五类专业模型总参数量的10%和2%，即可分别保持94%和89%的问答性能，首次实现了无需共享架构或训练数据的异构医学专业VLM的高效融合。

类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists’ training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt’s modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists’ combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.

[NLP-60] Marketing-Bench: Evaluating Frontier Models and Agents on Real-World Marketing Capabilities

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前前沿生成式AI在营销领域应用中缺乏有效评估体系的问题。由于营销内容的质量高度依赖主观判断（如品牌调性、审美偏好），传统基于客观标准的评估方法难以适用，导致模型性能无法被准确衡量。为此，论文提出Marketing-Bench——首个开源的营销能力基准测试框架，其核心创新在于将判别性任务（检测品牌异常）与生成性任务（修复问题内容）相结合，并确保答案可验证。该基准从事实性、一致性、连贯性、结构化和品牌语调五个关键维度全面评估模型表现。实验结果表明，当前主流前沿模型在处理营销任务时仍存在显著不足：平均仅能修正约53.1%的问题，远低于人类营销专家的近100%修正率；即使最强模型GPT-6 Astra也仅达到74.8%的修正率，其余模型表现更差。这一发现揭示了营销能力的实际成熟度低于广泛部署所暗示的程度，强调必须建立系统性评估机制以指导后续模型迭代与规模化应用。Marketing-Bench为迈向“超人级营销模型”奠定了基础，标志着对生成式AI在创意营销领域真实能力的首次严谨量化探索。

机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:As frontier AI models and agents are deployed more broadly in the real world, marketing is emerging as one of their largest applications. Marketing teams use AI models to produce brand assets like website copy and social media posts, while consumers’ agents autonomously discover products, research purchases, and navigate websites. However, evaluating marketing capability is difficult because unlike areas like software development, customer support, or legal review where ground truth is more objectively defined, marketing is subjective, and output quality is judged based on taste and brand. We introduce Marketing-Bench, the first open-source marketing benchmark, which pairs discriminative tasks (detecting brand anomalies) with generative tasks (remediation), while keeping answers verifiable. Marketing-Bench tests five key pillars: factuality, consistency, coherence, structure, and brand voice, all crucial elements for good brand content on the web. We find that frontier models are far from solving the benchmark: the average model corrects only about half of the introduced issues (53.1%), whereas a marketing expert corrects nearly all of them. Even the strongest, GPT-6 Astra, reaches only 74.8%, with Claude Opus and Fable, Gemini Argon, and GPT-6 Sol falling well short. These findings suggest that marketing capabilities are less mature than adoption implies, and that principled evaluation should precede further scaling of usage. Marketing-Bench is a first step toward “frontier marketing models” with superhuman marketing performance.

[NLP-61] ableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大表格（large tables）在生成式 AI 推理中因上下文长度限制导致的推理失效问题。当表格超出模型上下文预算时，仅通过检索相关行无法保证模型获得精确计算所需的信息，且即使获取了完整证据，模型仍可能难以有效利用这些信息进行准确推理。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需训练的框架 TableRouter，该框架根据查询内容动态选择两种推理路径：一是“计算路径”（computation route），从全表中推导出与问题相关的统计量；二是“覆盖路径”（coverage route），检索相关行及列摘要。所选上下文以单一调用方式输入冻结的生成式 AI 模型。实验表明，TableRouter 在三个大表基准测试和三种生成式 AI 模型上均显著优于六种单次调用基线方法，准确率提升 1.2 至 18.3 个百分点，同时使用约 77%-95% 更少的估算浮点运算量（FLOPs），且索引开销可跨查询分摊。在未参与前期训练的数据库长表场景下，TableRouter 使用 Qwen2.5-7B 达到 35.8% 的准确率，远超最强外部基线的 16.4%。控制实验进一步证实，显式提供计算得到的统计量可使准确率最高提升 40.0 个百分点，即使所有答案决定性行均已可用。这一结果揭示了“证据获取”与“证据使用”的本质区别：长表推理的成败不仅取决于检索到的行，更关键在于信息的表达方式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32006
作者: Anahita Bolourani,Xiaofeng Lin,Tung Sum Thomas Kwok,Guang Cheng
机构: University of California, Los Angeles(加州大学洛杉矶分校)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.

[NLP-62] Grounding Language Models in Revealed Audience Behavior

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式语言模型在预测受众行为时存在的偏差问题，即现有模型依赖于“询问”（asking）而非真实行为数据进行训练，导致其预测能力受限。其核心问题是：为何仅通过提示（prompting）让模型预测受众点击、点赞或观看行为的表现不佳？解决方案的关键在于将模型“接地”（grounded），即通过微调（fine-tuning）使用真实用户行为数据（如实际点击、点赞、观看记录）作为训练信号，从而显著提升模型对受众行为的预测准确性。研究发现，这种差距源于训练信号本身的性质，而非模型规模或提示工程的局限性——即使是一个仅有0.6B参数的小模型，只要经过真实行为数据的接地训练，其表现也优于所有未接地的大规模前沿模型；同时，在不同行为类型中，接地模型的优势在文本承载信号较强的场景（如短视频点赞）中尤为显著，而在依赖用户历史行为的场景（如新闻点击）中仅能与提问模型持平，而纯文本特征在观看时长预测上则无法超越随机猜测水平。这一结果表明，真实行为数据是构建高精度受众行为模拟器的核心要素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31999
作者: Jiwoo Jung,Daecheol An
机构: Sigmine
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 30 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models are increasingly used to simulate how an audience will respond to a headline or a post, and such simulators are validated against what people say. We validate them against what people do. We call a model grounded in revealed audience behavior when it is fine-tuned on records of what audiences actually clicked, liked or watched, and we ask not only whether asking a model falls short of grounding it, as prior work found, but why and where. Why: the gap is a property of the training signal, not mainly of model size or prompting. The same 8B model is right about half the time when asked which headline readers will click and 86.5% of the time when grounded in the clicks; the strongest prompting we tried only matches a text classifier; a grounded 0.6B model beats every prompted frontier model in our runs; and whether the clicks are fitted as counts or as shares makes no detectable difference in a pre-registered test. The asked 8B model also reproduces stated-preference cues, favoring question headlines that in fact lower clicks. Where: across four behaviors, grounding wins where the text carries the signal (short-video likes, +20 points on 200 pre-registered videos), only ties an asked model given the reader’s history (news clicks), and nothing text-only gets far from chance on watch time. Code, adapters and run outputs will be released.

[NLP-63] Reading Writing and Repairing Game-Theoretic Policies in Weight Space

【速读】： 该论文试图解决的问题是：如何让语言模型在策略网络的权重空间中，针对重复博弈（repeated game）任务实现对策略的精确建模与推理。具体而言，研究聚焦于语言模型是否能够基于对手群体的自然语言描述，生成最优策略网络，并在给定权重的情况下准确推断其行为、重构状态机结构、或修复被局部篡改的网络输出。解决方案的关键在于将策略网络的权重视为可计算的程序代码，利用语言模型对权重空间进行符号级解析与逻辑推演，从而完成从自然语言描述到精确策略实现的映射。实验结果表明，语言模型在大多数任务上表现出色——62/66次成功恢复程序，34/36次正确预测全部15个历史路径下的动作输出，且在20/20次声明策略时达到理论最优值；然而，在网络修复任务中表现较弱，仅4/18成功修复，5/18正确诊断问题，且修复范围平均仅覆盖两个必要修正中的一个，表明当前方法在容错与局部修正能力方面仍存在局限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31979
作者: Ancil Crayton
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Can a language model work in the weight space of a policy network for a repeated game? We put four questions to a mid-size open model, on recurrent networks of 1,218 weights with exactly checkable answers. Given a population of opponents described in English, write a policy that is optimal: its value is a finite computation over the agent’s information state, so a submitted network has an exact gap from the optimum. Given a network’s weights, report its action after each of fifteen opponent histories; recover the state machine it implements, judged on every opponent sequence to depth ten; or repair a network whose output was altered in one place and say which round first goes wrong. The model recovers the program in 62 of 66 replies, reports all fifteen behavioral entries correctly in 34 of 36, and attains the optimum in 20 of 20 when it states a policy the evaluator compiles. Repair is the exception: 4 of 18 repaired, 5 of 18 diagnosed, with a median patch covering one of the two entries needed.

[NLP-64] Localizing Cross-Lingual Generalization in Parameter Space EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决跨语言迁移在不同任务间表现不均的问题，尤其关注自然语言理解（Natural Language Understanding, NLU）任务中跨语言迁移成功而数学推理（Mathematical Reasoning）任务常失败的现象。其核心问题是：为何跨语言迁移在某些任务中有效而在另一些任务中失效？解决方案的关键在于揭示参数空间中的基底几何结构（basin geometry）对跨语言泛化能力的决定性作用。研究提出，跨语言泛化是否成功取决于英语与目标语言的低秩适配器（LoRA adapters）是否共享一个低误差基底。通过线性模式连接性（Linear Mode Connectivity, LMC）分析发现，自然语言理解（NLI）和问答（QA）任务的适配器对大多具有线性连通性，而数学推理任务则普遍不连通，表明基底几何具有任务依赖性。这种不连通性是局部而非全局的，仅需在英语适配器的语言编码或语义组合层上引入少量目标语言样本即可修复。此外，研究进一步揭示跨语言泛化可分解为语言特异性编码与语言无关的语义组合两个独立组件，分别由低成本信号供给：将英语任务数据注入组合层、利用无标签目标语言语料注入编码层，两者各自即可显著提升跨语言性能，其中组合层的作用更为关键且无需目标语言标注数据。这一分解机制为低资源场景下的跨语言适应提供了可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31975
作者: Yeoreum Lee,Jaeseong Lee,Seung-won Hwang
机构: Seoul National University (首尔国立大学); Snowflake AI Research (雪花人工智能研究)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: EMNLP 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cross-lingual transfer is uneven across tasks, succeeding for natural language understanding but often failing for mathematical reasoning. We argue that this asymmetry is governed by the geometry of parameter space. Specifically, cross-lingual generalization is determined by whether English and target-language LoRA adapters share a low-error basin. To test this, we use linear mode connectivity (LMC) between English and target-language adapters, evaluating on three tasks. We find that NLI and QA model-language pairs are mostly linearly connected, whereas mathematical reasoning (Math) pairs are not, indicating that basin geometry is task-dependent. Such disconnection in Math is ``local’’ rather than global. A small target-language task sample, applied only to the English adapter’s language encoding or semantic composition layers, is enough to repair it. Cross-lingual generalization is also factorizable into language-specific encoding and language-agnostic composition, each supplied separately from a cheaper signal. English task data routed to the composition layers and an unlabeled target-language corpus routed to the language encoding layers each alleviate it on their own for nearly every pair. Composition is the more influential of these, and it needs no target-language data. Together, these results suggest that cross-lingual generalization decomposes into language-specific and language-agnostic components in parameter space. This decomposition offers a practical route for low-resource cross-lingual adaptation.

[NLP-65] Scoring What Matters: Exact Feedback Reduction for Language Model Comparison

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型检查点性能比较中因评估流水线对响应评分而导致的冗余计算问题，即部分评分贡献在性能差异估计中相互抵消，造成资源浪费。其核心解决方案是提出一种采样无关的对比感知反馈获取方法（Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition, CAFA），该方法能够在获取反馈前预判线性报告所需的最小有效评分输入集合，通过将相同评分输入分组并聚合其报告系数，实现对查询的高效压缩，既避免了传统缓存之外的重复查询，又完整保留了最终评分结果的精确性。对于固定的响应库和任意标量评分器，论文形式化地刻画了精确恢复样本均值（或联合恢复样本均值与协方差）所必需且充分的查询集。在可控更新场景下，CAFA 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 与 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 上分别减少了 55.8% 和 90.1% 的缓存后剩余评分输入，平均覆盖四次生成重复。在三个在线群体相对策略优化（GRPO）轨迹上，结合 CAFA 的独立星型采样（Independent Star sampling）相比采用缓存的独立自回归采样，在相同经验精度阈值（RMS MCSE ≤ 0.04）下，生成与反馈总成本降低 46.1%–51.3%。该对比为固定预算网格上已完成运行的后验分析。所有 504 个评估报告单元均以数值精度重现了完全评分后的均值与协方差。研究还提供了模块化实现，兼容现有响应库、版本化缓存及外部评分器。

作者: Hui Zhang,Haoda Yue,Bicheng Deng,Yuanchao Zhu,Jun He,Rui Qian
机构: Beijing Institute of Technology(北京理工大学); Nanyang Technological University(南洋理工大学); Fudan University(复旦大学); University of Electronic Science and Technology of China(电子科技大学); Beijing Technology and Business University(北京工商大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 79 pages, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Comparing language-model checkpoints requires estimating performance differences, yet evaluation pipelines can pay to score responses whose contributions cancel from those differences. We introduce Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition (CAFA), a sampler-agnostic method that identifies which scores a requested linear report needs before acquiring feedback. CAFA groups identical scoring inputs and aggregates their report coefficients, removing queries beyond ordinary caching while preserving the fully scored result. For a fixed response bank and an otherwise unrestricted scalar scorer, we characterize necessary and sufficient query sets for exact recovery of sample means, either alone or jointly with ordinary sample covariances. On controlled updates, CAFA removes 55.8% and 90.1% of the scoring inputs remaining after caching for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct, respectively, averaged over four generation repetitions. Across three online group relative policy optimization (GRPO) trajectories, Independent Star sampling with CAFA achieves 46.1-51.3% lower recorded generation-plus-feedback cost than independent autoregressive sampling with caching at a common empirical precision threshold (RMS MCSE \leq 0.04 ). This is a post hoc comparison of completed runs on a fixed budget grid. All 504 evaluated report cells reproduce the fully scored means and covariances to numerical precision. We provide a modular implementation supporting existing response banks, versioned caches and external scorers.

[NLP-66] Subliminal Learning Crosses Modalities

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型中隐性知识迁移（subliminal learning）的跨模态传播问题，即在看似无意义的数据（如数字序列）中，一个语言模型对特定主题（如“动物”）的偏好可被隐性地传递至另一个模型，并影响其多模态输出（如图像生成）。其解决方案的关键在于揭示：隐性迁移的核心机制源于学生模型（student model）在训练过程中对特定概念的恒定权重成分变化，这一成分主导了图像表征向目标属性的偏移。研究进一步表明，这种迁移仅影响由完整提示决定的复杂概念（如动物类别），而不会影响以单个标记编码的属性（如颜色或风格）。为此，作者提出“权重透镜”（weight lens）方法，通过分析单一训练模型的权重分布，能够有效识别出隐藏的隐性特征，即使这些特征未在生成图像中显现。该方法为解析和追踪跨模态隐性知识迁移提供了可解释性的工具。

作者: Saraswathy Amjith,Kimia Hamidieh,Antonio Torralba,Yoon Kim
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (麻省理工学院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Subliminal learning refers to a surprising phenomenon in language models wherein a prompt given to one model (e.g., preference for cats) can be subliminally distilled to another model via training on data that is ostensibly meaningless (e.g., number sequences). This paper shows that text-based subliminal learning transfers cross-modally, in particular, a topic/preference (e.g., animals) transferred through number sequences across vision-language models also changes how images are generated and represented. First, we show that a diffusion model using the student as its text encoder generates the student’s animal more often than with the original model as its text encoder, but not its color or style. We then investigate the mechanism behind this phenomenon and which concepts transfer across modalities. A constant component of the student’s change accounts for much of the shift of image representations toward the trait. Adding this component uniformly can change the generated animal, which depends on the whole prompt, but not concepts such as color or style, which are encoded in a single token. Finally, we introduce weight lens as an approach to identify a subliminal trait from the weights of a single trained model, and show that it identifies the trait of nearly every student, including traits that do not surface in generated images.

[NLP-67] Faithful Persona Steering under Incongruity via Dual-Stream Refinement ACL2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决标准大语言模型（LLM）个性化方法中将身份（identity）视为静态检索任务所带来的局限性，即忽视了人类人格特质中稳定特征与情境特定非典型立场共存的本质矛盾。现有方法在处理这一矛盾时表现不佳：提示工程（prompting）在长序列中易受上下文漂移（context drift）影响，而微调（fine-tuning）则常以牺牲个体独特“怪癖”为代价，趋向于学习通用分布模式。为此，本文提出QuirkyMind框架，其核心在于将身份定义（identity definition）与身份表达（identity expression）进行解耦。关键创新在于：首先通过“特质锚定”（Traits Anchoring）构建双流潜在状态，融合句子级摘要以保证语义稳定性，以及词元级序列以实现生成控制；随后利用“上下文叙事精炼”（In-Context Narrative Refinement）通过交替优化目标——判别式InfoNCE损失用于在表征空间中锚定人格以防止漂移，生成式交叉熵损失确保语言表达的忠实性——实现状态的稳定；最后通过“人格引导的泛化”（Persona Steered Generalization）采用参数高效适配器将精炼后的状态迁移至下游任务。实证评估表明，QuirkyMind有效缓解了上下文漂移，实现了人格知识的巩固，同时保留了真实的人格不一致性。

作者: Yu-An Chu,Jen-Ren Pong,Chia-Yao Yeh,Meng-Fen Chiang
机构: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (国立阳明交通大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Standard LLM personalization typically frames identity as a static retrieval task, overlooking the inherent incongruity of human personas, where stable traits coexist with atypical, context-specific stances. Existing methods struggle to reconcile these dimensions: prompting succumbs to context drift over long sequences, while fine-tuning often suppresses idiosyncratic “quirks” in favor of generic distributional patterns. To bridge this gap, we present QuirkyMind, a framework that disentangles identity definition from its expression. First, Traits Anchoring constructs a dual-stream latent state, fusing a sentence-level summary for semantic stability with a token-level sequence for generative control. This state is stabilized via In-Context Narrative Refinement using an alternating objective: a discriminative InfoNCE loss anchors the persona in representation space to prevent drift, while a generative cross-entropy loss ensures faithful verbalization. Finally, Persona Steered Generalization transfers the refined state to downstream tasks via parameter-efficient adapters. Empirical evaluations on Persona-Steered QA and Narrative Inference demonstrate that QuirkyMind mitigates drift, consolidating persona knowledge without erasing authentic incongruities.

[NLP-68] Learning Compact State Abstractions for LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在交互过程中过度依赖完整历史记录作为状态表示所带来的冗余问题，即无差别地保留所有过往观测与动作，导致输入维度膨胀且效率低下。其核心挑战在于如何从交互历史中提取真正必要的信息以构成紧凑的状态抽象。解决方案的关键在于：不通过行为匹配来定义状态的充分性，而是基于任务性能表现来评估状态抽象的有效性，从而避免对黑箱策略的严格模仿；同时，将状态抽象建模为确定性的递归程序，并利用大语言模型引导的遗传算法进行搜索优化。实验结果表明，在ALFWorld和ScienceWorld两个环境中，所学习的状态抽象能够保持接近参考智能体的任务成功率，同时分别将平均策略输入减少71%和57%，且生成的程序具有可解释性，清晰揭示了交互过程中信息的保留、更新与丢弃机制。

类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)

Abstract:LLM agents commonly use the full interaction history as a proxy for state, retaining all past observations and actions regardless of whether they remain relevant. We instead ask what information an agent actually needs to carry forward. We define agent state as a compact abstraction of interaction history that preserves the competence of a fixed reference agent, with the minimal such abstraction as the ideal. Because matching the reference agent’s behavior is unnecessarily restrictive and difficult for black-box policies, we define sufficiency through task performance rather than behavior matching. We represent state abstractions as deterministic recursive programs and search over them using an LLM-guided genetic algorithm. Across ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, the learned abstractions preserve near-reference task success while reducing mean policy input by up to 71% and 57%, respectively. The resulting programs are directly inspectable, providing an explicit account of what information is retained, updated, and discarded during interaction.

[NLP-69] SwarmLeak: Does Coordination Improve Privacy Attacks on LLM Agents ?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在大型语言模型（LLM）代理协作参与群组聊天并访问敏感记录的场景下，多个合谋攻击者是否比单个攻击者更有效地泄露保密信息这一关键安全问题。其核心挑战在于评估群体攻击（swarm attack）相对于单体攻击在信息泄露效率上的优势，尤其是在存在明确保密政策约束的现实应用环境中。解决方案的关键在于构建了首个系统性的红队测试数据集SwarmLeak，涵盖医疗、法律、金融和软件工程四大领域的24种合成群组对话场景，模拟攻击者伪装为同事，通过七种不同对话策略诱导目标代理违反保密协议。研究通过在五个不同目标模型上对比单一攻击者与四人协同攻击（共享私密通道、统一预算）的表现，发现：在相同20万令牌预算下，群体攻击并未展现出显著优势——无论是泄露任意敏感字段的比例（两条件差异不超过14.3个百分点），还是整体泄露程度，均未超越单个攻击者；而受害者模型本身的脆弱性对泄露率的影响远超攻击规模（泄露率在0%至99.4%间波动）。尤其值得注意的是，在最易受攻击的两个模型中，几乎所有实验都导致泄露，但单个攻击者首次披露时暴露的敏感字段比例更高（如Nemotron 3.5 Lightning模型中达85.4% vs. 68.1%）。此外，尽管64.3%的独立攻击能成功检索到敏感数据，但仅0.6%实际发生泄露——表明数据检索不必然等于披露，但在高风险场景中，哪怕一字段泄露也可能造成严重身份识别风险。因此，研究结论强调：在同等资源条件下，更大的红队并不自动意味着更强的攻击能力，受害模型的安全性才是决定性因素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31791
作者: Asma Farajidizaji,Vyas Raina,Vatsal Raina,Ivaxi Sheth
机构: Spark AI Research(火花人工智能研究); Ivaxi Sheth(伊瓦克西·谢特)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 12 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents increasingly collaborate in group chats while holding tool access to confidential records, which makes the shared chat an attack surface. It remains unclear whether several colluding attackers extract such information more effectively than one. We introduce SwarmLeak, a red-teaming dataset of 24 synthetic group-chat scenarios across healthcare, law, finance, and software engineering, where attackers pose as colleagues to make a victim agent post protected fields despite an explicit confidentiality policy. With GLM 5.2 attacking five victim models through seven conversational strategies, we compare one attacker with a swarm of four sharing a private channel, matching scenarios, strategies, and a 200,000-token budget that also covers swarm coordination. Swarms show no advantage: a single attacker matches or exceeds them on every victim, and the share of runs leaking any field differs between conditions by at most 14.3 percentage points, whereas changing the victim shifts it from 0% to 99.4%. On the two most vulnerable models, nearly every run leaks under both conditions, but single attackers expose more of the record at first disclosure (85.4% vs. 68.1% of protected fields on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning). Four of the five victims leaked despite the policy. GLM 5.2 retrieved protected data in 64.3% of individual-attack runs and leaked in 0.6%: retrieval does not imply disclosure, but in high-stakes settings even one leaked field can identify a patient or client. At equal budgets, a larger red team is not automatically a stronger one; the victim model matters far more.

[NLP-70] Byte Patches versus BPE at Matched Data: A Matched-Twin Comparison at 350M Parameters

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型中是否可以通过固定大小的字节块（byte-patch）Transformer完全替代传统基于子词分词（subword tokenization）的解码器，而在保持原始字节序列、文档顺序及优化器步长下训练数据量一致的前提下进行公平比较。其核心问题在于：在不改变输入数据和训练配置的情况下，采用局部滑动窗口的字节级模型（local64）能否在性能上超越或等同于标准的8k BPE分词器（BPE-8k）。解决方案的关键在于设计一个严格控制变量的对比实验——固定原始字节流、文档顺序、每轮优化器步骤的字节数量以及模型参数规模（3.5亿），并采用相同的训练数据量（100亿字节），从而直接评估“无分词”架构（即字节块模型）与传统分词模型之间的有效性差异。研究发现，在多数任务中，尽管BPE-8k在整体比特/字节（bits per byte）指标上表现更优（相对差距分别为-5.2%至-9.3%），但下游任务表现存在分歧：在字符级基准测试（CharBench）中局部滑动模型（local64）占优，而事实推理（fact200）和常识推理（PIQA、ARC-Easy）任务则支持BPE-8k。此外，研究揭示了若干评估陷阱（如上下文长度外推、比特/词误报为比特/字节、分母不一致），这些因素可能误导结论。因此，本研究强调在模型评估中需严格控制输入表示与评价范式，并指出当前字节级模型虽具潜力，但在特定任务上仍难以全面取代基于预定义词汇表的分词机制。

作者: Asadullah Maliyawala,Andrej Lisal
机构: independent researchers(独立研究员)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 18 pages, 3 figures. Code, checkpoints and evaluation suites: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We compare a MEGABYTE-style byte-patch Transformer with a 64-byte sliding local decoder (local64) to a matched byte-level 8k BPE decoder (BPE-8k) under identical raw bytes, document order, and approximately matched bytes per optimizer step: 350M parameters and 10 billion training bytes. Under matched-span document sliding (identical scored byte ranges), BPE-8k leads with relative gaps of -5.2%, -4.9%, -9.3% and -6.1% in bits per byte (overall, text, code, math; paired bootstrap). Downstream, CharBench equal fine-tuning favors local64 (53.7% vs 40.0%), fact200 favors BPE-8k (16.5% vs 7.0%), and PIQA (raw and length-normalized) and ARC-Easy length-normalized favor BPE-8k after Holm correction at alpha = 0.05; remaining tasks are ties. Evaluation pitfalls that changed conclusions include context-length extrapolation past the BPE training context, bits per token reported as bits per byte, and inconsistent byte denominators. Unlike controlled tokenizer studies that vary the subword tokenizer under a fixed token budget, or FLOP-controlled byte-model scaling studies, we hold the raw bytes, their order and the optimizer recipe fixed and ask whether a fixed-patch byte model can replace the tokenizer at all. Limits: one size, one seed, one 8k vocabulary fixed before the runs, and a known difference in embedding initialization between the twins.

[NLP-71] SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决复杂多跳问答（multi-hop question answering）中语义检索在召回率与精确率之间的权衡问题：传统方法在召回时易受干扰项影响，导致答案质量下降，而依赖于查询推理的检索机制难以高效实现。现有图谱增强检索（GraphRAG）虽通过图遍历提升召回，但其多跳扩展过程计算开销大且引入额外噪声。为此，本文提出一种关键创新——将密集检索（dense retrieval）与外部知识图谱（Wikidata）的图遍历进行交错（interleaving），以实现高效且精准的多跳推理。核心解决方案在于：利用密集检索快速定位初始相关文本片段以保障召回，再通过预训练的知识图谱进行路径验证，以恢复精确度并进一步提升召回；为确保图遍历的可适应性与可靠性，采用大语言模型（LLM）将查询转化为SPARQL格式的代码生成任务，但仅解析（parse）而不执行该查询，从而避免因无效查询导致的错误。实验表明，在共享语料库与阅读器条件下，仅用单一配置即在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue三个基准上分别达到62.5/75.1、73.5/81.0和37.1/50.0的EM/F1得分，显著优于复现的HippoRAG2、T²RAG及IRCoT。在令牌匹配设置下，仍保持对T²RAG的优势，且每查询消耗资源接近其水平。若执行生成的SPARQL而非仅解析，则性能下降高达11.4 EM，主要源于空结果而非语法错误，凸显了不执行查询策略的必要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31771
作者: Priyesh Vakharia,Masud Moshtaghi,Pratyay Banerjee,Nicholas Jedema,Amita Misra,Ankit Chadha
机构: Amazon(亚马逊)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted in EACL 2027, Findings

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Semantic retrieval struggles with multi-hop question answering on both recall and precision: gold passages are buried among distractors that degrade the reader’s answer, and retrieving them requires reasoning over the query rather than matching it. GraphRAG techniques expand semantic retrieval by connecting passages to graph nodes and performing one or more hops of expansion after initial retrieval. This improves recall, but multi-hop expansion becomes expensive and brings additional noise into the retrieved set. We break this tradeoff by \emphinterleaving dense retrieval with knowledge-graph traversal for complex multi-hop questions. Dense retrieval locates the first relevant regions of the search space at good recall, while traversal of a pre-existing external KG (Wikidata) restores precision and improves recall by confirming retrieved passages against a reasoning path through the KG. To keep traversal both question-adaptive and reliable, we have an LLM plan it as code generation task for graph traversal in SPARQL format but \emphparse rather than execute the query. On full 1,000-question splits under a shared corpus and reader, and with a single configuration applied identically to every dataset, we reach \textbf62.5 / 75.1 EM/F1 on HotpotQA, \textbf73.5 / 81.0 on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and \textbf37.1 / 50.0 on MuSiQue, ahead of reproduced HippoRAG2, T\textsuperscript2RAG, and IRCoT on all three benchmarks. A second, token-matched setting stays ahead of T\textsuperscript2RAG on HotpotQA and 2Wiki while spending roughly its per-query budget. Executing the generated SPARQL instead of parsing it costs up to 11.4 EM, mostly because raw queries return empty results, not because of syntax errors.

[NLP-72] ACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前AI代理在使用外部工具时面临的安全评估不足问题，特别是针对具有政策约束的工具调用代理（policy-governed tool-use agents）在面对隐蔽且动态演化的攻击时缺乏有效测评基准的问题。现有基准多聚焦于受损工具通道或自适应多轮攻击，难以充分反映此类代理在不中断合法任务的前提下抵御未经授权请求的能力。为此，论文提出TACT-Bench，一个基于情境化故事、角色设定、操纵策略与响应自适应升级机制的状态化评测框架。其核心创新在于构建了对抗性任务与良性任务成对出现的结构（TACT-Base），确保攻击任务始终存在合规解，从而真实衡量代理在政策约束下的安全与实用性平衡。进一步引入TACT-TrustPrime，通过在无关攻击前插入独立良性任务，以检验代理在复杂对话中维持信任的能力。同时提出配对选择性可信度（Paired Selective Trustworthiness, PST）评估指标，综合考察代理拒绝不当请求的明确性与其在匹配良性任务中的表现，揭示其过度谨慎与实际可用性之间的权衡。实验表明，相较于四个基线攻击方法，TACT-Base使攻击诱发失败率（AFR）平均上升17.53%，TACT-TrustPrime再提升17.01%；而现有防御方法仅平均降低AFR 8.35%–9.41%，且未能稳定提升PST，凸显当前政策执行机制仍需强化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31756
作者: Ilia Hashemi Rad,Feijie Wu,Haoyu Wang,Jing Gao
机构: Purdue University (普渡大学); University at Albany (阿尔巴尼大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注: Code and data are available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. TACT pairs each adversarial task with at least one benign counterpart, and its adversarial tasks retain authorized ground-truth actions when a compliant resolution remains available. We define these base tasks as TACT-Base. We additionally introduce TACT-TrustPrime, which places an independent benign task before an unrelated attack in the same conversation. We also propose Paired Selective Trustworthiness (PST), which combines explicit safe refusal with demonstrated capability on matched benign tasks, to analyze an agent’s overcautiousness and practicality. Averaged across 6 different models as assistants, TACT-Base raises Attack-Induced Failure Rate (AFR) by 17.53% over four compatible attack baselines, and TACT-TrustPrime raises it by a further 17.01%. The two evaluated defense methods reduce AFR by only 8.35%–9.41% on average and do not consistently improve PST, underscoring the need for stronger policy-enforcement methods.

[NLP-73] BEARING: Who Is Talking to Whom? Grounding Acoustic Direction in Vision for Online Multi-Party Conversation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多人群体对话中说话人识别（speaker identification）与信息接收者判定（addressee detection）的挑战，即从视频和音频信号中准确判断谁在讲话以及对谁讲话。传统方法通常依赖单通道音频片段的离线处理，并采用自评估奖励机制进行模型对齐，存在依赖标注数据、无法实时响应及对齐不精确等问题。本文提出BEARING，一种以几何信息为先的新型解决方案，其核心创新在于仅使用麦克风阵列从摄像头旁感知到的声音方向这一单一可测量信号。通过无标签校准（label-free calibration）将声音方向动态注册至相机图像坐标系，实现无需注册的在线人脸、语音与方向联合追踪。该方向信息作为三个关键组件：（i）视觉-语言模型的视觉提示，用于标记说话人或指向屏幕外声源；（ii）与视觉活跃说话人检测结果进行可靠性加权融合，提升同向说话人的识别精度；（iii）可验证的对齐奖励机制——被命名的说话人必须位于声源方向，置信度需与此一致，且始终回答“群体”则无法获得奖励。所有决策均在线完成，且具备显式前瞻窗口（lookahead）参数。在AMI三个站点及易穿戴式EasyCom共9,498条带接收者标注的语料上，方向提示使说话人识别准确率由54%提升至74%；接收者识别提升约2个百分点，表明接收者区分更多依赖语义而非空间位置。在AVDIAR数据集上，当说话人共处同一位置时，视觉活跃说话人检测达到95%准确率，而仅依赖方向信息下降至59%。可验证奖励机制在GRPO、奖励排序微调和DPO等对比实验中均优于自评估奖励。缩短前瞻时间从5秒降至0.5秒导致AMI数据集上4.5个DER点损失，而在线学习注册过程在初始两分钟内略有性能下降，但随后超越纯视觉系统。代码与评估协议将公开发布。

作者: Nader Lobandi,Lombe Chileshe,Mohammad Mehdi Hosseini,Mohammad H. Mahoor
机构: University of Denver(丹佛大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: 26 pages, 15 figures, 16 tables. Includes supplementary material. Demo video as an ancillary file

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding a group conversation means deciding, from video and audio, who is speaking and to whom. Leading systems treat these tasks offline on single-channel clips and align models with a self-evaluation reward. We propose BEARING, a geometry-first alternative built on one measured signal: the direction from which a microphone array beside the camera hears a sound. A label-free calibration learned from the stream registers this direction into the camera image, and an online registry of faces, voices and directions needs no enrollment. The registered direction serves as (i) a visual prompt for a vision-language model, a marker on the speaker or an arrow toward an off-screen source; (ii) one input of a reliability-weighted fusion with visual active-speaker detection, for speakers in the same direction from the array; and (iii) a verifiable reward for alignment: the named speaker must sit where the sound comes from, the confidence must match that check, and always answering “group” earns nothing. Every decision is online, with the lookahead as an explicit parameter. On 9,498 addressee-labelled utterances from three AMI sites and egocentric EasyCom, the direction prompt raises speaker accuracy from 54% to 74%; addressee accuracy moves by about two points, because telling one addressee from the group depends on the words more than on where people are. For co-located speakers on AVDIAR, visual active-speaker detection holds 95% where direction alone falls to 59%. The verifiable reward beats self-evaluation under GRPO, reward-ranked fine-tuning and DPO; shrinking the lookahead from 5 s to 0.5 s costs 4.5 DER points on AMI, and learning the registration online costs a dip in the first two minutes before the system overtakes vision alone. Code and evaluation protocols will be released.

[NLP-74] fork() for Agents : Agent Kernel for Non-blocking LLM Orchestration EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体在执行工具调用时因同步执行和失败后丢弃已完成工作而导致的容错性差、恢复效率低的问题。现有方法虽在分布式系统或部分智能体运行时中引入了子图选择性恢复（Subgraph-selective Recovery, SGR）机制，但其依赖训练好的验证器、规划器或事务边界，限制了通用性和实时性。本文提出 Agent-Kernel，一个非阻塞运行时框架，将子图选择性恢复模式引入LLM的内容平面（content plane），其核心创新在于无需依赖训练过的验证器或规划器，仅通过原始异常触发即可实现高效恢复：当节点失败时，仅重执行该节点的传递后代（transitive descendants），同时保留已完成的兄弟节点结果，并通过上下文继承（context inheritance）将父节点文本注入子节点提示中以维持语义连贯性。该方案基于持久化存储，具备形式化的状态保持保证。在14,434次合成与标准基准测试（tau-bench, Gaia2, AutomationBench, InterruptBench）中的实验表明，SGR 在预算=3 时达到100% 的完整恢复率，远超全轨迹重播的55%；且相比适配后的Sherlock回滚机制快约10倍。在串行工作负载上，其准确率与ReAct-serial相当，同时支持并行执行（最高达12.7倍加速），并在结构允许时显著提升效率。消融实验进一步证明，移除SGR后成功率骤降至39.4%，凸显其关键作用。

作者: Ankit Chadha,Pratyay Banerjee
机构: Amazon(亚马逊)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC)
备注: Accepted in EACL 2027, Findings

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-based agents typically execute tool calls synchronously and discard completed work upon failure. Subgraph-selective recovery, re-executing only a failed node’s transitive descendants, is a well-established pattern in distributed systems (Spark, Erlang/OTP, Dryad), and recent agent runtimes (Sherlock, AgentGit, Atomix) preserve completed work through verifiers, version control, or transactional tool boundaries. We present \textbfAgent-Kernel, a non-blocking runtime that ports this pattern to the LLM \emphcontent plane: its primitive, \textbfSub-Graph Recovery (SGR), fires on a raw exception with no trained verifier or planner, resets a failed node’s descendants while preserving completed siblings, and composes each parent’s text into its children’s prompts (context inheritance), all on a durable substrate with a formal state-preservation guarantee. Across 14,434 runs on synthetic and standard benchmarks (tau-bench, Gaia2, AutomationBench, InterruptBench), SGR reaches full recovery within budget=3 where whole-trajectory replay exhausts (100% vs.\ 55%), and is roughly 10 \times faster than an adapted Sherlock rollback that also recovers. It matches ReAct-serial accuracy within noise on linear workloads while adding recovery and parallelism (up to 12.7 \times speedup) where structure permits. Ablation isolates SGR: removing it collapses success to 39.4%.

[NLP-75] CATWAY: Cost-sensitive agent ic three-way robot decisions with calibrated language-model confidence

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型机器人代理在执行指令时面临的关键决策问题：如何在“执行”“询问”或“拒绝”之间做出最优选择，尤其在存在安全风险时，避免不当执行所带来的高昂代价。现有方法未基于误差成本设定阈值，也缺乏对概率的校准，且多在单一领域训练后直接迁移至其他领域，导致泛化性能不足。其解决方案的核心是提出一种成本敏感的三类决策门控机制（CATWAY），通过一个覆盖四种指令状态（明确、模糊、不可行、不安全）的损失矩阵，在概率单纯形上划定执行、询问与拒绝区域，其中“询问”作为信息收集步骤。该机制融合了十次样本投票结果与由逻辑回归生成的模糊性、不可行性和风险等级评分，实现概率融合。模型在家庭指令数据上拟合并冻结后，应用于三个小型模型的文本级决策任务，在两个新机器人领域及外部TRUST-NAV基准测试中均表现优异：在每项决策平均11次生成对比单次提示的情况下，其平均损失（0.28）显著低于直接提示、成本感知提示和无防护代理（0.57–0.83），在所有18个家庭场景中均更优，并在9/18和10/18的新领域与基准测试中具有统计显著性，且从未出现更高成本。更重要的是，它成功避免了全部142条不安全指令的执行。此外，当采用全票一致投票时，最小期望损失规则可将校准简化为单一损失推导阈值，但仅依赖投票的门控策略在部分配置下会错误拒绝明确指令，导致高达0.49的损失，而CATWAY的融合估计则在所有测试集上均有效规避此问题，验证了其综合建模优势。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31694
作者: Erik Derner
机构: Czech Institute of Informatics, Robotics and Cybernetics (CIIRC), Czech Technical University in Prague(捷克技术大学普拉哈信息学、机器人学与控制论研究所)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A language-model robot agent must decide whether to execute, question or refuse an instruction, and an unsafe execution costs far more than an unneeded question. No prior robot gate derives all its thresholds from error costs or acts on calibrated probabilities, and none was fitted in one domain and evaluated unchanged in another. We propose CATWAY, a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate: a loss matrix over four instruction conditions (clear, ambiguous, infeasible, unsafe) fixes execute, ask and refuse regions on the probability simplex, the question being the information-gathering step. Its probabilities fuse a ten-sample vote with graded scores of ambiguity, infeasibility and risk by logistic regression. Fitted on household instructions and frozen, CATWAY was tested on text-level decisions of three small models in-domain, in two new robot domains and on the external TRUST-NAV benchmark. At eleven generations per decision against one, it was significantly cheaper than a direct prompt, a cost-aware prompt and an unguarded agent in all 18 household comparisons (mean loss per item 0.28 against 0.57-0.83), in 9 of 18 in the new domains and in 10 of 18 on TRUST-NAV (Holm per set), and never significantly costlier. It executed none of the 142 unsafe test instructions. On a unanimous vote, the minimum-expected-loss rule reduces calibration to one loss-derived threshold, so for two of six model configurations a gate on the vote alone never executed a clear instruction, costing 0.49 per item on TRUST-NAV against CATWAY’s 0.13 and 0.09; the fused estimate avoided this on every set.

[NLP-76] Right Destination Wrong Journey: Synthetic Counseling Dialogues Miss Human Interactional Dynamics

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型（LLM）生成的心理咨询对话在评估中过于关注回应质量与最终结果，而忽视支持过程随时间演化的动态性这一关键问题。其核心挑战在于如何衡量生成对话在治疗进程（trajectory）上的真实性，即支持策略的渐进性、患者-咨询师间的实时响应一致性等过程性特征。论文提出以“轨迹中心”（trajectory-centered）的评估范式，系统比较真实、重构及合成对话数据集在恢复动态（recovery dynamics）和逐轮响应性（turn-by-turn responsiveness）等方面的差异。研究发现，尽管通过生成设计可调节全局属性如恢复时机与轨迹结构，但生成对话在交互响应性方面始终显著低于真实对话，且该差距在不同模型与生成范式间保持稳定。进一步实验表明，针对性的生成干预虽能在部分轨迹级指标上缩小差距，却无法完全恢复互动真实性，尤其在逐轮响应性维度仍存在局限。因此，解决方案的关键在于构建可控的合成数据集与配套的评估框架，以推动生成式心理支持系统在过程性真实性方面的改进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31686
作者: Ziwei Gong,Yuchen Huang,Nicholas Deas,Melanie Subbiah,Julia Hirschberg
机构: Columbia University (哥伦比亚大学); Barnard College (巴纳德学院); UCLA (加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校); Brown University (布朗大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-generated counseling dialogues are increasingly used for training and evaluating mental-health systems, yet existing evaluations focus largely on response quality and final outcomes rather than how support unfolds over time. We conduct a trajectory-centered evaluation of process fidelity across ten human, reconstructed, and synthetic counseling datasets. Our results show that synthetic dialogues often reach plausible endpoints but differ from human support in recovery dynamics and turn-by-turn responsiveness. While generation design can shift global properties such as recovery timing and trajectory structure, contingent patient–counselor responsiveness remains consistently lower in fidelity across models and generation paradigms. Our experiments on controlled synthetic datasets show that targeted generation interventions can narrow the gap with real data on several trajectory-level measures, but do not fully recover interactional fidelity, with turn-level responsiveness remaining limited. We release three controlled synthetic datasets comprising 2,050 dialogues, together with annotations and the evaluation framework.

[NLP-77] LimoBench: How Street Smart Are Large Language Models ?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在地理空间应用中缺乏真实位置感知能力的问题，即现有模型是否能够可靠地理解并精确回答涉及真实世界坐标、兴趣点（Points of Interest, POIs）及地理空间距离的自然语言位置查询。其核心挑战在于，尽管LLMs在多种任务中表现出色，但其地理空间知识多为模糊或非结构化的内部表征，难以支持高精度的街级空间推理。为此，论文提出LimoBench——一个基于印第安纳州西拉法莱特市真实地图数据的街级基准测试，涵盖7类典型空间操作（如地理编码、反向地理编码、路径规划、范围搜索等），共82个自然语言位置查询，按位置与语义复杂度进行标注，用于系统评估模型的街级空间意识。解决方案的关键是Limo方法，它基于模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP），通过将LLM与后端支持PostGIS的空间数据库对接，引入一组紧凑的空间工具集，实现对模型的精准地理上下文“接地”（grounding）。实验表明，未接地的模型在各类空间操作上平均准确率仅为3.1%（如GPT-6 Luna），而接入Limo工具后，准确率提升至99.3%，且仅带来可接受的额外开销（+0.2秒延迟、7.7倍令牌消耗、2.2倍成本）。研究证明，通过外部空间数据的结构化接入，可显著增强LLM的地理空间认知能力，从而推动更可靠的地理智能应用发展。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31682
作者: Gautam Choudhary,Jack Peng,Udesh Kumarasinghe,Rachel Rafik,Yousef Hammad,Ahmed Samy,Walid G. Aref
机构: Purdue University (普渡大学); University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校); Queen’s University (皇后大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Databases (cs.DB)
备注: Preprint (Under Review). 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) have transformed how humans interact with information, enabling natural-language interfaces across various domains. They are increasingly deployed for geospatial applications including map-based question answering, location-based services, and natural-language interfaces to spatial databases. But are LLMs truly location-aware, able to reliably interpret and precisely answer location queries involving real-world coordinates, points of interest (POIs), and geospatial distances? To answer this concretely, we present LimoBench, a street-level benchmark of 82 natural-language location queries over seven canonical spatial operations: geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, directionality, range search, k -nearest-neighbor search, and spatial join. The queries are grounded in real map data of West Lafayette, Indiana, and are graded by location and semantic complexity. They are designed to probe LLMs’ street-level spatial awareness, from simple lookups to multi-step spatial reasoning. We also present Limo, an approach based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that enhances the location awareness of LLMs. Limo grounds LLMs in PostGIS-backed spatial data through a compact set of tools. We find that ungrounded models mostly achieve single-digit accuracy (3.1% for GPT-6 Luna) across different spatial operations. In contrast, the same models achieve near-perfect accuracy (99.3% for GPT-6 Luna) when given access to Limo’s spatial tools through MCP. Current LLMs thus have limited and unreliable street-level spatial knowledge, while grounding provides accurate answers at modest overhead (+0.2 s latency, 7.7 \times tokens, and 2.2 \times cost for GPT-6 Luna). We release the benchmark, Limo toolset, and evaluation code to encourage the community to evaluate their own location-aware LLM approaches.

[NLP-78] E2SIM: Long-Horizon Simulation of Everyday Human Behavior with Evolving States

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长期用户模拟（longitudinal user simulation）中如何维持用户状态演化与共享环境变化之间一致性的问题。传统方法往往仅关注静态或短期的一致性，难以捕捉用户在工作与日常生活中的目标、兴趣、活动及互动随时间的动态演变，导致行为轨迹缺乏连贯性与真实性。其解决方案的关键在于提出E2SIM框架，通过一个反馈回路将个体状态更新与共享环境变迁相耦合，实现即时行动、延迟后果与个体特定观测之间的动态关联，从而使得早期行为的后果能够影响后续决策，同时保留不同智能体间知识差异。此外，研究还引入一套纵向轨迹诊断指标，涵盖动态一致性、事件进展连贯性、协作能力以及非退化轨迹发展等维度，超越了传统静态一致性评估。在为期60天的仿真中，E2SIM生成的事件线程被评估者判定为更具意义，且近似重复动作显著减少，优于四种直接生成基线模型。该框架及其评估方法为研究长期用户模拟提供了坚实基础，具有在训练与评估长期辅助型AI代理方面的广泛应用前景。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31641
作者: Ziwei Gong,Xiangyang Yin,Thai Quoc On,Lin Ai,Julia Hirschberg,Haotong Yang
机构: Columbia University (哥伦比亚大学); New York University (纽约大学); Microsoft (微软); Peking University (北京大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI agents are increasingly expected to support users over long periods, across work, and daily life. This requires modeling not only who users are, but also how their goals, interests, activities, and interactions evolve over time. A challenge in longitudinal user simulation is maintaining consistency between these evolving states and the consequences of actions in a shared environment. We introduce E2SIM, a longitudinal user simulation framework that jointly models evolving actor states and a dynamic shared environment. E2SIM connects actor-state updates with shared-world changes through a feedback loop linking immediate actions, delayed outcomes, and actor-specific observations across work and life. This allows the consequences of earlier actions to shape later behavior, while preserving differences in what each actor knows. We further propose a suite of longitudinal trajectory diagnostics, measuring dynamic consistency, coherent event progression and collaboration, and non-degenerate trajectory development rather than static consistency alone. In one 60-day simulation, E2SIM produced more extracted event threads judged meaningful by our evaluator and fewer near-duplicate actions than four direct-generation baselines. The framework and evaluation methods provide a basis for studying longitudinal user simulation, with potential applications in training and evaluating AI agents that assist users over extended periods.

[NLP-79] ablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生物医学研究论文中补充表格所包含的结构化数据难以被有效提取并转化为可计算知识的问题。这些表格通常包含未在正文明确表述的知识断言，如基因与疾病、分子与表型之间的关联，但由于统计显著性不足、篇幅限制或叙事范围等原因被排除在主文之外。其解决方案的关键在于开发名为Tablassert的工具，能够将多种格式（如Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet）的表格数据自动转换为符合NCATS生物医学数据翻译器（Biomedical Data Translator）标准的知识图谱。该方法通过用户以YAML格式定义数据映射规则，实现从表中数据到“主体-谓词-客体-限定符”语义三元组的精准转化；同时利用标准化标识符对自由文本进行消歧，并附带溯源信息与统计指标，从而构建可追溯、可推理的高质量生物医学知识图谱。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31614
作者: Skye L. Goetz,Jared C. Roach,Gwênlyn Glusman
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 8 Pages, 1 Figure

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table’s data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ‘‘lung cancer’’) to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).

[NLP-80] raining decision models for simulating human respondents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在市场研究、联合分析及随机实验中作为合成受访者时，因预训练模型固有偏差导致下游计量推断失准的问题。其核心解决方案是采用“系统一架构”（System One architectures）的决策模型，并通过选择训练（choice training）方法，在不依赖目标研究数据的前提下，基于历史个体层面的选择微观数据，利用条件最大似然法更新KEV模型参数。该方法在三个不同规模的模型上均表现出显著性能提升：在四个新领域（疫苗、营养标签、消费者权益与人工智能）的新研究中，处理效应误差降低22%至89%；其中小型经选择训练的模型在三项研究中超越了大型现成生成式模型的表现。值得注意的是，仅在单一研究上进行训练虽可降低交叉熵，但可能加剧处理效应误差，因此选择训练不仅有效弥补了后推断校准的局限性，更为人类偏好估计提供了更优的初始起点。

作者: Davood Wadi,Yu Ma
机构: Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University (麦吉尔大学德绍泰尔斯管理学院); McGill University (麦吉尔大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); General Economics (econ.GN)
