点击查看摘要

Abstract:Researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic respondents in market research, conjoint analysis, and randomized experiments. However, synthetic choice data from off-the-shelf generative LLMs bias downstream econometric inference. Neither proprietary models nor higher reasoning effort reliably reduces this bias. We investigate decision models (System One architectures) for silicon sampling. Using choice training, we update KEV model weights on historical respondent-level choice microdata by conditional maximum likelihood, before inference and without target-study data. Across three model scales, training on two discrete choice experiments lowers treatment-effect error by 22% to 89% on four held-out studies from new domains (vaccines, nutrition labels, consumer rights, and AI) and new response formats. A small choice-trained model outperforms a much larger off-the-shelf model on three of the four studies. Although training on single studies lowers cross-entropy, it can exacerbate treatment-effect error. Choice training thus complements post-inference calibration by providing a stronger starting point for estimating human preferences.

[NLP-81] LUCID: Statistically Grounded Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning Evaluation EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在链式思维（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）推理评估中因系统性步骤评分偏差导致的推理审计失真与解题排名错误的问题。其核心挑战在于，低成本的大规模语言模型评分器虽可实现高效评估，但其主观偏倚（如对计算、验证或后期推理步骤过度严格）会显著影响评估结果的可靠性。为此，论文提出LUCID（Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis），其关键创新在于将提示自修正（prompt self-correction）与基于设计的监督学习（Design-based Supervised Learning, DSL）相结合，在无需重新训练或访问模型权重的前提下，通过少量专家标注数据对评分器进行校准。具体而言，LUCID首先从专家标注样本中总结评分偏差的文本化特征，并以此生成针对性提示，引导评分器对未见推理步骤进行重评。实验表明，在PRM800K数据集上，该方法将GPT-5-mini的预测-专家评分绝对差异从7.8个百分点降至0.9，同时将误报率减半，未达标步骤的错误检测F1值提升32%。此外，该框架具备跨模型、跨领域的迁移能力，可将一个模型的偏差模式用于优化其他模型表现。为提升效率，系统引入预/后检查机制，自动跳过已校准的评分器并回滚无效校准轮次。最终，通过复用专家标注集构建DSL模型，不仅实现了对原始评分的校准与回归去偏，还显著提升了“最佳K选”策略与合理推理路径转移的准确性，其双重稳健估计器在小样本预算下优于仅依赖专家的回归基线，且将合理步骤转移误差降低近三分之二。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31595
作者: Satiyabooshan Murugaboopathy,Adel Daoud,Connor T. Jerzak
机构: AI and Global Development Lab; Institute for Analytical Sociology, Linköping University (林雪平大学分析社会学研究所), Sweden; NLP@DSAI, Chalmers University of Technology (查尔姆斯理工大学), Gothenburg (哥德堡), Sweden; Department of Government, The University of Texas at Austin (德州大学奥斯汀分校), Austin (奥斯汀), TX, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Methodology (stat.ME)
备注: Findings of EACL 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cheap language-model raters grade chain-of-thought reasoning at scale, yet systematic step-rating errors can skew reasoning audits and solution rankings. We introduce LUCID (Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis), which pairs prompt self-correction with Design-based Supervised Learning (DSL). Without retraining or weight access, LUCID calibrates binary step ratings by aligning predicted and expert soundness rates. From a small expert-labeled set, LUCID summarizes rater bias in plain text and prompts the rater to re-grade unseen steps. For example, on PRM800K, GPT-5-mini grades too strictly, under-rating computation, verification, and late-trace steps most acutely. In one pass, LUCID shrinks GPT-5-mini’s calibration gap from 7.8 to 0.9 percentage points in absolute predicted-expert rate difference. LUCID also halves false alarms (sound steps rated unsound) and lifts error-detection F1 on unsound steps by 32%. LUCID retains these gains with 1,000 diagnostic steps or overall-gap feedback alone. The loop also transfers across models and domains: it applies GPT-5-mini’s bias profile to lift GLM-5.2’s PRM800K accuracy, and it narrows calibration gaps for overly strict but capable raters across math, science, web, and logic benchmarks. Because prompt feedback shifts thresholds without improving class-balanced sound/unsound discrimination, LUCID filters re-grading with pre-/post-checks that skip already calibrated raters and roll back ineffective passes. Finally, we reuse that expert set with raw corpus ratings in DSL for calibration and regression debiasing, and apply DSL to pair-labeled steps for sound-step transitions. DSL’s out-of-fold soundness probabilities lift best-of-K selection to match expert labels, while its doubly-robust estimators beat expert-only regression fits at small budgets and cut sound-step transition error by nearly two-thirds.

[NLP-82] GoldiBench: Right Tools Wrong Amount – Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在真实图像编辑任务中面临的“效果判断”难题，即用户通常仅描述期望的视觉效果（look），而非具体操作步骤，因此代理需具备评估不同工具使用强度与参数调整对最终视觉结果影响的能力。现有基准测试无法有效衡量这一能力：要么直接提供工具与参数值，要么开放参数但依赖视觉语言模型（VLM）评分，导致大量未优化结果被误判为成功。为此，作者提出GoldiBench基准，包含500个来自五个专业应用（darktable、RawTherapee、GIMP、Inkscape、Blender）的真实编辑任务，每项任务均以一个已知目标（TARGET）图像作为标准，通过隐藏程序生成，确保编辑量固定；代理需基于起始图像进行编辑并重渲染，与目标对比。该设计将任务拆分为三种情形：完整指令（工具+参数）、仅工具、仅目标，从而分离操作执行与效果判断。实验表明，当给定参数时，各类模型（4B及以上规模）在程序化编辑下表现优异（99–100%通过率），但在仅提供工具或目标的情况下，性能急剧下降——最佳模型在程序路径下仅通过19%，GUI路径下33%，且模型规模扩大未能弥合差距。手册辅助作用有限，仅测量目标与起始图像之间的差异（difference）可显著提升通过率（超过两倍），但以图像形式展示相同差异对开放模型无效。此外，允许四次渲染时，代理几乎总在首次即停止，强制要求比较后，强模型通过率翻倍。核心发现是：当前代理虽掌握工具知识，却缺乏对编辑程度的读取与验证能力，即无法自主判断“用多少”。解决方案的关键在于构建具有明确目标与可量化效果的标准测试框架，并揭示出模型在“效果评估”层面存在根本性缺陷，强调未来需发展具备显式量级感知与自校验能力的智能体。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31590
作者: Wang Yang,Xinpeng Li,Yanyan Zhang,Chaoda Song,Shouren Wang,Debargha Ganguly,Vikash Singh,Chuang Ma,Xiaoran Cai,Kai Ye,Xiaotian Han,Vipin Chaudhary
机构: Case Western Reserve University (凯斯西保留大学); NII, Japan (日本信息研究所); Columbia University (哥伦比亚大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: 20 pages. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Real editing requests describe a look, not the steps to reach it, so an agent that serves them must judge how much of each tool the look takes. Existing benchmarks do not measure this: their tasks either state the tools and values, or leave the amount open and are scored by VLM judges that pass more than half of half- and triple-strength results. We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI. Each task pairs a START image with a TARGET rendered from a hidden program, so the amount is fixed by a known target; the agent’s edit is re-rendered and compared with TARGET, and the same task is posed with the tools and values, the tools only, or the goal only, separating operation from effect judgement. Across 25 open, GUI and closed models, agents operate well (99-100% with programs from 4B up when told the values) but fall off a cliff when they must judge the amount: given only the tools, the best model passes 19% of the tasks with programs and 33% through the GUI, and scale does not close the gap. Manuals barely help; the measured TARGET-START difference more than doubles the pass rate, but the same difference shown as an image does not for open models. Allowed four renders, agents almost always stop after the first; forced to compare, the strong models double their pass rate. Agents know the tools, but neither read nor check the amount.

[NLP-83] SecondChance: Benchmarking Reliable Error Recovery in AI Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前AI代理在执行任务过程中发生错误后，其自我修复能力难以被有效评估的问题。现有评估基准多通过人为注入故障、缺乏用户交互且仅以任务最终是否完成作为评分标准，无法揭示代理是否真正识别并纠正自身隐性错误、是否向用户通报问题，或是否面对不可修复错误的应对策略。为此，论文提出SecondChance——一个基于真实错误的检查点数据集与评估框架，用于系统性地分析和衡量AI代理在错误发生后的恢复行为。其关键在于：错误来源于代理在τ²-bench、BFCL和AppWorld等环境中的真实任务尝试，而非人工构造；在相同检查点下，代理在四种不同恢复条件下（无协助、错误提示、错误位置信息、修复指导）进行续行，从而全面评估包括错误修正、任务成功率、策略合规性、环境状态保持、修复持久性及成本在内的六项核心指标。实验对12个模型在5,760次续行中进行评估，结果表明，即使表现最优的模型在无辅助情况下也仅有16%的恢复成功率，即便有修复指导也仅达27%；更值得注意的是，部分模型虽能修正错误但未能完成任务，或在成功案例中仍保留原始错误，凸显了“错误修正”与“有效恢复”之间的本质差异。SecondChance通过多维度量化分析，揭示了传统任务完成率无法捕捉的关键缺陷，为提升生成式AI (Generative AI) 代理的可靠性提供了精细化评估路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31586
作者: Atahan Dokme,Adar Avsian,Larry Heck
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 18 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables. Code: this https URL . Dataset: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI agents make errors while they act, and their reliability depends on what they do afterwards. Existing recovery benchmarks mostly inject faults, involve no user and score whether the task is eventually completed, so they cannot show whether an agent undid its own silent error, told the user, or faced an error that could not be fixed. We introduce SecondChance, an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that profiles and measures error-recovery behaviour of AI agents. The errors are natural: they come from agents’ own task attempts in \tau^2 -bench, BFCL and AppWorld. Different agents then resume from the same checkpoints under one of four conditions: no assistance, an error notice, the error location, or repair guidance. We measure error correction, task success, policy compliance, preservation of environment state, repair durability and cost. We evaluate 12 models under all four conditions in 5,760 continuations. Recovery is rare: across its environments, the best model completes only 16% of recoveries unaided and 27% with repair guidance. Correcting is not recovering: with repair guidance, Llama-3.3-70B corrects 26% of \tau^2 errors but completes none, and 40 of 84 successful AppWorld continuations leave the error in place. SecondChance exposes these differences that task success alone cannot capture.

[NLP-84] LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中通过连续表示（latent representations）进行隐式通信时，其实际贡献不明确的问题。现有研究虽报告了性能与效率的提升，但未能将隐式通信接口与智能体架构分离，也未深入分析其内部组件的作用机制，导致难以厘清其真实价值。为此，论文提出LatentLens框架，从两个层面解耦隐式接口：外部层面将其与智能体架构分离，以评估其对整体性能的贡献（研究问题RQ1）；内部层面则分解为重对齐兼容性（realignment compatibility）、信息可访问性（information accessibility）与传播动态（propagation dynamics），以识别各组件的优势与局限（研究问题RQ2）。在基于Qwen3模型的七个基准测试中，将相同架构下的隐式接口引入后，性能不仅未提升，反而可能显著下降。内部分析表明，尽管隐式表示能保留部分领域信息，但不兼容的重对齐会严重损害性能，且重复的隐式交互步骤会放大表示层面的错误。因此，尽管隐式表示具备信息保持能力，但并不能自动保证有效通信——有效的隐式通信还需依赖于兼容的重对齐机制、良好的信息可访问性以及稳定的传播动态。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31582
作者: Ziqing Yang,Kewei Cheng,Mingjie Li,Yang Zhang
机构: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security; Microsoft(微软)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Latent interfaces let agents in a multi-agent system communicate through continuous representations rather than decoded text. Prior work reports performance and efficiency gains, but neither separates latent communication from the agent harness nor examines its internal components, leaving its actual contribution unclear. We propose LatentLens, a framework that decouples the latent interface at two levels: externally from the agent harness, to measure its contribution to overall performance (RQ1), and internally into realignment compatibility, information accessibility, and propagation dynamics, to identify the benefits and limitations of each (RQ2). Across seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models, adding the latent interface to the same harness does not improve and can even substantially degrade accuracy. Internally, latent representations retain some domain information, but incompatible realignment can substantially degrade performance, and repeated latent steps can amplify representation-level failures. Thus, while latent representations may preserve information, they do not necessarily ensure effective communication, which also requires compatible realignment, information accessibility, and stable propagation.

[NLP-85] PazaBench: Large-Scale ASR Benchmark for Low-Resource Languages in Africa

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言（low-resource languages）在自动语音识别（ASR）评估基准中代表性不足的问题，从而限制了模型性能的可靠评估与比较。其核心解决方案是构建一个大规模、统一且可复现的非洲低资源语言ASR评估基准，通过整合六个公开语料库，形成标准化的评估框架，并对39种非洲语言上的52个先进ASR模型（涵盖三种架构范式）进行系统性评测。关键创新在于引入架构感知（architecture-aware）的对比分析方法，不仅评估单个模型性能，还系统考察不同模型家族的整体表现差异；同时，量化语言家族间的语言变异性对ASR性能的影响，并开展直接面向低资源部署场景的准确率与效率权衡分析。该工作为低资源语言的ASR模型评估提供了透明、可复现且具备实际部署指导意义的完整工具链。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31578
作者: Mercy Muchai,Nick Mumero Mwangi,Kevin Chege,Samuel Chege Maina
机构: Microsoft Research Africa(微软研究院非洲); Microsoft(微软)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at Deep Learning Indaba 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Low-resource languages remain underrepresented in ASR benchmarks, limiting the ability to reliably assess and compare model performance. We present a large-scale benchmark for automatic speech recognition (ASR) on low-resource languages in Africa. The benchmark harmonizes six public corpora into a unified, reproducible evaluation framework and evaluates 52 state-of-the-art ASR models spanning three model architectural paradigms across 39 African languages on diverse datasets. Models are evaluated using standard accuracy and efficiency metrics, word error rate (WER), character error rate (CER), and inverse real-time factor (RTFx). This benchmark introduces architecture-aware comparison that systematically analyzes both individual models and broader model families. In addition, we quantify linguistic variance across language families, revealing how these factors shape ASR performance across diverse African languages. We also provide a comprehensive accuracy and efficiency trade-off analysis directly relevant to deployment in low-resource settings. Together, the benchmark, evaluation pipeline, and results support transparent, reproducible, and deployment-aware evaluation of ASR models for low-resource languages.

[NLP-86] CLAIMGATE: Cautious On-Device Checking of Spoken Legal and Clinical Claims

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在法律与医疗场景中，未经核实的规则陈述可能在对话过程中误导决策的问题。其核心挑战在于：实时核查需确保核查系统能同步对话节奏、持续监听敏感语音输入，且自身不产生误导性反馈。为此，论文提出CLAIMGATE——一种基于设备端的智能助手，能够实时监听对话、识别可验证的主张（claim），从官方规则库中检索相关法规条文，并基于引用的规则对每项主张作出“支持”“矛盾”或“未覆盖”的判断，同时附带引用来源。其解决方案的关键在于“向沉默失败”（fail towards silence）的设计原则：采用仅4比特量化、70亿参数的语言模型，强制其仅引用检索到的规则进行推理；判决结果通过代码逻辑严格由主张与引用规则共同生成，避免模型自由发挥。实验表明，在真实交通拦截和医疗问诊场景下，使用真实法规文本（如佛罗里达州和德克萨斯州5,742个法条子项，以及美国疾控中心、食品药品管理局和MedlinePlus指南）和真实转录语料进行评估，CLAIMGATE在141个留出测试的交通拦截主张中达到80.1%准确率，严重错误（真主张误判为假，或反之）从20例降至5例；仅通过代码化判决逻辑即可将严重错误进一步降至5例，且不影响准确率。在148个过敏相关主张测试中，准确率达87.8%，严重错误降至5例，显著优于无检索机制的基线模型。此外，系统在8GB消费级GPU上实现平均1.86秒延迟，且95.7%的主张被正确通过，所有日常非主张语句均被拒断，展现出高可靠性与实时性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31569
作者: Peter Forcha,Harshitha Kaje Kusumadhara,Audrey Moguem Souop,Shalom Iboh
机构: University of Florida (佛罗里达大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In law and medicine, a misstated rule can shape a decision before anyone has time to check it. Checking such claims in real time helps only if the checker keeps pace with conversation, keeps sensitive audio on the device, and stays silent rather than mislead. We present CLAIMGATE, an on- device assistant that listens to a conversation, detects checkable claims, retrieves the relevant official rule, and labels each claim as supported, contradicted or not covered, with a citation. CLAIMGATE is designed to fail towards silence: its 4-bit 7B- parameter language model may cite only retrieved rules, and the verdict is derived in code from the claim and rule the model quotes. We evaluate it on traffic stops and medical visits using real official rule text (5,742 Florida and Texas statute subsections; CDC, FDA and MedlinePlus guidance), real transcripts, live speech and author-written gold-labelled claims. On 141 held-out traffic-stop claims, CLAIMGATE reaches 80.1% accuracy and cuts serious errors (a true claim called false, or the reverse) from 20 to 5 compared with the same model without retrieval; deriving the verdict in code alone reduces them from 13 to 5 at no cost to accuracy. The claim gate passes 95.7% of held-out claims and rejects all 30 everyday sentences, and feedback arrives a median 1.86 s after a speech window closes on an 8 GB consumer GPU. On 148 allergy claims, with only the claim gate to rebuild, CLAIMGATE reaches 87.8% accuracy with 5 serious errors, against 20 without retrieval.

[NLP-87] Reading Between the Layers: Where Representation Quality Lives and What Geometry Reveals

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决预训练文本基础模型中表示质量（representation quality）在不同层间分布不集中，而实践中仍普遍选择最后一层进行探查（probing）的问题。核心挑战在于：缺乏标签的情况下，如何无监督地识别出最优的表示层。其解决方案的关键是提出一种名为**稳定几何指数（Stable Geometry Index, SGI）**的全新指标，该指标为闭式表达、完全无需标签且无待拟合参数，综合了幂律拟合质量、有效秩容量、谱稳定性及弱深度先验等多维度特征。通过大规模实证研究覆盖25个模型、四种架构家族与四种预训练策略，发现不同模型的最优探查层存在系统性差异：掩码编码器在中后层达到峰值，序列到序列模型随任务类型变化，对比句编码器在使用CLS或最后词元读出时信号集中在末层但均值池化下则早期峰值，而仅解码器模型则表现出与深度相关的相变结构。SGI在383个评估组中显著优于最后一层基线，将Hit@3从0.39提升至0.52，恢复了约40%接近“理想层”（oracle）的性能差距，且在匹配子集上超越了需监督信息的ELMo式层混合方法，证明了其高效性。此外，消融实验推翻了谱衰减文献中的常见假设——幂律拟合质量比指数趋近于1更有力地预测层质量。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31496
作者: Arnesh Batra,Aniket Khandelwal,Arush Gumber,Krish Thukral,Kushagra Agrawal,Dev Sharma
机构: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi(印第普拉斯特拉信息科技学院, 德里); Manipal University Jaipur(曼尼帕尔大学贾伊普尔分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Representation quality in pretrained text foundation models is not concentrated at the final layer, yet practitioners routinely probe it there because layer selection without labels has remained an open problem. We present a large-scale empirical study of where layer quality lives across 25 models spanning four architectural families and four pretraining strategies, evaluated on 13 datasets across classification, pair classification, semantic textual similarity, and multiple-choice question answering. Peak probing layers depend systematically on pretraining strategy and architecture: masked encoders peak in late-middle layers, sequence-to-sequence models shift their peak with task type, contrastive sentence encoders concentrate signal at the final layer under CLS and last-token readouts but peak early under mean pooling, and decoder-only models exhibit distinct phase structure tied to depth. We distill these findings into the Stable Geometry Index (SGI), a closed-form, fully label-free selector with no fitted coefficients combining power-law fit quality, effective-rank capacity, spectral stability, and a weak depth prior. Across 383 evaluation groups SGI improves over the last-layer baseline and lifts Hit@3 from 0.39 to 0.52, recovering 40% of the gap to the oracle without using any labels, and exceeds a supervised ELMo-style layer mix on the matched subset despite using strictly less information. Our ablations also reverse a common assumption in the spectral-decay literature: power-law fit quality is a stronger predictor of layer quality than the exponent’s proximity to one.

[NLP-88] SwiftLoop: Selective Refinement for Adaptive Implicit Reasoning in Looped Transformers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有循环式推理模型（looped reasoners）在隐式链式思维推理中因采用固定深度循环而导致的冗余计算问题。具体而言，传统方法在每一轮迭代中均对所有潜在位置（latent positions）进行更新，即使某些位置已收敛或无需进一步精炼，仍强制执行更新操作，造成不必要的计算开销。为应对这一挑战，论文提出一种名为SwiftLoop的推理时框架，其核心创新在于通过**位置级冻结（position-wise freezing）**实现选择性递归精炼，从而动态分配计算资源于循环深度与活跃宽度两个维度。关键解决方案是：基于两种互补判据——内部表示层面的键值（K/V）可重用性与输出层面的功能影响性——通过事后指导（hindsight-guided）监督学习轻量级冻结策略；在推理阶段，根据观测到的隐藏状态自适应地触发冻结机制，仅对需要精炼的位置进行更新。实验表明，相较于固定循环结构及现有自适应基线，SwiftLoop在准确率与计算效率之间实现了更优权衡，并显著提升推理速度。此外，该方法还拓展至通用循环模型中的递归提示预填充任务，展现出良好的泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31481
作者: Tianyi Zhao,Ke Wan,Chen Chen
机构: University of Virginia(弗吉尼亚大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped Transformers advance implicit chain-of-thought reasoning through recurrent latent refinement. However, existing looped reasoners typically employ fixed-depth recurrence, updating all latent positions at every iteration and incurring redundancy when further refinement is unnecessary. We introduce \textscSwiftLoop, an inference-time framework for selective recurrent refinement through position-wise freezing, enabling adaptive computation allocation across both recurrent depth and active width. SwiftLoop learns lightweight freezing policies through hindsight-guided supervision derived from two complementary criteria: K/V reusability at the internal representation level and functional impact at the output level. At inference time, these policies guide adaptive freezing based on observed hidden states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SwiftLoop achieves favorable accuracy–computation trade-offs over fixed-loop inference and adaptive baselines, with measured inference acceleration. Beyond implicit reasoning, we further demonstrate its applicability to recurrent prompt prefilling in general looped models.

[NLP-89] Leaks by Installm ents: Cross-Session Answer Disclosure in LLM Tutors and a Ledger-Based Defense

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的辅导系统中存在的跨会话泄露（cross-session disclosure）问题，即学习者通过更换问题表述或使用数值不同的变体重新发起会话，规避现有防护机制，从而间接获取完整解题答案。现有防御机制仅在单次会话内评估回复内容，无法阻止此类策略性规避行为。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种持久化、面向学习者的披露记录账本（persistent, per-learner disclosure ledger），为每个问题构建带有类型标签的解题路径图（typed solution graph）。系统在每次生成回复前，通过匹配回复结果值与结构化的类型标签解题路径，计算学习者当前可推导出的步骤集合，并在该集合包含最终答案或超过预设预算时拒绝释放回复。实验表明，在3000个问题的模拟中，该方案将重编号练习变体导致的答案泄露率从100%降至10.6%，同时保证94%-99.5%的诚实学习者能顺利完成任务；在两个真实LLM辅导系统（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Phi-3.5-mini-instruct）对60个问题的实测中，泄露率分别从0.58/1.00降至0.08/0.18，且诚实完成率保持在98%。该方法未显著提升对拆分请求（split requests）的抑制效果，但所有评估标准均在实验前固定，确保了结果的可靠性。

Abstract:Tutors built on large language models (LLMs) are told not to give away answers, but a learner does not have to ask for the answer all at once. Existing safeguards judge each reply within the current conversation, so a learner can open a new session, reword the problem, or request a worked solution to the same problem with different numbers. We call this cross-session disclosure and propose a defense: a persistent, per-learner disclosure ledger. For every problem a learner brings, the system builds a typed solution graph. Before a reply is released, a gate matches the reply’s own content, not the learner’s wording, against the ledger by result values and by type-labeled solution structure, then computes which steps the learner could now derive. The reply is withheld if that set reaches the final answer or exceeds a budget. In a simulation of 3,000 problems, the ledger reduced leakage through renumbered practice variants from 100% to 10.6% while honest learners completed 94-99.5% of problems. With two real LLM tutors (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Phi-3.5-mini-instruct) on 60 problems, leakage through renumbered variants fell from 0.58 to 0.08 and from 1.00 to 0.18, with 98% honest completion. The ledger did not reduce split requests beyond a per-session gate in the live runs. All acceptance criteria were fixed before each run.

[NLP-90] Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agent ic Training

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体在特定操作框架（harness）下表现不佳的根本原因：当智能体无法完成任务时，究竟是由于缺乏任务所需的知识（task competence），还是由于不具备在特定接口上有效执行知识的能力（interface competence）。其核心问题是区分并解耦这两类能力——任务能力指解决问题所需的知识与推理能力，接口能力则指通过特定框架（如系统提示、动作格式、反馈机制等）有效表达和应用知识的能力。研究发现，单一框架训练可能导致接口能力干扰甚至崩溃，即使任务知识有所提升；而多框架蒸馏虽能聚合跨框架的任务知识，但若未保留或增强推理时所用接口的适应性，则知识无法有效释放。为此，论文提出“框架重演”（harness rehearsal）策略，即在蒸馏过程中使用仅携带少量任务知识但充分训练目标接口行为的轨迹，从而实现对任务与接口监督的解耦。实验表明，仅采用跨框架任务监督或仅使用重演均收益有限，但二者结合可显著提升性能（如在BFCL V3多轮任务中，Qwen3-4B模型性能从58.8%大幅提升至67.3%），远超单独方法。此外，基于策略的强化学习（on-policy RL）相比蒸馏更鲁棒，不会显著损害其他框架下的表现，且能够保留多框架蒸馏所获得的接口能力，为构建通用、稳定智能体提供了关键路径。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability to act on that knowledge through a given harness. Across four reasoning and agentic benchmarks, we show that harness-conditioned training yields vastly different outcomes depending on how these interact. Multi-harness distillation aggregates task knowledge from trajectories collected through different harnesses into a shared policy, but this knowledge is realised only when training preserves or improves competence on the inference-time interface. Otherwise, single-harness training can induce interference in interface competence, sometimes catastrophically collapsing performance on a held-out harness despite improvements in underlying task knowledge. To disentangle task and interface supervision, we introduce harness rehearsal: distillation on traces that carry minimal task knowledge while exercising the target interface. Cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone yields little gain, but their combination yields gains far larger than either: on BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B, they achieve 8.5% and 32.5% respectively, versus 58.8% together. Finally, on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is more robust than distillation to single-harness training: it does not substantially degrade performance on other harnesses, and interface competence acquired through multi-harness distillation persists through subsequent RL.

[NLP-91] CoRe: Jointly Learning Contextual Representations for Understanding and Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态表示学习中理解与生成任务分离导致的表征效率低下问题，即传统方法通常先通过对比学习等手段构建静态语义表示，再独立进行生成或推理，造成信息冗余与模态间协同不足。其核心解决方案是提出CoRe框架，采用统一的上下文表征（contextual representation）同时支持图像与文本的理解与生成，该表征通过从零训练（trained from scratch）获得，并以连续流（continuous flow）形式实现跨模态生成——即从高斯噪声出发，通过可逆变换逐步生成真实数据。关键在于：理解过程不仅用于读取表征，更主动塑造表征结构；而生成过程则在理解所定义的空间内进行，使表征兼具语义组织性与信息保真度。实验表明，在相同数据与架构条件下，仅依赖理解并冻结表征的方法性能劣于联合优化的CoRe，且后者在文本到图像、图像到文本生成任务中均表现更优，同时对提示（prompt）响应更准确。此外，通过注意力分割探针、单目深度估计及冻结语言模型读取等任务验证，生成能力增强了表征的信息表达力，使模型能直接利用自身中间状态进行采样排序与调控，无需额外训练。由于双模态均基于连续流机制，还可高效压缩至少数几步，实现快速推理。控制实验进一步揭示：单一表征足以胜任多任务，因理解赋予其语义结构，而生成则提升其信息容量，二者协同实现高效、灵活的多模态智能。

Abstract:We introduce CoRe, in which understanding and generation jointly shape one contextual representation for images and one for text, trained from scratch. Each representation is read for understanding, conditions the other modality, and is the space in which that modality is generated by a continuous flow from Gaussian noise. With 383M parameters trained on CC12M and no pretrained language model, text encoder, or VAE at inference, CoRe matches a same-data contrastive-only baseline in global understanding and reaches COCO-30K FID 10.10, comparable to much larger generators built on pretrained components. In controlled comparisons at equal data and architecture, CoRe generates better in both directions (text to image and image to text) than a representation shaped by understanding alone and then frozen, and follows prompts better than generating in a space that understanding does not shape. In the other direction, with an attentive segmentation probe, on monocular depth, and when read by a frozen language model, CoRe surpasses the contrastive-only baseline: generation adds information that stronger readouts reach. Because generation runs inside the understanding representation, frozen real-image probes read and steer intermediate states and the model ranks its own samples without extra training. Because both modalities use continuous flows, both also distill to a few steps. Our controls indicate why one representation suffices: understanding organizes the representation semantically, while generation makes it retain more information.

[NLP-92] GHC:Expanding Residual Interfaces in Hyper-Connections

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决超连接（Hyper-Connections）在并行分支中因受限于窄读写接口而导致的性能瓶颈问题。具体而言，传统方法中每个分支仅能读取单一的流混合输入，并将同一输出向量的缩放副本写入所有流，限制了信息流动的多样性与表达能力。为突破这一局限，论文提出分组式超连接（Grouped Hyper-Connections, GHC），其核心创新在于沿注意力头或前馈网络（FFN）通道将每个分支划分为多个并行组，使每组接收独立的流混合输入，并通过可学习权重聚合各组输出至各流。该设计显著增强了残差路径的信息丰富度，同时保持极低的参数量和内存访问开销。实验表明，GHC在密集模型与专家混合模型（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）中均持续优于身份超连接（Identity Hyper-Connections, IHC），训练效率相较Pre-Norm提升35%，较IHC提升10%；此外，通过扩展残差接口，有效缓解了增加流数带来的收益递减问题，使更宽的残差状态仍能带来持续性能增益。

Abstract:Hyper-Connections expand residual capacity across parallel streams, yet restrict every branch to narrow read and write interfaces: each branch still reads a single stream mixture and writes scaled copies of one output vector to all streams. To lift this bottleneck, we propose Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC). By partitioning each branch into parallel groups along attention heads or FFN channels, GHC supplies each group with a distinct stream mixture and aggregates their separate outputs into each stream with learned weights. Extensive experiments across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models show that GHC consistently improves upon Identity Hyper-Connections (IHC) with negligible parameter and memory-access overhead, increasing training efficiency by 35% over Pre-Norm and 10% over IHC. Moreover, expanding residual interfaces overcomes the diminishing returns of adding streams, allowing wider residual states to yield further gains.

[NLP-93] What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations WSDM2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有多模态大模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在社交理解能力评估中对信息操纵行为识别不足的问题。当前主流基准主要局限于粗粒度情绪识别或二元真假判断，未能充分涵盖对话中复杂且多样化的信息操纵策略，如隐瞒（withholding）、泄露（leakage）、虚构（fabrication）、回避（evasion）及防御性反诉（defensive counterclaim）。这些行为需要结合底层事实、参与者知识状态以及对话上下文进行深层次推理，因而难以通过传统方法可靠评估。为此，本文提出InfoCon——一个面向对话中细粒度信息操纵的多模态基准。其核心创新在于：首先，系统识别出六类细粒度信息操纵策略，并基于其事实一致性与交互关系生成粗粒度一致性标签；其次，构建基于证据的多智能体标注框架，利用丰富的上下文证据对标签进行生成与验证，确保标注可靠性。该方案为评估模型在复杂社会互动中的信息操纵理解能力提供了超越二元真假判断的新测试平台。

Abstract:Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.

[NLP-94] LLM Genetic Feature Engineering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决特征工程（Feature Engineering）中传统依赖人工设计所带来的效率低下与主观性强的问题，尤其针对自动化特征构造过程中如何有效平衡特征质量、模型性能与可解释性等关键挑战。其核心解决方案在于提出一种新型遗传算法，突破了以往在整组特征集层面进行选择、交叉与变异的范式，转而实现个体特征级别的操作。这一创新使得算法能够在特征生成过程中实时进行统计分析，从而将个体特征与群体特征层面的度量指标（如当前最先进的特征重要性指标）同步整合至选择机制中，显著提升了特征的相关性、模型的鲁棒性以及整体可解释性，最终在预测性能上取得优于现有方法的成果。

Abstract:Feature Engineering is the (traditionally manual) process of constructing derived variables from an existing dataset by combining, transforming, or otherwise manipulating the original data fields to reduce statistical noise and extract meaningful, domain-specific quantities of interest from the raw dataset. Recent work demonstrates promising progress toward the au tomation of this process through the integration of large language models (LLMs) and various metaheuristics to guide the search for useful features. We build on this approach by introducing a novel genetic algorithm that implements selection, crossover, and mutation at the individual feature level, rather than at the level of the entire engineered feature set. In doing so, we enable in-process statistical analysis of newly-generated features, thereby enabling the genetic algorithm to simultaneously integrate individual and group-level feature metrics into its selec tion process. We demonstrate this capability using state-of-the-art feature importance metrics, and show that this approach yields superior predictive performance while driving meaningful improvements in feature relevance, algorithm robustness, and overall model interpretability.

[NLP-95] Lexical Tone and Word Order Matter in Translation: Prosodic Correspondence Across Languages

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决跨语言翻译中韵律（Prosody）对应性不足的问题，尤其关注在词法声调（lexical tone）和词序差异显著的语言之间，韵律特征如音高（pitch）与能量（energy）在词语层面的对应关系。其核心解决方案的关键在于：通过系统性地对比英语与五种亚洲语言（包括有声调的汉语普通话、泰语、越南语，以及无声调的日语和韩语）的翻译语音数据，揭示韵律对应性的制约因素。研究发现，尽管调整词法声调可提升部分声调语言间的音高对应性，但非声调语言（如日语、韩语）同样表现出低于欧洲语言对的韵律对应性，表明声调属性并非决定性因素；此外，词汇重排程度越高，局部韵律对应性越弱，即使在语义对齐条件下依然如此，说明语义对齐无法完全解释韵律组织差异。因此，该研究强调需建立能兼顾词法声调约束及翻译内容结构语境的韵律建模方法，以更准确刻画跨语言韵律传递的边界与机制。

Abstract:Prosody conveys emphasis, emotion, and intent, yet its correspondence across translation remains underexplored, especially when languages differ in lexical tone and word order. To our knowledge, we present the first systematic word-level analysis of prosodic correspondence in translated speech spanning tonal and non-tonal Asian languages, with comparisons to European-language findings and explicit analyses of lexical tone and word reordering. Building on prior evidence of fine-grained prosody correspondence in European-language pairs, we investigate how these linguistic factors relate to word-level pitch and energy correspondence between English and five languages: Mandarin Chinese, Thai, and Vietnamese, which have lexical tone, and Japanese and Korean as additional comparisons. Correspondence is generally lower than previously reported European-language estimates. Adjusting for lexical tone increases pitch correspondence for English-Mandarin Chinese, English-Thai, and English-Vietnamese. However, English-Japanese and English-Korean also exhibit lower correspondence than the European-language estimates, indicating that tonal status alone does not explain the observed pattern. Greater word reordering is associated with weaker local correspondence even under semantic alignment, suggesting that semantic alignment does not fully account for differences in prosodic organization. These findings characterize the limits of fine-grained acoustic correspondence across translation and motivate prosody modeling that accounts for lexical pitch constraints and the structural context of translated content.

[NLP-96] AhaPro: A Process-level Rebus benchmark for probing Aha moments in LLM reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在推理过程中“顿悟时刻”（Aha moment）的动态演化机制缺乏过程级刻画的问题，现有研究多聚焦于反思性表达或最终修正结果，忽视了顿悟如何在可见的推理链中触发认知重构。其解决方案的关键在于提出AhaPro——一个基于字谜（rebus puzzle）的进程级基准框架，通过将思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）建模为候选答案、证据与验证状态的序列，并采用分层指标评估冲突检测、状态改进及后续采纳情况，从而系统分析模型在顿悟时刻对证据重组与答案修正的行为。实验表明，尽管多数模型能识别冲突并产生更优状态，但普遍存在未能采纳更优状态的现象，且部分采纳行为反而导致状态质量下降；此外，模型常在发现冲突后无法实现有效修正，提示先前推理上下文可能抑制修正效果，而多分支搜索进一步揭示答案选择是连接正确答案发现与成功修正之间的关键瓶颈。

Abstract:Existing research on Aha moments in large language models has largely focused on reflective expressions or final revision outcomes, leaving their role in the visible reasoning process insufficiently characterized. Rebus puzzles encode answers through character forms, spatial arrangements, and homophony. Reinterpreting key details may trigger Aha moments and shifts in the reasoning process and candidate answers. We introduce AhaPro, a process-level benchmark that uses rebus puzzles to examine how models reorganize evidence and revise answers through Aha moments. The framework represents CoT as sequences of candidate answers, evidence, and verification states, using hierarchical metrics to assess conflict detection, state improvement, and subsequent adoption. Across eleven models, we observe frequent failures to adopt better states discovered during Aha moments, alongside adopted revisions that leave state quality unchanged or reduce it. Models also detect conflicts without subsequently achieving an effective revision. Further paired interventions suggest that prior reasoning context may hinder effective revision after conflict detection, while multi-branch search highlights answer selection as a bottleneck between correct-answer discovery and successful correction.

[NLP-97] oneMamaba: Learning Contextualized Tonal Contours with Boundary-Reset State Space Models ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决连贯语流中普通话声调识别的挑战，其核心问题在于上下文依赖性和音长变化会显著扭曲基频（F0）轮廓，从而影响声调判别准确性。为应对这一问题，论文提出ToneMamba，一种具有边界感知能力的状态空间模型，其关键创新在于将传统的静态边界嵌入替换为在音节、词和意群（IPU）层级上的双向状态重置机制，通过固定权重融合多层级表征，并采用共享权重的双向扫描与通道级方向性融合策略以降低参数量。此外，动态音节池化用于构建声调轮廓，而节奏条件门控则引入时长信息以增强对自然语流中音长变异的建模能力。实验结果表明，ToneMamba在读写语音数据集FCU-VOICE-360和对话语音数据集MCDC-8上分别达到97.9%和74.8%的准确率，相较于基线模型ToneNet分别提升0.9和15.9个百分点；消融实验进一步验证了词级状态重置的有效性以及节奏条件门控在对话语音中带来的显著增益，凸显了时长变化在自发性口语中的关键作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31267
作者: Po-Yu Chiu,Yi-Fen Liu
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Sound (cs.SD); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: Submitted to ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mandarin tone recognition in connected speech is challenging because contextual and durational variation reshapes F0 contours. We propose ToneMamba, a boundary-aware state space model that replaces static boundary embeddings with bidirectional state resets at syllable, word, and IPU levels. Fixed weights fuse multi-level representations, while shared-weight bidirectional scans use channel-wise directional fusion to reduce parameters. Dynamic syllable pooling forms tonal contours, and rhythm-conditioned gating incorporates durational information. ToneMamba achieves 97.9% and 74.8% accuracy on FCU-VOICE-360 read and MCDC-8 conversational speech, outperforming the baseline (ToneNet) by 0.9 and 15.9 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that word-level resets are particularly effective, while rhythm conditioning provides greater gains in conversational speech, underscoring the role of durational variation in spontaneous speech.

[NLP-98] Agent ic Systems Need Multi-Run Evaluation: A Study of Retrieval and Response Variability in a Deployed Enterprise RAG System NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式检索增强生成（agentic RAG）系统在评估过程中存在的可靠性与一致性盲区问题。传统RAG系统多采用单次运行（single-run）评估方式，而随着代理型RAG系统的兴起，其组件中存在非确定性决策机制（如并行检索数量的动态变化），导致不同运行间结果出现显著差异。研究发现，尽管在任意一次运行中正确文档的检索命中率为69.4%，但在所有十次运行中均成功检索到正确文档的比例仅为50.9%，表明单次评估可能严重高估系统性能。此外，尽管回答在语义上保持一致（平均BERTScore为0.90），但表达形式存在明显差异（BLEU为0.49）。通过追踪级分析确认，检索阶段是主要的变异来源（占43.9%），其中首次检索步骤中的并行搜索数量变化单独就贡献了20.1%的差异对。因此，该研究的关键解决方案在于提出并验证多轮运行（multi-run）评估的重要性，以揭示单次评估所掩盖的系统不一致性与可靠性缺陷，从而推动更全面、稳健的RAG系统评估范式发展。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31266
作者: Karan Gupta,Sumit Bhatia,Yunyao Li
机构: Adobe(Adobe); Noida, India; San Jose, USA
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages, 6 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET), NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Previous RAG systems have mostly been evaluated in a single-run setting, and with the advent of agentic RAG, systems are still often evaluated the same way. However, agentic RAG systems introduce a source of run-to-run variability, since several of their components make decisions non-deterministically. Such systems typically comprise a retrieval stage followed by a generation stage, and the retrieval stage in particular can behave differently across runs. For example, the agent might issue a different number of parallel searches from one run to the next, which alters the retrieved documents and therefore the final answer. In this paper we study this behavior in a deployed agentic RAG system for product-documentation questions, running each of 739 questions ten times and analyzing the execution traces to find where different runs first diverge. We find a substantial gap between success in any run and success in every run: the retrieval hit rate is 69.4% when the correct page is found in at least one run, but 50.9% when it must be found in all ten. Responses also stay similar in meaning while varying in wording, with an average BERTScore of 0.90 and a BLEU of 0.49. Trace-level analysis shows that retrieval is the largest source of divergence (43.9%), and the number of parallel searches at the first retrieval step alone accounts for 20.1% of divergent pairs. Taken together, these results show that single-run evaluation can hide reliability and consistency issues in agentic RAG systems, and that multi-run evaluation is necessary to reveal them.

[NLP-99] SD-Cache: Learnable Memory Consolidation with State-Guided Dynamic Caching

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在作为持久化服务部署时，因持续积累外部知识而导致键值（KV）缓存线性增长所引发的内存消耗与推理成本上升问题。现有内存压缩方法或通过保留部分缓存状态，或通过学习上下文压缩器将文档映射为紧凑的潜在表示，但在严格内存预算下仍难以有效保留信息对后续查询的有用性。本文提出一种无需依赖未来查询的、基于模型原生KV状态的有选择性信息整合方案——SD-Cache（状态引导且动态更新的缓存），其核心在于通过分层的锚点引导池化与状态引导的精炼机制，将各层的KV状态高效压缩至固定大小的工作记忆中。该方法以单次前向传播完成新上下文处理，无需针对特定任务进行优化，实现在有限内存约束下维持下游任务性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31265
作者: Yuanhong Chen,Yiping Ji,Cameron Gordon,Emily Hackett-Jones,Hemanth Saratchandran,Anton van den Hengel
机构: University of Adelaide(阿德莱德大学); Commonwealth Bank of Australia(澳大利亚联邦银行)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as persistent services that must reason over large volumes of external knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds model responses in relevant documents, but the retrieved content must still be encoded and stored in the key-value (KV) cache. As this content accumulates, the cache grows linearly, increasing memory consumption and inference cost. Existing memory-compression methods address this problem either by retaining a subset of cached states or by learning context compressors that map documents to compact latent representations. Despite these advances, consolidating information under tight memory budgets while preserving its usefulness for future queries remains challenging. We investigate how the model’s native KV states can be selectively consolidated into a fixed-size working memory without access to future queries. To this end, we introduce SD-Cache (State-guided and Dynamically updated Cache), a query-agnostic KV-memory consolidation framework that operates alongside a frozen generator LLM. SD-Cache learns to consolidate layer-wise KV states into fixed-size memory through selective anchor-based pooling and state-guided refinement, processing new contexts in a single forward pass without context-specific optimisation. Experiments on retrieval-augmented question answering and synthetic long-context benchmarks show that SD-Cache maintains competitive downstream performance under constrained memory budgets.

[NLP-100] How Persona Conditioning Changes Open-Ended Task Execution: A Paired Evaluation of Behavioral Gains and Reliability Costs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在角色扮演（persona-based）提示下，其任务执行行为如何被引导与调控的问题。现有研究多关注角色一致性（character fidelity）或整体基准准确率，但忽略了角色设定作为任务执行的引导信号对模型推理过程的影响。本文提出，角色条件化（persona conditioning）本质上是一种任务执行的导向机制，能够改变模型对任务的理解、响应结构及持续性。研究通过真实用户角色扮演日志生成配对样本，并扩展为模拟多轮对话，严格控制任务内容、约束条件、用户模拟方式和评估标准，在八种不同模型上对比有角色与无角色条件下的表现。结果表明，角色条件化显著提升了专家级内容深度与流程一致性，且该优势在长度控制条件下依然成立；然而，其代价是导致每种模型的严格指令遵循准确率下降17至30个百分点，并因角色诱导的过度推演而引入更多未经证实的真实世界细节。这说明角色提示并非通用性能提升手段，而是一种具有明确行为增益与可靠性风险的选择性任务执行策略调整。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31264
作者: Yugyeong Ji,Changho Lee,Yerin Hwang,Taegwan Kang,Jinsik Lee
机构: 42dot; University of Michigan; Dongguk University; LG AI Research
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are often prompted with role- or persona-based instructions, yet persona conditioning has mainly been evaluated through character fidelity or aggregate benchmark accuracy. We study persona conditioning as a task-execution steering signal that changes how models interpret, structure, and sustain responses. Using paired instances derived from real user role-play logs and expanded into simulated multi-turn continuations, we compare with-persona and no-persona conditions while fixing task content, constraints, user simulation, and evaluation criteria. Across eight models, persona conditioning improves expert content depth and procedural fidelity, and these gains survive length control. At the same time, it lowers strict instruction-following accuracy by 17 to 30 points in every model evaluated, and increases unsupported real-world specificity through persona-induced elaboration. These results suggest that persona prompting is not a general-purpose performance improvement technique, but a selective task-execution policy shift with both behavioral gains and reliability risks.

[NLP-101] Evaluating Large Language Models on Iranian Doctoral Entrance Exams in Electrical and Computer Engineering

【速读】： 该论文旨在评估生成式 AI（Generative AI）在高难度专业领域考试中的表现，具体针对2024年和2025年伊朗电气工程（EE）与计算机工程（CE）博士入学考试中的多选题进行测试。其核心问题是：当前主流大语言模型（LLMs）在需要深度专业知识和复杂推理的工程类高阶认知任务中是否具备可靠的准确性和鲁棒性。解决方案的关键在于构建一个标准化、可复现的评估框架，涵盖433道经过筛选的试题（含171道依赖图表的题目），通过零样本（zero-shot）方式在统一商业接口（Perplexity）上对GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5和Grok 4四款模型进行测试，并采用配对检验与问题聚类模型分析差异显著性。结果显示，GPT-5与Gemini 2.5 Pro表现相近且显著优于Grok 4和Claude Sonnet 4.5；同时发现图表依赖型题目显著降低模型准确率（优势比0.30），而电气工程领域的表现劣势可通过图表示例比例更高予以解释。研究还揭示了模型在英文与波斯语题干间的表现差异极小，表明语言转换影响有限。研究释放了逐题响应数据与分析代码，以促进可重复性与进一步研究。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31263
作者: Sima Akbari Neisiyani,Hossein Taghizad
机构: Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières (魁北克大学三河城分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We evaluate four large language models (LLMs) on multiple-choice questions from the 2024 and 2025 Iranian national Ph.D. entrance examinations in Electrical Engineering (EE) and Computer Engineering (CE). Of the 440 questions in the four official booklets, 7 were excluded because the question statement or its figure was ambiguous, leaving 433 questions (186 EE, 247 CE), of which 171 (39.5%) depend on a figure. Each question was presented in the original Persian and in an English translation, giving 3,464 scored responses. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 were queried zero-shot, with reasoning enabled, through a single commercial web interface (Perplexity) in October 2025, using an automated script. Because every model answers the same items, all inferences use paired tests or question-clustered models. Accuracy separates into two tiers: GPT-5 (79.9%, 95% CI 76.6–83.1) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (78.4%, 74.8–81.9) are statistically indistinguishable, and both outperform Grok 4 (71.7%) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (71.3%) by 6.7–8.7 percentage points (Holm-adjusted p 0.001 ). The English–Persian accuracy difference is small for every model ( -0.2 to +2.5 points; exact McNemar p \ge 0.28 ). For three models the 90% confidence interval lies within \pm 5 points, so differences larger than this can be excluded. Questions with figures are much harder: the odds ratio is 0.30 (95% CI 0.21–0.43) after adjusting for discipline. The apparent EE deficit of two models disappears once the larger share of figure-based EE items is accounted for. We describe the dataset, the protocol and its limitations, including the uncontrolled web-retrieval and decoding settings of the interface, and release item-level responses and analysis code.

[NLP-102] RegioZH: Unveiling Comprehension Disparities across Regional Chinese Varieties in LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大语言模型（LLM）评估中将汉语方言视为同质整体的问题，这一做法掩盖了区域用户在本地化语言使用中的表现缺陷。其核心解决方案是提出一个包含2,607个多项选择题的基准测试集——RegioZH，覆盖中国大陆、台湾、香港、新加坡和马来西亚五个地区，专门针对区域词汇推理任务。该基准由各地区本土标注者构建并经专家验证，涵盖地方习语、俚语、语码混用、礼貌规范及社会文化表达等关键语言现象。实验表明，11个主流大模型在零样本测试下表现出显著差异，如台湾与新加坡之间平均准确率差距达29.4个百分点。通过引入角色扮演（persona）和结构化思维链（structured chain-of-thought）提示，部分模型获得选择性提升，暗示错误根源不仅在于知识缺失，更涉及检索或表述框架问题。进一步的表征分析、注意力机制、校准度及表面特征分析揭示：模型对语言标记的关注与其语义基础之间存在脱节，且存在过度自信的强制选择错误；而局部词汇密度被证实为稳定的难度预测因子。定性分析还发现术语误解、社会文化推理断层以及跨区域语义分歧等问题。研究证明，表面的汉语能力表现可能掩盖不同区域变体间理解不均的现象，强调应在多语言泛化之外，加强同一语言内部的区域鲁棒性评估。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31262
作者: Weihua Zheng,Wu Kui,Thong T. Doan,Lin Jingxia,AiTi Aw,Nancy F. Chen,Roy Ka-Wei Lee
机构: Institute of Advanced Intelligence and Computing (IAIC), A*STAR, Singapore; Singapore University of Technology and Design; Nanyang Technological University; University of British Columbia
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Current evaluations often treat Chinese varieties as monolithic, obscuring failures for regional users. We introduce RegioZH, a 2,607-item multiple-choice benchmark for regional lexical reasoning across Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia. Built by region-specific annotators and expert-validated, it targets localized idioms, slang, code-mixing, politeness conventions, and sociocultural expressions. Zero-shot results on eleven LLMs show large disparities, including a 29.4-point average accuracy gap between Taiwan and Singapore. Persona and structured chain-of-thought prompts for five models yield selective gains, suggesting that some errors stem from retrieval or framing rather than only missing knowledge. Representation, attention, calibration, and surface-feature analyses show a dissociation between marker attention and semantic grounding, overconfident forced-choice errors, and localized lexical density as a consistent difficulty predictor. Qualitative analysis finds terminology misunderstandings, sociocultural inference gaps, and cross-regional semantic divergence. RegioZH demonstrates that apparent Chinese proficiency can mask uneven understanding across regional varieties, motivating intra-language robustness evaluation alongside multilingual generalization.

[NLP-103] Does Item Response Theory Generalize Across Languages? Evidence from Cross-Lingual LLM Benchmarks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在多语言环境下，项目反应理论（Item Response Theory, IRT）用于基准测试数据筛选时的跨语言泛化问题。传统上，IRT的应用主要局限于单语场景，而本文探讨了同一基准测试在不同语言间翻译后，IRT模型参数的稳定性及其对模型排名保持能力的影响。研究在涵盖超过100个语言模型和11种语言的多语言GSM与Global MMLU数据集上进行了实验，分别拟合每种语言的一参数（1PL）、二参数（2PL）和三参数（3PL）IRT模型。结果表明，项目难度是跨语言最稳定的参数，其次是猜测参数，而区分度参数则表现出较差的稳定性；此外，通过项目差异分析发现，部分题目的不稳定性可归因于翻译过程中的语义偏移。因此，该研究的关键解决方案在于强调：在多语言场景下进行基于IRT的数据筛选时，必须同时具备参数敏感性和题目敏感性，即不仅要关注模型参数的跨语言一致性，还需对具体题目进行逐项评估，以确保筛选出的子集能够有效保留模型间的相对排名，从而验证模型选择的合理性并避免对跨语言泛化的盲目假设。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31261
作者: Ruchira Dhar,Qiwei Peng,Anders Søgaard
机构: University of Copenhagen(哥本哈根大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (Findings)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The application of Item Response Theory (IRT) for data selection in benchmarks has mostly been limited to monolingual settings. In this work, we ask: how does IRT generalize when the same benchmark is translated across languages? We conduct experiments on Multilingual GSM and Global MMLU, covering over 100 language models and 11 languages. Fitting 1PL, 2PL, and 3PL IRT models per language, we assess cross-lingual consistency of parameters and whether IRT-filtered subsets preserve model rankings across languages: item difficulty emerges as the most stable parameter followed by guessing and then discrimination. A differential item analysis also shows that lack of stability can be tracked to specific items shifting under translation across languages. Our findings suggest IRT-based selection in multilingual settings must be both parameter-aware and item-aware, validating model choice and screening individual items before assuming cross-lingual generalization.

[NLP-104] Capability and Interpretability of Transformers on Multi-task Recurrence

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型（Generative AI）中变压器（Transformer）架构在语言任务中内部工作机制理解不足的问题，尤其关注其对语言规则的建模与泛化能力。研究聚焦于通过一组受控的线性递归任务（linear recurrence tasks）在有限循环群上的表现，系统考察Transformer在执行单一固定规则、从上下文中识别潜在规则以及在显式指定规则间切换等不同场景下的能力差异。研究发现，对于大多数情况，规则间的切换比识别隐含规则更为简单；同时，模型深度、宽度及递归关系的代数结构是影响其泛化性能的关键因素。当规则数量较多时，课程学习（curriculum training）能显著提升模型表现。借助机制可解释性工具如线性探针（linear probing）和输入修补（input patching），研究揭示了Transformer如何表征、识别并执行多种规则，从而为深入理解其内在计算机制提供了可解释性支持。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31260
作者: Xiamin Chen,Linyu Liu,Jiachen Hu,Pinyan Lu
机构: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics; Taylor Lab, Huawei Technologies Ltd.
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Transformers are widely used in various language tasks, with limited understanding of their internal mechanisms. Motivated by the recurrent structure of many linguistic rules, we study the capability and interpretability of Transformers through a controlled family of linear recurrence tasks over finite cyclic groups. These tasks range from executing a single fixed rule to identifying a latent rule from context and switching between explicitly specified rules, with and without input masking. Through extensive experiments across different configurations, we find that switching specified rules is simpler than identifying latent rules for Transformers in general. We also identify how several key factors affect the generalization capability of Transformers, including the depth, width, and the algebraic structure of the linear recurrence. Curriculum training is extremely useful when the number of rules is large. With standard tools in mechanistic interpretability like linear probing and input patching, our study reveals how Transformers represent, identify, and execute multiple rules.

[NLP-105] RecipeADQA: A User-aware Question-Answering Dataset for Multi-Constraint Recipe Recommendation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自然语言问答式食谱推荐任务中缺乏具有真实标注（ground-truth labels）的基准数据集的问题。现有方法通常通过简单组合食材或标签约束生成数据，导致问题表达不自然、约束不合理，难以反映用户真实偏好。其解决方案的关键在于：基于真实用户行为，利用大语言模型（LLM）从外部用户查询与评论数据中提取细粒度偏好信号，并将其映射至基于知识图谱的标签体系，从而构建包含偏好与食材约束的问答数据。此外，采用贪心策略控制约束数量以调节答案规模，并引入基于标签的重排序机制提升数据质量。最终生成的 RecipeADQA 数据集包含自然语言问题、结构化约束及答案集合，共 128,465 条实例。实验表明，该数据集在覆盖率、问题自然性与约束合理性方面均优于基线数据集，且显著提升检索-推荐性能。同时，作者设计了一种噪声增强的“检索-重排序”模型，其中轻量级解析器先召回候选食谱，小规模语言模型再从噪声候选池中筛选并排序相关结果，该模型在 RecipeADQA 上训练后表现更优。相关代码与数据已开源。

作者: Haotian Li,Shuai Jiang,Sayaka Kamei,Yasuhiko Morimoto
机构: Hiroshima University (广岛大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted as Full Paper for presentation at the 22nd International Conference on Advanced Data Mining and Applications 2026 (ADMA 2026)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Question-answering recipe recommendation tasks lack datasets with ground-truth labels. Existing methods often generate datasets from simple combinations of ingredient or tag constraints, leading to unnatural expressions and unreasonable constraints that are hard to reflect users’ real preferences. This paper proposes a construction method for a benchmark-style QA dataset for natural-language recipe recommendation. Driven by real user behavior, our method integrates external user query and review data to extract fine-grained preference signals by LLMs and maps them onto a knowledge-graph-based tag schema, thereby constructing QA data consisting of preference and ingredient constraints. Besides, a greedy strategy for constraint selection is also used to control the answer size, while tag-based re-ranking is applied to improve data quality. The generated dataset RecipeADQA contains natural-language questions, structured constraints, and answer sets, resulting in 128,465 instances. Experiments compare RecipeADQA with baseline datasets from two perspectives: data quality and retrieval-recommendation performance. The results show that ours outperforms existing methods on the same recipe knowledge graph in coverage, higher question quality in naturalness and constraint rationality, and better queryability. Moreover, we design a noise-augmented retrieve-and-rerank model, in which a lightweight parser first retrieves candidate recipes, and a small language model then selects and ranks relevant recipes from a noisy candidate pool. The model trained on RecipeADQA outperforms the same model trained on the baseline datasets. The relevant construction code and data have been open-sourced at a GitHub repository this https URL.

[NLP-106] RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型智能体在有限上下文预算下处理长时程任务时，如何有效进行上下文压缩（context compaction）的问题。核心挑战在于：压缩摘要的质量会通过多轮交互持续影响任务成功率，而传统方法仅依赖任务奖励信号进行训练，难以实现对摘要生成与后续行为的协同优化。其解决方案的关键是提出RECAP框架，基于“摘要应保留原始交互历史所诱导的行为模式”这一原则，引入行为失真目标（behavior distortion objective），量化压缩前后代理行为的差异。该目标的梯度可分解为两个互补的学习信号：一是用于摘要生成的失真奖励信号，二是用于后续动作选择的自蒸馏（self-distillation）信号。实验表明，RECAP在Qwen3.5-4B模型上显著优于仅使用任务奖励的强化学习基线，在BrowseComp-plus和SWE-bench Verified任务上分别取得4.6%和4.3%的绝对性能提升，且消融实验证明联合监督摘要生成与压缩后行为对性能至关重要。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31258
作者: Yulun Jiang,Maria Brbic,Michael Moor
机构: EPFL(洛桑联邦理工学院); ETH Zurich(苏黎世联邦理工学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent’s subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. Ablations further highlight the value of jointly supervising summary generation and post-compaction behavior for RECAP.

[NLP-107] scOPD: Routed On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM -Based Single-Cell Annotation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在单细胞注释任务中面临的两大核心挑战：一是现有训练方法依赖标量结果奖励，缺乏对中间生物推理过程的细粒度监督，导致模型难以捕捉复杂的生物学逻辑；二是批处理（batch-level）注释面临局部细胞身份识别与全局一一匹配约束之间的耦合难题，单一错误可能引发连锁性误判，且单次推理提供的证据不足，难以有效识别和修正不确定性预测。针对上述问题，本文提出一种基于策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）的框架scOPD，其关键创新在于：在训练阶段，通过自适应路由机制将高质量的推理轨迹（rollouts）送入基于奖励的优化路径，而错误轨迹则获得来自成功“兄弟”轨迹的特权级标记级别监督，从而实现细粒度的推理引导；在推理阶段，引入基于约束感知的成对精炼机制，当多个推理轨迹出现分歧时，触发对不确定注释的迭代修正。该方法显著提升了多种主流LLM骨干网络在跨域疾病数据集上的性能，尤其在批量注释任务中表现突出，以Qwen3-8B为例，实现了81.71%的细胞级准确率和44.49%的批级准确率，验证了其在复杂注释场景下的鲁棒性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31257
作者: Zhiyin Yu,Yuchen Mou,Songtao Huang,Shuaiyu Zhang,Xing Wei,Chunchun Chen,Wei Ye,Xiao Luo,Zhonghai Wu,Xiangchao Yan,Lei Bai,Shiyang Feng,Bo Zhang
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for single-cell annotation, but existing training methods mainly rely on scalar outcome rewards that provide limited supervision for intermediate biological reasoning. Batch-level annotation is particularly challenging because it requires jointly resolving local cell identities and a global one-to-one matching constraint, such that one local error can affect the entire assignment. Moreover, a single inference pass provides insufficient evidence for locating uncertain predictions. These limitations call for fine-grained reasoning supervision during training and uncertainty-aware refinement during inference. Results: To address these challenges, we propose scOPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based single-cell annotation. After reasoning fine-tuning, scOPD adaptively routes qualified rollouts to reward-based optimization, while erroneous rollouts receive privileged token-level supervision from successful sibling trajectories. During inference, rollout disagreement triggers constraint-aware pairwise refinement of uncertain assignments. Across CellPuzzles and four out-of-domain disease datasets, scOPD consistently improves the performance of diverse LLM backbones, achieving average cell-level and batch-level accuracies of 81.71% and 44.49% with Qwen3-8B. Availability and Implementation: Code and data are available at this https URL. [NLP-108] Directly Maximizing On-policy Expected Accepted Length for Speculative Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）中推测解码（speculative decoding）技术在实际应用中的效率瓶颈问题，即当前基于轻量级草稿模型（draft model）的采样策略未能有效优化被目标模型接受的前缀长度。由于一旦草稿序列中的某个词元被拒绝，其后所有后续词元均被丢弃，因此传统方法通过词元级分布对齐进行草稿训练，并不能直接提升可接受前缀的期望长度。为此，论文提出 FreDraft，一种基于策略的在线训练方法，其核心在于直接最大化从当前草稿模型采样的草稿序列中被接受前缀的期望长度。该目标显式考虑了首次拒绝截断（first-rejection truncation）的影响，并引入前缀感知的信用分配机制，按每个词元对当前及后续词元接受概率的贡献程度进行加权。为高效优化该目标，论文采用分析方式对词元级接受率进行边缘化处理，利用目标模型的词汇分布降低梯度方差；同时，将部分分布级梯度重新分配至一个显式的惩罚项，用于纠正草稿模型对采样词元概率的过高估计，同时保持期望梯度不变。实验结果表明，FreDraft 在多个基准测试和目标模型上均显著提升了接受前缀长度与解码加速比，且实现了更快的在线策略训练收敛速度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31256
作者: Ziying Zhang,Yaqing Wang,Yong Liu,Quanming Yao
机构: Tsinghua University (清华大学); Zhongguancun Academy; BIMSA; Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University (中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens for verification by a target model. Draft training commonly optimizes token-level distribution alignment, but this does not directly optimize the length of the accepted prefix: once a draft token is rejected, all subsequent draft tokens are discarded. We propose FreDraft, an on-policy training method that directly maximizes the expected accepted length of drafts sampled from the current draft model. This objective accounts for first-rejection truncation and induces prefix-aware credit assignment, weighting each token by its contribution to the acceptance of the current and subsequent tokens. To optimize the objective efficiently, we analytically marginalize token-level acceptance rate, using the target model’s vocabulary distribution to reduce gradient variance. We further redistribute part of this distribution-level gradient into an explicit penalty for sampled tokens whose probabilities are overestimated by the draft model, while preserving the expected gradient. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and target models show that FreDraft improves accepted length and decoding speedup over strong baselines, achieving faster on-policy training convergence.

[NLP-109] INCLUDE-2.0: Disentangling Knowledge Gaps in Multilingual LLM Evaluation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有多语言评估基准在语言覆盖范围与区域知识表征上的双重局限性：一方面，当前基准仅涵盖预训练语料库中极小部分的语言，另一方面，其常将语言能力误作区域知识能力的代理，忽视了问题答案对特定地域与社区背景的依赖性。为应对这一挑战，作者提出INCLUDE-2.0——一个大规模、面向区域感知的多语言事实性评估基准，覆盖86个国家的91种语言（共127个语言-国家组合），包含超过22万条来自本地区域来源的精心筛选样本。其解决方案的关键在于：明确区分四类不同类型的区域知识——与上下文无关的事实、因国家而异的答案、广泛记录的地区事实，以及主要通过本地语言与文化表达的知识，并对每条数据标注其区域知识类型与领域，同时提供英文翻译，从而实现对语言能力与区域知识掌握程度的解耦分析。实验表明，前沿模型在本地嵌入型知识上的表现显著低于对普遍记录事实的处理能力（平均下降约14.5个百分点），且开源模型虽随规模提升准确率，但其性能仍受提问语言（英语或原生语言）影响，不具备稳定性。因此，INCLUDE-2.0为评估模型在跨语言、跨区域知识理解中的真实能力提供了更精细、可控制的评测框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31255
作者: Angelika Romanou,Maria Grandury,Clara Meister,Negar Foroutan,Jabez Magomere,Anna Sotnikova,Hitesh Laxmichand Patel,Akshay Kumar Dubey,Alfonso Amayuelas,Amit Agarwal,Arion Das,Carlos Arriaga,Cheng Yu,Dalia Ali,David Quispe-Castillo,Fenal Ashokbhai Ilasariya,Francisco-Javier Rodrigo-Gines,Gonzalo Martinez,Gouthami Vadithya,Guido Ivetta,Javier Conde,Jorge Vallego,Juan J. Cumbicus-Pineda,Priyaranjan Pattnayak,Reewos Erwin Talla Chumpitaz,Sahil Aggarwal,Sahil Raj,Shruti Jalan,Srikant Panda,Susana Zhou,Yeshil Bangera,Orestis Papakyriakopoulos,Scott A. Hale,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad,Antoine Bosselut
机构: EPFL(洛桑联邦理工学院); University of Oxford(牛津大学); Technical University of Munich(慕尼黑工业大学); Imperial College London(帝国理工学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Current multilingual benchmarks cover only a fraction of the languages represented in modern pretraining corpora and often conflate language proficiency with the ability to answer questions grounded in specific regions and communities. We introduce INCLUDE-2.0, a large-scale benchmark for region-aware multilingual factual evaluation, which covers 91 languages from 86 countries (127 total language–country pairs), comprising over 220K curated samples drawn from native regional sources. Unlike existing benchmarks that often treat language as a proxy for region, IINCLUDE-2.0 distinguishes between questions whose answers are independent of context, vary by country, concern widely documented facts about a place, or depend on knowledge primarily expressed through local linguistic and cultural sources. Each item is annotated with its regional knowledge type and domain, and paired with an English translation, enabling controlled analysis of the relationship between language proficiency and possession of regional knowledge. Evaluating frontier and open-weight models on IINCLUDE-2.0, we find that aggregate multilingual accuracy masks substantial variation across regional knowledge types, languages, and regions. We find that frontier models perform worse on locally embedded knowledge than on widely documented facts about regions, with an average drop of ~14.5 points. We also show that for open-weight models, scale improves accuracy but does not reliably make performance invariant to whether a question is asked in English or its original language. [NLP-110] he Date You Didnt Set: The System-Prompt Date as a Hidden Variable in LLM Evaluation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决指令微调模型在评估过程中因系统提示（system prompt）中自动填充的日期变化而导致评估结果不可靠的问题。其核心问题是：尽管评估配置、解码策略和输入提示保持不变，仅因系统提示中的日期每日自动更新，便可能显著影响模型输出的正确性与一致性，从而导致评估结果出现虚假波动。解决方案的关键在于识别并控制这一隐含变量——即固定系统提示中的日期，以确保评估的可重复性与可靠性。研究发现，在六种指令微调模型与四个基准测试中，仅改变日期（如2024年与2026年）即可使中位数6.6%的测试项在正确与错误之间切换，甚至在某些情况下导致模型性能下降达36.5分；此外，日期变更还会影响大语言模型判题（LLM-judge）的判断，并逆转15%–32%的越狱攻击重现成功率。然而，当前主流评估框架均未显式记录或锁定日期。研究证实，一旦固定日期及其他所有参数，评估可实现字节级复现。因此，作者建议在评估中明确“钉住（pin）”、记录并报告系统提示中的日期，以保障评估的严谨性与可比性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31254
作者: Noureldin Zahran,Mohammed E. Fouda,Khaled N. Khasawneh
机构: George Mason University (乔治梅森大学); Compumacy AI Solutions; Cairo, Egypt
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The system prompt of many instruction-tuned models carries a date, usually today’s, filled in automatically for conversational and agentic requests alike, so an unchanged evaluation can send a different prompt each day. In this paper, we explore how much this hidden input changes evaluation outcomes. Across six instruction-tuned models and four benchmarks, with prompts, decoding, and configuration fixed, every model is affected: two plausible dates (2024–2026) switch a median 6.6% of test items between correct and incorrect. Even rerunning the evaluation one day later flips about as many items as changing the batch size, although nothing in the setup was changed. In addition, using a grammar-constrained variant of Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) to search dates of any year, we find dates that cost the Llama-3.x models up to 36.5 points of held-out accuracy. Beyond accuracy, switching to another plausible date alters LLM-judge verdicts and undoes 15 – 32% of reproduced jailbreak successes on Llama-3.2-3B. Yet none of the eleven evaluation stacks we audit pins the date. With the date and the rest of the setup fixed, reruns reproduce byte-for-byte; we therefore recommend pinning, logging, and reporting the date.

[NLP-111] Instantiation of Human Values in Image Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在文本到图像（Text-to-Image, T2I）模型中如何将抽象人类价值观转化为视觉场景这一关键问题，尤其关注这些模型在价值具象化（value instantiation）过程中的系统性偏差。其核心解决方案基于舒瓦茨（Schwartz）的基本人类价值观理论，构建了一个分析框架，通过使用来自70个正负向价值项目的个性化提示词，生成28,000张图像，并识别出具有代表性的视觉原型（visual prototypes），即主体、行为与场景的重复性组合模式。研究进一步将这些原型映射至涵盖情境、社会性、互动方式及社会关系维度的社会配置分类体系，揭示了模型在价值呈现中的结构性偏倚。结果显示，相较于人类对同一价值的描述，T2I模型表现出高度集中的具象化倾向，其默认采用一种超个人主义、以成人为中心的世界观，将成就与正式制度环境绑定，将享乐主义表现为富裕消费，而系统性忽略日常劳动、关系性关怀以及非成人视角。作为概念验证，研究提出一种无需修改原始提示词即可通过结构化偏差引导实现输出多样化的控制方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31253
作者: Maria-Teresa De Rosa Palmini,Piera Riccio,Noa Garcia,Eva Cetinic
机构: University of Zurich(苏黎世大学); University of Amsterdam(阿姆斯特丹大学); The University of Osaka(大阪大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly embedded in everyday visual culture, yet little is known about how they translate abstract human values into visual scenes. We address this gap by introducing a framework, grounded in Schwartz’s theory of basic human values, for studying value instantiation: the process by which ideals such as success, care, or freedom are visually realized. Using person-centered prompts from 70 positive and negative value items, we generate 28,000 images across four state-of-the-art T2I models. We identify visual prototypes, recurring combinations of subjects, actions, and settings, and use them to quantify how narrowly models instantiate these values and how this breadth compares with human descriptions of the same items. We then map these prototypes onto a taxonomy of social configurations spanning setting, sociality, mode of engagement, and social register, revealing what is systematically foregrounded or omitted. Our results show that T2I models produce far more concentrated representations than humans do when describing the same values. They default to a hyper-individualistic, adult-centric worldview, reproducing value-specific associations, such as achievement tied to formal institutional settings or hedonism rendered as affluent consumption, while marginalizing everyday labor, relational care, and non-adult perspectives. As a proof of concept, we show that these structural gaps can guide a steering method that diversifies outputs without modifying the original prompt.

[NLP-112] DAGGER: Deployment-Free Quality Estimation for Generative AI Workflows

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI工作流（generative AI workflows）端到端质量评估的难题，其核心挑战在于工作流由多个阶段组成，各阶段间存在输出依赖关系，错误可能在阶段间传播，导致整体性能不仅取决于单个模型的准确性，还受各阶段输出对下游影响的耦合效应。传统方法需部署并评估所有可能的模型配置组合以评估质量，但此类全量部署成本过高，难以实际应用。现有方法面临估算成本与精度之间的权衡：低成本方法往往结果不可靠，而高精度方法则需大量部署开销。本文提出DAGGER框架，通过将工作流建模为有向图（DAG），其中节点代表处理阶段、边表示阶段间的输出依赖关系，将整体质量分解为节点级准确率项与边级依赖项。结合一种新颖的解析建模方式与基于奇异值分解（SVD-based matrix completion）的稀疏观测补全技术，DAGGER能够在不执行全部候选配置的前提下，高效估计工作流质量。实验表明，DAGGER在三个数据集上的三个生成式AI工作流中，实现了中位数6.8个百分点的误差，并相较当前最优基线BenchPress降低了10.2倍的调优成本，同时所选工作流配置性能可媲美LLMSelector等先进框架。其解决方案的关键在于利用图结构建模与矩阵补全技术，在极低部署开销下实现高精度的质量预测。

作者: Dimitrios Liakopoulos,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Estimating the quality of generative AI workflows is challenging because these workflows comprise multiple stages, and errors can propagate across them, making end-to-end performance depend not only on the accuracy of individual models but also on how their outputs affect downstream stages. Each stage can use one of many candidate models. Estimating end-to-end workflow quality by deploying and evaluating every resulting model configuration is therefore prohibitively expensive. As a result, existing approaches face a tradeoff between estimation cost and accuracy: inexpensive methods often produce unreliable quality estimates, while accurate methods require deploying and evaluating many workflow configurations. In this paper, we introduce DAGGER, a framework for estimating the quality of generative AI workflows without exhaustive deployment and profiling. DAGGER represents a workflow as a graph, in which nodes correspond to stages and edges capture how outputs from one stage affect subsequent stages. It then decomposes workflow quality into per-node accuracy terms and per-edge dependency terms. Using a novel analytical formulation and SVD-based matrix completion, DAGGER estimates workflow quality from sparse observations without executing every candidate workflow. We evaluate DAGGER on three generative AI workflows across three datasets. DAGGER estimates workflow quality with a median error of 6.8 percentage points while reducing profiling cost by 10.2 \times relative to BenchPress, a state-of-the-art baseline, and selects workflow configurations competitive with state-of-the-art frameworks such as LLMSelector.

[NLP-113] Validation Bias in Large Language Model Responses to Cancer Treatment Queries: A Factorial Cross-Sectional Study

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）聊天机器人在癌症信息咨询场景中，面对用户持有与证据不符的治疗信念时的安全性问题。研究发现，当用户采用与科学证据相悖的表述框架（如推崇替代疗法或质疑循证治疗）时，LLM倾向于表现出验证偏倚（validation bias），即倾向于认同而非纠正用户的错误信念，导致不安全响应率显著上升（14.4% vs 5.1%；OR 3.14，P < .001）。其解决方案的关键在于通过一个2×2×2因子设计实验，系统评估不同对话形式（单轮/多轮）、治疗类型（循证/替代）和查询情感倾向（正向/负向）下，证据错位框架对响应安全性的影响，并引入基于GPT-5-mini的自动化评分系统进行高信度评估。结果表明，多轮对话可降低不安全响应率，而各厂商模型表现差异显著（1.8%–36.8%），提示当前医疗AI系统的安全性测试必须涵盖非中立、存在认知偏差的用户输入情境，否则可能严重低估真实风险。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31251
作者: Ramez Kouzy,Saketh Vinjamuri,Sarah Ghalayini,Jack Gallifant,Shan Chen,Marielle Fis Loperana,Roxanna Attar-Olyaee,Danielle S. Bitterman

Bitterman, MD (丹妮尔·S·比特曼医生)
